meta.digest_method: sha256 over sorted(relpath + "\0" + file bytes + "\0") of every repo file read

ratioScale.source: all *Ratio / RateLv / percent property fields are x10000 (e.g. baseproperty.Crit=500 -> 5%, CritDamage=15000 -> 150%)

energyScale.source: baseproperty.EnergyMax=10000 vs liberation desc "消耗共鸣能量 100" (1402); damage.Energy 75 shown by encore.moe as 0.75

concertoScale.source: baseproperty.ElementEnergyMax=10000 -> 协奏能量上限 100; damage.ElementPower 240 shown by encore.moe as 2.4

charDefConst.source: community (see MECHANICS.md); consistent with enemy Def = 800*(1+0.01*(Lv-1)) = 792+8*Lv derived from baseproperty+monsterpropertygrowth

meta.damageTypesNote: damage.Type -> bonus category; mapping verified against encore.moe DamageList labels (cached 3.7.8 character pages). Types 6,9,10,11,14 unlabeled.

StrengthFastSwim.zh: dnt/快速游泳耐力消耗速度

StrengthClimbJump.zh: dnt/攀爬跳跃消耗的耐力（一次）

GreenStrengthFastSwim.zh: dnt/快速游泳耐力消耗速度

GreenStrengthClimbJump.zh: dnt/攀爬跳跃消耗的耐力（一次）

assumptions: Playable resonator = roleinfo.RoleType==1 and not IsTrial (includes each Rover element variant as its own entry).

Hit attribution: a description multiplier term x%*n is tied to damage.json rows whose RateLv equals round(x*100) (+-1) at every skill level; ties within the same skill first, then anywhere in the role. Matched -> confidence high; else low with lowReason.
damage rows listed in a skill but not referenced by any multiplier are exported under unlinkedDamage (confidence low).

Energy = damage.Energy/100 resonance energy per hit; concerto = damage.ElementPower/100 per hit (ElementPowerType equals the attacker element in 93% of hits - treated as a tag, not a unit). Resonance skill / liberation / intro rows usually carry ElementPower 0: their concerto gain is the skill-level param 回复协奏能量 (exported as skill.concertoGain), presumably granted on cast by a buff - see MECHANICS.md.
toughness/offTune/hardness = damage.ToughLv/WeaknessLvl/HardnessLv /10000 (scale per encore.moe display; game semantics of 共振度/偏谐值 not verified).
Weapon stat at (level,breach) = base * weaponpropertygrowth.CurveValue/10000; resonator stat = base * rolepropertygrowth ratio/10000.
Echo main stat at level L = StandardProperty * phantomgrowth(GrowthId,L)/10000; AddType 2 = percent, 1 = flat (percent-type props are /10000).
Enemy stats at level L = baseproperty * monsterpropertygrowth(curve, L)/10000; curve 0 unless template sets MonsterPropGrowthId (encore.moe uses 3001 for some). DEF is identical on curves 0 and 3001.
Weapon/sonata text effects parsed with a keyword lexicon; conditional ones are low confidence. Sonata AddProp effects are table-exact (high).

skills.name: 无明心音
skills.desc:
重击·爆裂

冰痕区域扩大规则
每拥有1层【透视】都会扩大【冰痕】区域，最多可拥有2层【透视】。
施放第5段普攻时，获得1层【透视】。
施放变奏技能凛刺时，获得1层【透视】。
施放共鸣技能朔雪永冻时，获得1层【透视】。
施放共鸣解放焦瞑冻土时，获得2层【透视】。
施放重击爆裂时，移除所有【透视】。
skills.descEn:
Heavy Attack: Detonate
When holding Basic Attack, a cursor moves back and forth on the Forte Gauge. Release Basic Attack while cursor falls in the "Frostbite" area, to perform Heavy Attack Detonate, dealing Glacio DMG considered as Heavy Attack DMG.
 
Ice Burst
Sanhua's Heavy Attack Detonate detonates all "Ice Thorns", "Ice Prisms" and "Glaciers" within her attack range, dealing Glacio DMG. Ice Burst deals Resonance Skill DMG.
 
Frostbite Area
The "Frostbite" area expands with every 1 stack of "Clarity". "Clarity" stacks up to 2 times.
Sanhua obtains 1 stack of "Clarity" upon performing Basic Attack 5.
Sanhua obtains 1 stack of "Clarity" upon casting Intro Skill Freezing Thorns.
Sanhua obtains 1 stack of "Clarity" upon casting Resonance Skill Eternal Frost.
Sanhua obtains 2 stack(s) of "Clarity" upon casting Resonance Liberation Glacial Gaze.
Upon casting Heavy Attack Detonate, all "Clarity" is removed.

在自身【狮魂】未满时，重击后短按普攻，将会施放登楼·尾坠千斤攻击目标，造成冷凝伤害。
 
行狮
施放重击起势·纵地金光后，进入行狮状态；
施放变奏技能出洞·睡狮蛰醒或共鸣解放奋进·狮子奋迅，俱足万行后，若满【狮魂】，短按普攻可进入行狮状态。
在行狮状态中：
·可在空中进行攻击，若回到地面，施放重击起势·纵地金光可再次回到空中；
·持续消耗【狮魂】，消耗完后将结束行狮状态，行狮状态可维持5秒；
·若同时处于共鸣解放狮子奋迅状态，【狮魂】消耗速率降低50%，行狮状态最多可延长至10秒；
·凌阳的普攻替换为普攻狂态·摇光金狮舞，进行最多2段的连续攻击，造成冷凝伤害；
·凌阳的共鸣技能替换为共鸣技能飞身式·翻山越涧，造成冷凝伤害；
·当【狮魂】消耗至10点以下时，短按普攻，将会施放普攻凌云式·腿打连环攻击目标，造成冷凝伤害；施放普攻凌云式·腿打连环后，可施放空中攻击登楼·尾坠千斤；
·消耗【狮魂】时回复协奏能量。
 
狮魂的获取规则
【狮魂】上限100点。
施放共鸣技能惊跃·郁怒追逃时，回复【狮魂】。
施放变奏技能出洞·睡狮蛰醒时，回复【狮魂】。
施放共鸣解放奋进·狮子奋迅，俱足万行时，回复【狮魂】。
skills.descEn:
Heavy Attack: Glorious Plunge
When "Lion's Spirit" is full, use Heavy Attack to perform Glorious Plunge, dealing Glacio DMG.
 
Mid-air Attack: Tail Strike
When "Lion's Spirit" is not full, use Basic Attack after Heavy Attack to perform Tail Strike, dealing Glacio DMG.
 
Striding Lion
After casting Heavy Attack Glorious Plunge, enter Striding Lion state;
After casting Intro Skill Lion Awakens or Resonance Liberation Strive: Lion's Vigor, if "Lion's Spirit" is full, use Basic Attack to enter Striding Lion state.
In the Striding Lion state:
-Attacks can be launched in mid-air. If Lingyang is on the ground, use Heavy Attack Glorious Plunge to get back in the air.
-"Lion's Spirit" is continuously consumed before running out in 5s, and when it runs out, Striding Lion ends;
-If Lingyang is in the Resonance Liberation Lion's Vigor state, the consumption speed of "Lion's Spirit" is reduced by 50%, extending Striding Lion state by up to 10s.
-Lingyang's Basic Attack is replaced with Basic Attack Feral Gyrate, which performs up to 2 consecutive attacks, dealing Glacio DMG;
-Lingyang's Resonance Skill is replaced with Mountain Roamer, dealing Glacio DMG;
-When "Lion's Spirit" is less than 10, use Basic Attack to perform Stormy Kicks, dealing Glacio DMG; after performing Basic Attack Stormy Kicks, the Mid-air Attack Tail Strike becomes available.
-Concerto Energy is restored when "Lion's Spirit" is consumed.
 
Lion's Spirit
Lingyang can hold up to 100 "Lion's Spirit".
When casting Resonance Skill Furious Punches, "Lion's Spirit" is restored.
When casting Intro Skill Lion Awakens, "Lion's Spirit" is restored.
When casting Resonance Liberation Strive: Lion's Vigor, "Lion's Spirit" is restored.

鹤影
折枝施放共鸣技能以形写神或重击构形时，消耗【灵韵】可召唤鹤影。
鹤影分为鹤影·左，鹤影·中，鹤影·右三种，每种最多存在1幅，持续15秒。
 
重击·构形
进行下述5种操作时，可消耗耐力施放该技能攻击目标，造成冷凝伤害。
·普攻第3段后一定时间内长按普攻
·施放共鸣技能以形写神后一定时间内短按普攻
·施放共鸣技能神来之笔、共鸣技能极意·神来之笔后一定时间内长按普攻
·处于空中状态时长按普攻
·成功闪避后长按普攻
若施放时折枝至少拥有30点【灵韵】，则消耗30点【灵韵】在场上召唤鹤影·中。
 
共鸣技能·神来之笔
折枝附近存在鹤影时，共鸣技能替换为神来之笔。施放时：
·移动到鹤影的位置并将它清除，然后召唤白鹤攻击目标，造成冷凝伤害，此次伤害为普攻伤害。若移动到处于空中的鹤影，可重置空中闪避次数。
·获得1层【极意】，持续8秒，可叠加2层。
·可在空中施放。
 
共鸣技能·极意·神来之笔
折枝附近存在鹤影，且【极意】层数为2时，神来之笔替换为极意·神来之笔。施放时：
·移除全部【极意】。
·移动到鹤影的位置并将它清除，然后召唤白鹤攻击目标，造成更高的冷凝伤害，此次伤害为普攻伤害，并且让折枝的普攻伤害加成提升18%，持续27秒。若移动到处于空中的鹤影，可重置空中闪避次数。
·可在空中施放。
 
【灵韵】获取规则
【灵韵】上限为90点。
常态攻击造成伤害可回复【灵韵】。
施放变奏技能可回复【灵韵】。
skills.descEn:
Phantasmic Imprint
Zhezhi may summon Phantasmic Imprints at the cost of Afflatus when casting Resonance Skill Manifestation or Heavy Attack Conjuration.
Up to 1 of each of Phantasmic Imprint - Left, Phantasmic Imprint - Middle, and Phantasmic Imprint - Right can exist at the same time, each lasting for 15s.

Heavy Attack - Conjuration
The 5 moves below consume STA to perform Conjuration to attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG.
-Hold the Normal Attack button shortly after Basic Attack Stage 3.
-Press the Normal Attack button shortly after casting Resonance Skill Manifestation.
-Hold the Normal Attack button shortly after casting Resonance Skill Stroke of Genius or Resonance Skill Creation's Zenith.
-Hold the Normal Attack button while in mid-air.
-Hold the Normal Attack button after a successful Dodge.
If Zhezhi has at least 30 Afflatus when performing any of these, consume 30 Afflatus to summon a Phantasmic Imprint - Middle.

Resonance Skill - Stroke of Genius
When a Phatasmic Imprint is nearby, the Resonance Skill is replaced with Stroke of Genius, which can be cast while in mid-air. When it is cast, Zhezhi will:
-Move to the location of the Phatasmic Imprint, remove it, and then summon an Ivory Herald to attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG, considered as Basic Attack DMG. Refresh the mid-air Dodge attempts if the target Phatasmic Imprint is in mid-air.
-Gain 1 stack of Painter's Delight, lasting for 8s and stacking up to 2 times.

Resonance Skill - Creation's Zenith
When a Phantasmic Imprint is nearby and there are 2 stacks of Painter's Delight, Stroke of Genius is replaced with Creation's Zenith, which can be cast while in mid-air. When it is cast, Zhezhi will:
-Lose all stacks of Painter's Delight
-Move to the location of the Phantasmic Imprint, remove it, and then summon an Ivory Herald to attack the target, dealing greater Glacio DMG, considered as Basic Attack DMG, additionally increasing the Basic Attack DMG Bonus by 18% for 27s. Refresh the mid-air Dodge attempts if the target Phatasmic Imprint is in mid-air.

Afflatus
Zhezhi can hold up to 90 Afflatus.
Normal Attacks grant Afflatus on hit.
Casting Intro Skill grants Afflatus.

空中攻击
消耗耐力进行空中下落攻击，造成冷凝伤害。
 
闪避反击
成功闪避后，釉瑚未拥有祯祥的情况下，一定时间内短按普攻，将会向前冲击，造成冷凝伤害，并进行一次问祯。
skills.descEn:
Basic Attack
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Glacio DMG.
 
Heavy Attack
- When Frost is full, hold the Normal Attack Button to cast Frostfall.
- When Frost is full during the Fortune Rolling state, release the Normal Attack Button to cast Frostfall. If Youhu cannot cast Frostfall at the moment, perform Lucky Draw once instead.
Youhu can obtain Frost in the following ways:
- When Frost is not full, hold Normal Attack Button to enter the Fortune Rolling state and restore Frost over time.
- When Basic Attacks hit a target.
 
Heavy Attack: Frostfall
Youhu dashes forward, dealing Glacio DMG, and performs Lucky Draw once.
 
Mid-air Attack

Dodge Counter

skills.name: 匣中问祯
skills.desc:
釉瑚掷出匣子，造成冷凝伤害，回复附近队伍中所有角色的生命值，并进行一次问祯。
 
问祯
进行问祯后，有概率获得不同的祯祥。
拥有祯祥的状态下，点击普攻时，根据祯祥进行对应的奇珍赏。
拥有祯祥的状态下获得新的祯祥，则会用新的祯祥替换掉旧的祯祥。
 
奇珍赏
·编钟：使用编钟进行攻击，造成冷凝伤害。编钟削减怪物共振度的能力较强。
·如意：使用如意对前方进行挥打，造成冷凝伤害。如意的伤害倍率较高。
·鼎：跳上鼎往前位移撞击敌人，造成冷凝伤害。鼎的打断能力较强。
·面具：丢出面具对前方敌人进行攻击，造成冷凝伤害。面具可牵引飞行路径上的目标。
skills.descEn:
Youhu smashes her scroll down at the enemy, dealing Glacio DMG, restoring HP for all party members nearby, and performs Lucky Draw once.
 
Lucky Draw
Youhu obtains a random Antique after the Lucky Draw. With an Antique, her next Basic Attack will activate the corresponding Antique Appraisal.
Only one Antique can exist at a time, and the newly drawn Antique will replace the existing one.
 
Antique Appraisal
- Chime: Attack the enemy with a Chime, dealing Glacio DMG. Chime can effectively reduce the enemy's Vibration Strength.
- Ruyi: Batter the enemy with a Ruyi, dealing Glacio DMG. Ruyi has a higher DMG Multiplier.
- Ding: Ram into the enemy on a Ding, dealing Glacio DMG. Ding can effectively break the enemy's stance.
- Mask: Throw a Mask at enemies in front, dealing Glacio DMG. Mask can pull in enemies along its path.

skills.name: 诗中物
skills.desc:
釉瑚拥有四个【吉兆】时，长按普攻将施放诗中物，造成冷凝伤害，此次伤害为共鸣技能伤害，并且回复附近队伍中所有角色的生命值。
釉瑚最多同时拥有四个【吉兆】。
 
诗中物
对范围敌人造成冷凝伤害，并且根据【吉兆】组合的不同获得以下的一种额外效果：
·飞白：每种【吉兆】都拥有时。对命中的敌人造成额外共振值伤害。
·对偶：拥有一对相同的【吉兆】时。诗中物造成的伤害提升70%。
·双关：拥有两对相同的【吉兆】时。额外回复附近队伍中所有角色的生命值。
·联珠：拥有三个相同的【吉兆】时。诗中物造成的伤害提升175%。
·合说：拥有四个相同的【吉兆】时。同时触发飞白、双关、联珠的效果。
施放诗中物后，清除所有【吉兆】。
 
【吉兆】的获取规则
·施放共鸣技能匣中问祯、变奏技能遂心匣、重击落霜坠、共鸣解放如意卜、闪避反击时，获得祯祥。
·釉瑚拥有祯祥的状态下，点击普攻时，根据祯祥进行对应的奇珍赏，并获得对应的【吉兆】。
skills.descEn:
At four Auspices, hold the Normal Attack button to release Poetic Essence, dealing Glacio DMG, considered as Resonance Skill DMG, while restoring HP for all nearby party members.
Youhu can hold up to four Auspices.
 
Poetic Essence
Deal Glacio DMG to enemies within the range and additionally obtain one of the following effects based on the Auspice combination:
- Free Verse: Four different types Auspices. Additionally reduce the Vibration Strength of hit enemies.
- Antithesis: A pair of Auspices. Increase Poetic Essence's DMG by 70%.
- Double Pun: Two pairs of Auspices. Additionally restore HP for all nearby party members.
- Triplet: Three identical Auspices. Increase Poetic Essence's DMG by 175%.
- Perfect Rhyme: Four identical Auspices. Simultaneously activate the effects of Free Verse, Double Pun, and Triplet.
Casting Poetic Essence removes all Auspices.
 
Auspice
- Youhu gains an Auspice through Antique Appraisal. Use Basic Attack while holding an Antique to receive the corresponding Auspice.
- Youhu unlocks Antiques by casting Resonance Skill Scroll Divination, Intro Skill Scroll of Wonders, Heavy Attack Frostfall, Resonance Liberation Fortune's Favor, and Dodge Counter.

skills.name: 缄默执行
skills.desc:
普攻
进行最多2段的连续攻击，造成冷凝伤害。
 
普攻·必要性手段
珂莱塔身上拥有【可塑晶质】时，施放的普攻将替换为必要性手段。
进行最多3段的连续攻击，造成冷凝伤害，每段必要性手段将消耗1个【可塑晶质】。
 
重击
消耗耐力攻击目标，造成冷凝伤害。
 
重击·限制性策略
珂莱塔【灵萃】充满时，施放的重击将替换为限制性策略，消耗所有【灵萃】，造成冷凝伤害，并使共鸣技能暴力美学的冷却时间减少6秒。
 
空中攻击
消耗耐力进行空中下落攻击，造成冷凝伤害。施放空中攻击落地后一定时间内短按普攻，可施放礼节性问候。
 
空中攻击·礼节性问候
向后空翻越进行攻击，造成冷凝伤害。
 
闪避反击
成功闪避时，一定时间内短按普攻，将会攻击目标，造成冷凝伤害，并消耗1个【可塑晶质】。
skills.descEn:
Basic Attack
Perform up to 2 consecutive strikes, dealing Glacio DMG.
 
Basic Attack - Necessary Measures
With Moldable Crystals, Carlotta's Basic Attack is replaced with Necessary Measures.
Chain up to 3 strikes, dealing Glacio DMG. Each strike of Necessary Measures consumes 1 Moldable {Cus:Sap,S=Crystal P=Crystals SapTag=1}.
 
Heavy Attack
Deliver a charged attack at the target at the cost of STA, dealing Glacio DMG.
 
Heavy Attack - Containment Tactics
When Carlotta's Substance is full, her Heavy Attack will be replaced with Containment Tactics: consume all Substance to deal Glacio DMG and reduce the cooldown of Resonance Skill Art of Violence by 6s.
 
Mid-air Attack
Perform a Plunging Attack at the cost of STA, dealing Glacio DMG. Using Basic Attack shortly after the landing will cast Customary Greetings.
 
Mid-air Attack - Customary Greetings
Flip over the target and deliver a surprise shot, dealing Glacio DMG.
 
Dodge Counter
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to deliver a riposte shot, dealing Glacio DMG. This consumes 1 Moldable {Cus:Sap,S=Crystal P=Crystals SapTag=6}.

skills.desc:

可以在低空中施放。
 
解离
珂莱塔攻击携带解离效果的目标，造成伤害时忽视目标18%防御。
 
枪花轮舞
枪花轮舞状态下按下普攻或共鸣解放可施放死兆。
每次施放死兆时，获得1点【镜向箔】。
【镜向箔】达到4点时，按下普攻或共鸣解放可施放致死以终。
·进入和退出枪花轮舞状态时，清空灵萃，枪花轮舞状态下无法施放普攻必要性手段、重击限制性策略、重击末路见行。
 
死兆
珂莱塔使用铳枪射击并召唤4枚晶体攻击目标，造成冷凝伤害，此次伤害为共鸣技能伤害。
·每次施放死兆时，可以朝方向键方向移动一段距离。
 
致死以终
对范围内的目标造成冷凝伤害，此次伤害为共鸣技能伤害。
·施放致死以终后结束枪花轮舞状态。
skills.descEn:
Deal Glacio DMG to all targets in an area (considered Resonance Skill DMG) and inflict Deconstruction on targets hit, then activate Twilight Tango.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
 
Deconstruction
Dealing DMG to targets inflicted with Deconstruction ignores 18% of their DEF.
 
Twilight Tango
While in Twilight Tango, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack or Resonance Liberation to cast Death Knell.
Each Death Knell grants 1 Meta {Cus:Sap,S=Vector P=Vectors SapTag=3}.
With 4 Meta Vectors, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack or Resonance Liberation to cast Fatal Finale. 
- All Substance is removed when activating and ending Twilight Tango. Cannot perform Basic Attack Necessary Measures, Heavy Attack Containment Tactics, and Heavy Attack Imminent Oblivion while in Twilight Tango.
 
Death Knell
Carlotta fires powerful shots with her musket and summons 4 crystal shards to attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG, considered Resonance Skill DMG.
- Carlotta moves in the direction of the movement input with each shot of Death Knell.
 
Fatal Finale
Deal Glacio DMG to an area, considered Resonance Skill DMG.
- Twilight Tango ends after casting Fatal Finale.

skills.name: 艺间巡礼
skills.desc:
重击·末路见行
珂莱塔每22秒可激活【镀色晶】。
当【灵萃】充满，且【镀色晶】处于激活状态时，长按普攻可消耗所有【灵萃】，施放重击末路见行，施放后【镀色晶】进入冷却状态，此次伤害为共鸣技能伤害。
造成冷凝伤害，使共鸣技能暴力美学的冷却时间减少6秒。
 
揭幕者
【灵萃】达到上限时，获得揭幕者效果。
共鸣解放新浪潮时代、共鸣解放死兆、共鸣解放致死以终的伤害倍率提升80%，枪花轮舞状态时若切换至其他角色或枪花轮舞状态结束时，效果结束。
 
【灵萃】获取规则
【灵萃】上限120点。
共鸣解放枪花轮舞状态下，无法获得【灵萃】。
施放变奏技能入冬叹调时，回复30点【灵萃】。
施放共鸣技能示我璀璨时，每消耗1颗【可塑晶质】，回复10点【灵萃】。
施放普攻必要性手段时，每消耗1颗【可塑晶质】，回复10点【灵萃】。
施放闪避反击时，消耗1颗【可塑晶质】，回复10点【灵萃】。
 
【可塑晶质】获取规则
【可塑晶质】上限6颗。
共鸣解放枪花轮舞状态下，无法获得【可塑晶质】。
施放第2段普攻时，回复3个【可塑晶质】。
施放重击时，回复3个【可塑晶质】。
施放空中攻击礼节性问候时，回复3个【可塑晶质】。
施放变奏技能入冬叹调时，回复3个【可塑晶质】。
施放共鸣技能暴力美学时，回复3个【可塑晶质】。
成功闪避时，回复3个【可塑晶质】。
skills.descEn:
Heavy Attack - Imminent Oblivion
Carlotta activates Tinted Crystal every 22s.
When Substance is full and Tinted Crystal is activated, hold Normal Attack to consume all Substance and cast Heavy Attack Imminent Oblivion, after which Tinted Crystal enters cooldown. 
Deal Glacio DMG (considered Resonance Skill DMG), and reduce the cooldown of Resonance Skill Art of Violence by 6s.
 
Final Bow
When Substance is full, enter the Final Bow state.
Increase the DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation Era of New Wave, Resonance Liberation Death Knell, and Resonance Liberation Fatal Finale by 80%. This effect ends when Carlotta is switched off the field during Twilight Tango or when Twilight Tango ends.
 
Substance
Carlotta can hold up to 120 points of Substance.
Cannot gain Substance while in Twilight Tango triggered by Resonance Liberation.
Restore 30 points of Substance upon casting Intro Skill Wintertime Aria.
Restore 10 points of Substance for every 1 Moldable Crystal consumed upon casting Resonance Skill Chromatic Splendor.
Restore 10 points of Substance for every 1 Moldable Crystal consumed upon casting Basic Attack Necessary Measures.
Consume 1 Moldable Crystal and restore 10 points of Substance upon casting Dodge Counter.
 
Moldable Crystal
Carlotta can hold up to 6 Moldable Crystals.
Cannot gain Moldable Crystal while in Twilight Tango triggered by Resonance Liberation.
Restore 3 Moldable Crystals upon casting Basic Attack Stage 2.
Restore 3 Moldable Crystals upon casting Heavy Attack.
Restore 3 Moldable Crystals upon casting Mid-air Attack Customary Greetings.
Restore 3 Moldable Crystals upon casting Intro Skill Wintertime Aria.
Restore 3 Moldable Crystals upon casting Resonance Skill Art of Violence.
Restore 3 Moldable Crystals upon a successful Dodge.

chains.name: 美或死，璀璨即凋零
chains.nameEn: Beauty Blazes Brightest Before It Fades
chains.desc: 珂莱塔对拥有解离效果的目标攻击造成伤害时，该次伤害的暴击提升12.5%。对处于变彩状态下的目标施放共鸣技能示我璀璨并命中时，额外回复30点【灵萃】。
chains.descEn: When Carlotta deals DMG to a target inflicted with Deconstruction, the Crit. Rate of this instance of DMG is increased by 12.5%. When Resonance Skill Chromatic Splendor hits a target inflicted with Dispersion, Carlotta additionally restores 30 points of Substance.

chains.name: 寂与亡，衰败亦新生
chains.nameEn: Fallen Petals Give Life to New Blooms
chains.desc: 共鸣解放致死以终的伤害倍率提升126%。
chains.descEn: The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation Fatal Finale is increased by 126%.

chains.name: 切步、向前，此为优雅的进行式
chains.desc:
延奏技能碎璃镜花：施放延奏技能致辞后，额外进行一次攻击，造成珂莱塔1032.18%攻击的冷凝伤害。
共鸣技能暴力美学、共鸣技能示我璀璨的伤害倍率提升93%。
chains.descEn: Enable Outro Skill Kaleidoscope Sparks: Deal 1 additional strike at the end of Outro Skill Closing Remark, dealing Glacio DMG equal to 1032.18% of Carlotta's ATK. The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Skill Art of Violence and Resonance Skill Chromatic Splendor is increased by 93%.

chains.name: 以旧雨，为颂赞的苦酒
chains.desc: 珂莱塔施放重击、重击限制性策略、重击末路见行时，队伍中的角色共鸣技能伤害加成提升25%，持续30秒。
chains.descEn: Casting Heavy Attack, Heavy Attack Containment Tactics, and Heavy Attack Imminent Oblivion grants all Resonators in the team 25% Resonance Skill DMG Bonus for 30s.

chains.name: 敬昨夜、今日和彼时彼刻
chains.nameEn: Toast to Past, Today, and Every Day to Come
chains.desc: 重击末路见行的伤害倍率提升47%。
chains.descEn: The DMG Multiplier of Heavy Attack Imminent Oblivion is increased by 47%.

chains.name: 我依然故我，于终幕之上
chains.nameEn: As the Curtain Falls, I Remain What I Am
chains.desc:
共鸣解放死兆的射击造成更高的伤害，并且生成的晶体数量翻倍，二者总计使共鸣解放死兆伤害倍率提升186.6%。
共鸣解放死兆的射击命中目标时，对目标附加焕彩效果：持续时间内无法进行任何动作，受到伤害或持续1.5秒时清除效果。
chains.descEn:
Shots of Resonance Liberation Death Knell deal higher DMG and shoot out double the number of crystal shards, representing a total increase of 186.6% in the DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation Death Knell.
Shots of Resonance Liberation Death Knell inflict Scattering on targets when hit, during which the target is immobilized. This effect is removed after 1.5s or when the target receives DMG.

skills.name: 灼樱刀术
skills.desc:
普攻·常世身
连续短按或按住普攻，进行最多3段的连续攻击，造成冷凝伤害。
普攻·常世身第3段会为命中的目标附加1次【霜渐效应】。

重击·寒簇·常世身
【心念】满300点时，解锁重击·寒簇·常世身。
长按普攻，消耗耐力施放，期间免疫伤害和受击。绯雪依次射出三支箭矢，造成冷凝伤害，此次伤害为共鸣解放伤害。
射出最后一支箭矢时，消耗300点【心念】，解锁预求我身·见心，该箭矢命中目标时，为命中的目标附加1次【霜渐效应】。

空中攻击·常世身
消耗耐力进行空中下落攻击，造成冷凝伤害。

闪避反击·常世身
成功闪避后一定时间内短按普攻，将会攻击目标，造成冷凝伤害。
施放该技能后在一定时间内短按普攻，将会施放普攻·常世身第3段。

普攻·预求身
预求身期间，普攻·常世身替换为普攻·预求身。
进行最多5段的连续攻击，造成冷凝伤害，此次伤害为共鸣解放伤害。
普攻·预求身第3、4、5段会为命中的目标附加1次【霜渐效应】。

重击·预求身
预求身期间，按住普攻，将消耗耐力，进入【沉息】，【沉息】期间持续消耗耐力。松开普攻或耐力耗尽时，绯雪退出【沉息】，挥刃向前突进，造成冷凝伤害，此次伤害为共鸣解放伤害。施放该技能后在一定时间内短按普攻，将会施放普攻·预求身第2段。
若挥刃向前突进的一定时间内受到敌方目标攻击，免疫此次伤害并停滞周围敌人，随后一定时间内免疫打断且受到的伤害降低100%，一定时间内短按普攻改为衔接普攻·预求身第4段。

重击·枯霜·预求身
【淬寒·枯霜】满时，重击·预求身替换为重击·枯霜·预求身。
长按普攻，消耗耐力，施放期间消耗3层【淬寒·枯霜】，获得1点【锻雪·归刃】，造成冷凝伤害，此次伤害为共鸣解放伤害。
重击·枯霜·预求身会为命中的目标附加1次【霜渐效应】。
绯雪处于空中时，若施放该技能，绯雪会先回到地面。

空中攻击·预求身
预求身期间，空中攻击·常世身替换为空中攻击·预求身。
消耗耐力，在空中进行最多3段的连续攻击，造成冷凝伤害，此次伤害为共鸣解放伤害，第3段为空中下落攻击。
空中攻击·预求身第2、3段会为命中的目标附加1次【霜渐效应】。
施放空中攻击·预求身一定时间后，在空中施放除普攻·居合以外的技能时，空中攻击·预求身的连击段数不会被重置。
在空中时，长按普攻，消耗耐力施放空中下落攻击。

闪避反击·预求身
预求身期间，闪避反击·常世身替换为闪避反击·预求身。
成功闪避后一定时间内短按普攻，将会攻击目标，造成冷凝伤害，此次伤害为共鸣解放伤害。
施放该技能后在一定时间内短按普攻，将会施放普攻·预求身第3段。
skills.descEn:
Basic Attack - Present Self
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack consecutively or hold it down to perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Glacio DMG.
Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3 applies Glacio Chafe 1 time on hit.

Heavy Attack - Frost Splinter: Present Self
When Dedication reaches 300 points, Heavy Attack - Frost Splinter: Present Self becomes available.
Hold Normal Attack to shoot out 3 arrows one by one at the cost of STA, dealing Glacio DMG, considered Resonance Liberation DMG. Hiyuki is immune to interruptions and incoming DMG in the duration.
When the last arrow is shot, 300 points of Dedication is consumed and Foreclaiming: Inward Vision becomes available. The arrow applies Glacio Chafe 1 time on hit.

Mid-air Attack - Present Self
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack from Mid-air, dealing Glacio DMG.

Dodge Counter - Present Self
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack within a certain period after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack within a certain period after casting this skill to perform Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3.

Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self
While in Foreclaimed Self, Basic Attack - Present Self is replaced by Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self.
Perform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing Glacio DMG, considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 3, 4, and 5 each applies Glacio Chafe 1 time on hit.

Heavy Attack - Foreclaimed Self
In Foreclaimed Self, hold Normal Attack to enter Hold Breath, continuously consuming STA. When Normal Attack is released or STA is depleted, Hiyuki leaves the Hold Breath state and thrusts forward, dealing Glacio DMG, considered Resonance Liberation DMG. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack within a certain period after casting this skill to perform Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 2.
If Hiyuki is attacked by an enemy within a certain period during the thrust, neutralize that instance of damage, Stagnate nearby targets, and become immune to interruptions for a certain period afterward while reducing all incoming DMG by 100%. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack within a certain period after triggering this effect to chain into Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 4 instead.

Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self
When Whiteout Bitterfrost is full, Heavy Attack - Foreclaimed Self is replaced with Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self. 
Hold Normal Attack and consume STA and 3 stacks of Whiteout Bitterfrost to gain 1 point of Snowforged Blade, dealing Glacio DMG, considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self applies Glacio Chafe 1 time on hit.
If Hiyuki is airborne while casting this skill, she'll land on the ground first.

Mid-air Attack - Foreclaimed Self
While in Foreclaimed Self, Mid-air Attack - Present Self is replaced by Mid-air Attack - Foreclaimed Self.
Consume STA to perform up to 3 consecutive attacks in Mid-air, dealing Glacio DMG, considered Resonance Liberation DMG. Stage 3 is a Plunging Attack.
Mid-air Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 2 & 3 apply Glacio Chafe 1 time on hit.
The Mid-air Attack - Foreclaimed Self cycle will not be reset by casting skills other than Basic Attack - Iai within a short period.
Hold Normal Attack while airborne to perform a Plunging Attack at the cost of STA.

Dodge Counter - Foreclaimed Self
While in Foreclaimed Self, Dodge Counter - Present Self is replaced by Dodge Counter - Foreclaimed Self.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack within a certain period after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG, considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack within a certain period after casting this skill to perform Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 3.

skills.name: 霜罚
skills.desc:
共鸣技能·常世身
造成冷凝伤害。
施放时，使下一次普攻·常世身第3段获得强化：施放时额外回复100点【心念】，若切换至其他角色则失去该效果。
施放该技能后在一定时间内短按或按住普攻，将会施放普攻·常世身第3段。

预求身期间，共鸣技能·常世身替换为霜罚·白玉切和霜罚·落华：

霜罚·白玉切
处于地面时，短按共鸣技能，牵引周围的目标，造成冷凝伤害，并移除命中目标的【霜结】状态。
该技能与霜罚·落华共享冷却时间。

霜罚·落华
处于空中时，短按共鸣技能，牵引周围的目标，造成冷凝伤害，并移除命中目标的【霜结】状态。
该技能与霜罚·白玉切共享冷却时间。
skills.descEn:
Resonance Skill - Present Self
Deal Glacio DMG.
Casting this skill enhances the next Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3, which now restores 100 points of Dedication when cast. Switching to another Resonator ends this effect.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} or hold Normal Attack within a certain period after casting this skill to perform Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3.

While in Foreclaimed Self, Resonance Skill - Present Self is replaced by Frostblight: Jade Cleave and Frostblight: Petalfall:

Frostblight: Jade Cleave
While on the ground, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Skill to pull in nearby targets and deal Glacio DMG, removing the targets' Frostbind.
This skill shares a Cooldown with Frostblight: Petalfall.

Frostblight: Petalfall
While in mid-air, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Skill to pull in nearby targets and deal Glacio DMG, removing the targets' Frostbind.
This skill shares a Cooldown with Frostblight: Jade Cleave.

skills.name: 预求我身
skills.desc:
预求我身·见心
施放重击·寒簇·常世身后，解锁预求我身·见心。
常世身期间，短按共鸣解放施放。造成冷凝伤害。施放时获得3点【武霜·居合】，清除300点【心念】和【寒意】，随后进入预求身并回复50点【寒意】。
预求我身·见心会为命中的目标附加4次【霜渐效应】。
施放预求我身·见心不消耗共鸣能量。

预求我身·归刃
预求身期间，可通过以下两种方式施放预求我身·归刃：
·短按共鸣解放松开时施放预求我身·归刃。若当前拥有3点【锻雪·归刃】，则消耗所有【锻雪·归刃】，否则不消耗。
·按住共鸣解放，绯雪进入蓄力状态，每隔一定时间消耗1点【锻雪·归刃】，松开共鸣解放时，施放预求我身·归刃。若松开共鸣解放时未消耗【锻雪·归刃】，则将会继续蓄力一定时间后自动施放。【锻雪·归刃】归零后，会自动施放预求我身·归刃。
绯雪造成冷凝伤害，每消耗1点【锻雪·归刃】会使该次攻击的伤害倍率增加。
施放时清除300点【心念】和【寒意】，并退出预求身。
skills.descEn:
Foreclaiming: Inward Vision
Foreclaiming: Inward Vision becomes available after casting Heavy Attack - Frost Splinter: Present Self.
While in Present Self, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Liberation to cast this skill, dealing Glacio DMG. Upon casting this skill, gain 3 points of Frostharden Iai, remove 300 points of Dedication and Frostheart. Then, enter Foreclaimed Self and restore 50 points of Frostheart.
Foreclaiming: Inward Vision applies 4 stacks of Glacio Chafe on hit.
Casting Foreclaiming: Inward Vision does not consume Resonance Energy.

Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation
While in Foreclaimed Self, Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation can be cast via the following ways:
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Resonance Liberation and release to cast Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation. If Hiyuki has 3 points of Snowforged Blade, consume all Snowforged Blade. Otherwise, this cast does not consume Snowforged Blade.
- Hold Resonance Liberation to enter a charging state. During this state, consume 1 point of Snowforged Blade periodically. Release Resonance Liberation to cast Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation. If no Snowforged Blade is consumed when Resonance Liberation is released, Hiyuki will continue to charge the attack and cast the skill automatically after certain time. Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation will also be cast automatically when Snowforged Blade depletes. 
Hiyuki deals Glacio DMG. Each point of Snowforged Blade consumed increases the DMG Multiplier of this attack.
Casting the skill consumes 300 points of Dedication and Frostheart, and ends Foreclaimed Self.

skills.name: 细雪
skills.desc:
队伍中的角色附加【霜渐效应】或【虚湮效应】时，绯雪获得1层【雪锈】。【雪锈】最多可叠加3层，每名角色仅可通过上述方式使绯雪获得1层【雪锈】。绯雪根据持有的【雪锈】层数，获得以下增益，可叠加：
1层【雪锈】：自身为队伍中登场角色时，一定范围内的目标受到【霜冻效应】伤害加深30%。绯雪的暴击伤害提升40%。
2层【雪锈】：自身为队伍中登场角色时，每次自身附加【霜渐效应】时，额外附加一段102%异常倍率的【霜冻效应】伤害。
3层【雪锈】：自身为队伍中登场角色时，一定范围内的目标受到【霜冻效应】伤害额外加深30%。
角色编入队伍时，重置该效果。
skills.descEn:
When a Resonator in the team applies Glacio Chafe or Havoc Bane, Hiyuki gains 1 stack of Snow Rust. Snow Rust stacks up to 3 times. Each Resonator can trigger this effect only once in this way.
Based on Hiyuki's current stacks of Snow Rust, the following bonuses are unlocked:
1 stack of Snow Rust: When Hiyuki is the active Resonator in the team, Glacio Bite DMG is Amplified by 30% against targets within a certain range. Hiyuki's Crit. DMG is increased by 40%.
2 stacks of Snow Rust: When Hiyuki is the active Resonator in the team, each time she applies Glacio Chafe, she additionally deals an instance of Glacio Bite DMG with a fixed DMG Multiplier of 102%.
3 stacks of Snow Rust: When Hiyuki is the active Resonator in the team, Glacio Bite DMG is additionally Amplified by 30% against targets within a certain range.
This effect resets when new Resonators are added to the team.

skills.name: 无常世
skills.desc: 绯雪每次脱离战斗状态或恢复意识后，处于非战斗状态达到4秒时，如果自身的【锻雪·归刃】点数小于1点，则回复1点。
skills.descEn: Once Hiyuki leaves the combat state or recovers after being knocked out, when she stays out of combat for 4s with fewer than 1 point of Snowforged Blade, restore 1 point.

skills.name: 霜锋
skills.desc:
造成冷凝伤害，此次伤害为共鸣解放伤害，为命中的目标附加1次【霜渐效应】。
如果处于常世身，施放时回复200点【心念】，且施放该技能后在一定时间内短按或按住普攻，将会施放普攻·常世身第3段。
如果处于预求身，施放该技能后在一定时间内短按普攻，将会施放普攻·预求身第2段。
skills.descEn:
Deal Glacio DMG, considered Resonance Liberation DMG, and apply Glacio Chafe 1 time on hit.
In Present Self, casting this skill restores 200 points of Dedication. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} or hold Normal Attack within a certain period after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3.
In Foreclaimed Self, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack within a certain period after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 2.

skills.name: 万世霜天
skills.desc:
霜冻效应
·绯雪处于编队时，附近队伍的角色对目标附加【霜渐效应】时，改为附加【霜冻效应】。【霜冻效应】被附加在目标上时，会按照目标当前【霜冻效应】上限层数结算一次【霜冻效应】伤害，且目标被冰冻期间，可以继续为目标附加【霜冻效应】。【霜冻效应】可同时视为【霜渐效应】。【霜冻效应】伤害可同时视为【霜渐效应】伤害。
·预求我身·见心和普攻·居合命中目标时，若目标【霜冻效应】层数不低于10层，会消耗目标10层【霜冻效应】，并造成一次【霜结】。
·绯雪进入编队时，会清空所有目标的【霜渐效应】层数。绯雪离开编队时，如果编队中没有其他能将【霜渐效应】转变为【霜冻效应】的角色，会清空目标的【霜冻效应】层数。

常世身
绯雪初始处于常世身，常世身期间，可通过特定技能回复【心念】。

预求身
绯雪施放预求我身·见心时，进入预求身。预求身期间，解锁全新的战斗形态，可通过特定技能回复【寒意】。

居合架势
若【寒意】不低于100点时进行以下操作，绯雪会消耗耐力向后瞬身，进入【居合架势】：
·施放除重击·枯霜·预求身以外的常态攻击·预求身、霜罚·白玉切、霜罚·落华、普攻·居合、变奏技能·霜锋后短按闪避。
·施放霜罚·白玉切、霜罚·落华后一定时间内长按共鸣技能。
进行上述操作时，若按住向前方向，且技能目标在一定范围内，绯雪会消耗耐力瞬身至敌人身后，进入【居合架势】。
绯雪在空中时可以进入【居合架势】。进入【居合架势】时，重置空中闪避次数。【居合架势】期间，若切换至其他角色则提前退出。

普攻·居合
施放【居合架势】后一定时间内，短按普攻可以消耗100点【寒意】，施放普攻·居合，造成冷凝伤害，此次伤害为共鸣解放伤害。
若施放后【寒意】仍不低于100点，一定时间内可以短按普攻再次施放普攻·居合。
若施放普攻·居合的一定时间内受到敌方目标攻击，免疫此次伤害，随后一定时间内免疫打断且受到的伤害降低100%。
每次施放普攻·居合期间，若拥有【武霜·居合】，绯雪会消耗1点【武霜·居合】，使本次普攻·居合为命中的目标附加3次【霜渐效应】，同时绯雪获得1层【淬寒·枯霜】。

心念
【心念】上限300点。
常世身期间，可通过以下方式回复【心念】：
·施放普攻·常世身第3段时，回复100点【心念】。
·施放变奏技能·霜锋时，回复200点【心念】。
·施放共鸣技能·常世身时，使下一次普攻·常世身第3段获得强化：施放时额外回复100点【心念】，若切换至其他角色则失去该效果。

寒意
【寒意】上限300点。
施放霜罚·白玉切、霜罚·落华期间，或是除重击·枯霜·预求身以外的常态攻击·预求身命中目标时，回复【寒意】。

武霜·居合
【武霜·居合】上限3点。
施放预求我身·见心时获得3点【武霜·居合】。

淬寒·枯霜
【淬寒·枯霜】上限3层。
每次通过施放普攻·居合消耗【武霜·居合】时，获得1层【淬寒·枯霜】。

锻雪·归刃
【锻雪·归刃】上限3点。
每次施放重击·枯霜·预求身期间，获得1点【锻雪·归刃】。
skills.descEn:
Glacio Bite
- While Hiyuki is in the team, Glacio Chafe inflicted by nearby Resonators in the team is converted to Glacio Bite. Every time a new stack of Glacio Bite is inflicted on a target, an instance of Glacio Bite DMG is triggered based on that enemy's current Glacio Bite stack limit. Glacio Bite can be inflicted on frozen targets. Glacio Bite is also considered Glacio Chafe and Glacio Bite DMG is also considered Glacio Chafe DMG.
- When Foreclaiming: Inward Vision or Basic Attack - Iai hits a target, if the target has no fewer than 10 stacks of Glacio Bite, consume 10 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=1} and trigger Frostbind once. 
- When Hiyuki joins the team, remove all stacks of Glacio Chafe from the targets. When Hiyuki leaves the team, if there is no other Resonator in the team who can convert Glacio Chafe into Glacio Bite, all enemies' Glacio Bite stacks are cleared.

Present Self
Hiyuki starts in Present Self. While in Present Self, casting certain skills restores Dedication.

Foreclaimed Self
Hiyuki enters Foreclaimed Self after casting Foreclaiming: Inward Vision. While in Foreclaimed Self, Hiyuki unlocks new moves and restores Frostheart through certain attacks.

Iai Stance
If Hiyuki has at least 100 points of Frostheart, performing any of the following actions causes her to flash backward at the cost of STA and enter Iai Stance:
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Dodge after casting any Normal Attacks - Foreclaimed Self other than Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self, Frostblight: Jade Cleave, Frostblight: Petalfall, Basic Attack - Iai, or Intro Skill - Frostedge.
- Hold Resonance Skill within a certain period after casting Frostblight: Jade Cleave or Frostblight: Petalfall.
While performing the actions above, if there is a valid target within the range and the forward input is held down, Hiyuki instead flashes behind the enemy at the cost of STA and enters Iai Stance.
Hiyuki may enter Iai Stance while airborne. Upon entering the Iai Stance, Hiyuki's mid-air Dodge charges are reset. Iai Stance ends if Hiyuki is switched out.

Basic Attack - Iai
Within a certain period after entering Iai Stance, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack and consume 100 points of Frostheart to cast Basic Attack - Iai, dealing Glacio DMG, considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
If Frostheart remains at 100 points or above after casting this skill, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack within a certain period to cast Basic Attack - Iai again.
If Hiyuki is attacked by an enemy within a certain period during Basic Attack - Iai, neutralize this instance of damage and become immune to interruptions for a certain duration afterwards while reducing all incoming DMG by 100%.
Each time Basic Attack - Iai is cast, if Hiyuki has Frostharden Iai, consume 1 point of Frostharden Iai to inflict 3 stacks of Glacio Chafe on hit, and gain 1 stack of Whiteout Bitterfrost.

Dedication
Hiyuki holds up to  300 points of Dedication.
While in Present Self, Dedication may be restored via the following ways:
- Casting Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3 restores 100 points of Dedication.
- Casting Intro Skill - Frostedge restores 200 points of Dedication.
Casting Resonance Skill - Present Self enhances the next Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3, which now additionally restores 100 points of Dedication. This effect ends when Hiyuki is switched out.

Frostheart
Hiyuki holds up to 300 points of Frostheart.
Frostheart is restored while casting Frostblight: Jade Cleave and Frostblight: Petalfall, or when Normal Attacks - Foreclaimed Self other than Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self hits the target.

Frostharden Iai
Frostharden Iai has a maximum of 3 points.
Casting Foreclaiming: Inward Vision grants 3 points of Frostharden Iai.

Whiteout Bitterfrost
Whiteout Bitterfrost stacks up to 3 times.
Each time Frostharden Iai is consumed through Basic Attack - Iai, gain 1 stack of Whiteout Bitterfrost.

Snowforged Blade
Snowforged Blade stacks up to 3 times.
Each time Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self is cast, gain 1 stack of Snowforged Blade.

inherents.name: 细雪
inherents.desc:
队伍中的角色附加【霜渐效应】或【虚湮效应】时，绯雪获得1层【雪锈】。【雪锈】最多可叠加3层，每名角色仅可通过上述方式使绯雪获得1层【雪锈】。绯雪根据持有的【雪锈】层数，获得以下增益，可叠加：
1层【雪锈】：自身为队伍中登场角色时，一定范围内的目标受到【霜冻效应】伤害加深30%。绯雪的暴击伤害提升40%。
2层【雪锈】：自身为队伍中登场角色时，每次自身附加【霜渐效应】时，额外附加一段102%异常倍率的【霜冻效应】伤害。
3层【雪锈】：自身为队伍中登场角色时，一定范围内的目标受到【霜冻效应】伤害额外加深30%。
角色编入队伍时，重置该效果。

inherents.name: 无常世
inherents.desc: 绯雪每次脱离战斗状态或恢复意识后，处于非战斗状态达到4秒时，如果自身的【锻雪·归刃】点数小于1点，则回复1点。

chains.name: 不见春
chains.desc:
普攻·预求身、重击·预求身、空中攻击·预求身、闪避反击·预求身的伤害倍率提升120%。

普攻·预求身第3段的攻击范围提升，且会将攻击范围内的敌人向中心进行牵引。施放普攻·预求身第4、5段期间免疫打断。

施放预求我身·见心时，使下一次普攻·预求身第1段和下一次普攻·预求身第2段命中目标时获得强化，为目标附加1次【霜渐效应】。
chains.descEn:
The DMG Multipliers of Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self, Heavy Attack - Foreclaimed Self, Mid-air Attack - Foreclaimed Self, and Dodge Counter - Foreclaimed Self are increased by 120%.

Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 3 now has an increased range and pulls enemies within range toward the center. Hiyuki is immune to interruptions while casting  Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 4 & 5.

Casting Foreclaiming: Inward Vision enhances the next Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 1 & 2, which now inflict Glacio Chafe 1 time on hit.

chains.name: 于无声处冰冷燃烧
chains.desc:
普攻·居合的伤害倍率提升125%。

固有技能无常世替换为以下效果：
绯雪每次脱离战斗状态或恢复意识后，处于非战斗状态达到4秒时，回复3点【锻雪·归刃】。

绯雪每次脱离战斗状态或恢复意识后，处于非战斗状态达到4秒时，触发一次以下效果：
·处于预求身状态时，【武霜·居合】回复3点。
·重置2次霜罚·白玉切的冷却时间。
·后续2次施放霜罚·白玉切或霜罚·落华期间，额外回复50点【寒意】。
chains.descEn:
Basic Attack - Iai's DMG Multiplier is increased by 125%.

Inherent Skill Ephemeral Realm's effect becomes the following one:
Once Hiyuki leaves the combat state or recovers from being knocked out, after staying out of combat for 4s, restore 3 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=1} of Snowforged Blade.

Once Hiyuki leaves the combat state or recovers from being knocked out, after staying out of combat for 4s, the following effects are triggered once:
- While in Foreclaimed Self, restore 3 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=3} points of Frostharden Iai.
- Reset the Cooldown of 2 {Cus:Sap,S=charge P=charges SapTag=4} of Frostblight: Jade Cleave.
- Restore an additional 50 points of Frostheart for the next 2 {Cus:Sap,S=cast P=casts SapTag=5} of Frostblight: Jade Cleave or Frostblight: Petalfall.

chains.name: 我身无我亦无穷
chains.desc:
固有技能细雪获得额外效果：当角色编入队伍或绯雪恢复意识，2秒后绯雪获得1层【雪锈】，最多通过该方式获取1层【雪锈】。

重击·寒簇·常世身和重击·枯霜·预求身的伤害倍率提升160%。

持有2层【雪锈】时，自身为队伍中登场角色时，每次自身附加【霜渐效应】时，额外附加的异常倍率提升488%。
chains.descEn:
Inherent Skill Fine Snow gains the following effect:
2s after a Resonator joins the team or Hiyuki is revived, Hiyuki gains 1 stack of Snow Rust. Hiyuki can obtain up to 1 stack of Snow Rust in this way.

The DMG Multipliers of Heavy Attack - Frost Splinter: Present Self and Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self are increased by 160%.

At 2 stacks of Snow Rust, while Hiyuki is the active Resonator in the team, the DMG Multiplier of the additionally applied Glacio Bite DMG each time she inflicts Glacio Chafe is increased by 488%.

chains.name: 有如苇草浮沉
chains.desc:
施放共鸣技能·常世身、霜罚·白玉切、霜罚·落华时，使附近队伍中所有角色造成的伤害提升20%，持续30秒。

每次施放霜罚·白玉切、霜罚·落华时，回复自身生命上限18%的生命值。
chains.descEn:
Casting Resonance Skill - Present Self, Frostblight: Jade Cleave, or Frostblight: Petalfall increases the DMG dealt by all nearby Resonators in the team by 20% for 30s.

Restore 18% of Max HP while casting Frostblight: Jade Cleave or Frostblight: Petalfall.

chains.name: 千祈万愿尽求我身
chains.desc: 共鸣技能·常世身、霜罚·白玉切、霜罚·落华的伤害倍率提升80%。
chains.descEn: The DMG Multipliers of Resonance Skill - Present Self, Frostblight: Jade Cleave, and Frostblight: Petalfall are increased by 80%.

chains.name: 纵使前路永夜无终
chains.desc:
预求我身·见心、预求我身·归刃暴击伤害提升500%。

持有2层【雪锈】时，“自身为队伍中登场角色时，每次自身附加【霜渐效应】时，额外附加异常倍率”改为“自身为队伍中登场角色时，每次队伍中的角色附加【霜渐效应】时，额外附加异常倍率”。
持有2层【雪锈】时，绯雪的暴击伤害提升40%。
持有3层【雪锈】时，队伍中登场角色一定范围内的目标受到【霜冻效应】的最终伤害提升25%。
chains.descEn:
The Crit. DMG of Foreclaiming: Inward Vision and Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation is increased by 500%.

At 2 stacks of Snow Rust, the effect "While Hiyuki is the active Resonator in the team, each time she applies Glacio Chafe, she additionally deals an instance of Glacio Bite DMG with a fixed DMG Multiplier" changes to "While Hiyuki is the active Resonator in the team, each time a Resonator in the team applies Glacio Chafe, she additionally deals an instance of Glacio Bite DMG with a fixed DMG Multiplier."
At 2 stacks of Snow Rust, Hiyuki's Crit. DMG is increased by 40%.
At 3 stacks of Snow Rust, the total Glacio Bite DMG taken by targets within a certain range of the active Resonator in the team is increased by 25%.

skills.name: 抓拍
skills.desc:
普攻
进行最多3段的连续攻击，造成冷凝伤害。
施放普攻第3段时，长按普攻，展开聚焦环，指针将在聚焦环上移动。
·若指针不在完美焦距时抬起普攻，洛瑟菈将施放普攻第3段·乏善可陈，造成冷凝伤害并回复【印象】。
·若指针在完美焦距时抬起普攻，洛瑟菈则将施放普攻第3段·可圈可点，造成更高的冷凝伤害并回复更多的【印象】。
若施放普攻第2段后一定时间内短按普攻，则不会展开聚焦环，并直接施放普攻第3段·乏善可陈。
展开聚焦环期间，完美焦距区域将逐渐扩大。完美焦距区域填满聚焦环后则自动收起，洛瑟菈将直接施放普攻第3段·可圈可点。
长按普攻时，可依次施放普攻第1、2、3段，且施放普攻第3段时将展开聚焦环。

空中攻击
消耗耐力进行空中下落攻击，造成冷凝伤害。
施放该技能后在一定时间内短按普攻将会施放普攻第2段。

闪避反击
成功闪避后一定时间内短按普攻，将会攻击目标，造成冷凝伤害。
施放该技能后在一定时间内短按普攻将会施放普攻第3段。
skills.descEn:
Basic Attack
Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Glacio DMG.
While casting Basic Attack Stage 3, hold Normal Attack to deploy Focus Ring. A cursor will move around the Focus Ring. 
- Releasing the Normal Attack button when the cursor falls outside of Perfect Focus will trigger Basic Attack Stage 3 - Unremarkable, dealing Glacio DMG and restoring Trace.
- Releasing the Normal Attack button when the cursor falls within Perfect Focus will trigger Basic Attack Stage 3 - Commendable, dealing increased Glacio DMG and restoring additional Trace.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tapping PC=Pressing Gamepad=Pressing} Normal Attack shortly after casting Basic Attack Stage 2 will trigger Basic Attack Stage 3 - Unremarkable instead of deploying Focus Ring.
When Focus Ring is deployed, the Perfect Focus zone continues to fill the ring. Once Focus Ring is completely filled, it automatically collapses and triggers Basic Attack Stage 3 - Commendable.
Hold Normal Attack to cast Basic Attack Stage 1, 2, and 3 in sequence, and deploy Focus Ring during Basic Attack Stage 3.

Mid-air Attack
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing Glacio DMG. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.

Dodge Counter
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG. Shortly after performing this attack, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack to perform Basic Attack Stage 3.

skills.name: 幻象定帧
skills.desc:
牵引周围的目标，造成冷凝伤害。
施放时，长按共鸣技能，展开聚焦环，指针将在聚焦环上移动。
·若指针不在完美焦距时抬起共鸣技能，洛瑟菈将施放补光，造成冷凝伤害并回复【印象】。
·若指针在完美焦距时抬起共鸣技能，洛瑟菈则将施放追光，造成更高的冷凝伤害并回复更多的【印象】。
若施放时未长按共鸣技能且洛瑟菈为登场角色时，则不会展开聚焦环，并直接施放补光。

补光
攻击目标，造成冷凝伤害，并使共鸣技能的冷却时间减少8秒。
施放该技能后在一定时间内短按普攻将会施放普攻第2段。

追光
攻击目标，造成冷凝伤害。
施放追光期间，洛瑟菈额外回复自身20点协奏能量，且洛瑟菈处于共鸣模态·霜渐时将会为命中目标附加1层【霜渐效应】。
追光免疫打断，施放追光期间切换至其他角色则提前退出。
施放该技能后在一定时间内短按普攻将会施放普攻第2段。
skills.descEn:
Pull in nearby targets, dealing Glacio DMG.
While casting this skill, hold Resonance Skill to deploy Focus Ring. A cursor will move around the Focus Ring.
- Releasing the Resonance Skill button when the cursor falls outside of Perfect Focus will trigger Compensate, dealing Glacio DMG and restoring Trace.
- Releasing the Resonance Skill button when the cursor falls within Perfect Focus will trigger Spotlight, dealing increased Glacio DMG and restoring additional Trace.
If Lucilla casts the skill on-field without holding Resonance Skill, she directly casts Compensate instead of deploying Focus Ring.

Compensate
Attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG and reducing the Cooldown of Lucilla's Resonance Skill by 8s.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.

Spotlight
Attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG.
While casting Spotlight, Lucilla additionally restores 20 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=1} of Concerto Energy, and inflicts 1 extra {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=2} of Glacio Chafe onto the target if she is in Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe.
Spotlight is immune to interruptions. Switching to another Resonator while casting Spotlight ends the skill early.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.

skills.name: 历历在目
skills.desc:
洛瑟菈共鸣能量上限为0，历历在目不消耗共鸣能量。
拥有全部3张【照片】时，解锁历历在目。

历历在目
造成冷凝伤害并进入追忆状态：
·处于共鸣模态·霜渐时，此次伤害为普攻伤害。施放该技能时洛瑟菈的普攻伤害加成提升30%，持续10秒。
·处于共鸣模态·声骸时，此次伤害为声骸技能伤害。施放该技能时洛瑟菈的声骸技能伤害加成提升30%，持续10秒。
追忆状态持续期间，洛瑟菈的抗打断能力提升，无法施放共鸣技能、共鸣解放，普攻、闪避反击、空中攻击、变奏技能·剪辑替换为普攻·溯念留形、闪避反击·追忆、空中攻击·追忆、变奏技能·剪辑·硬切。
可在低空中施放。

普攻·溯念留形
进行最多3段的连续攻击，造成冷凝伤害，此次伤害为普攻伤害。
长按普攻时，可依次施放普攻·溯念留形第1、2、3段。
施放普攻·溯念留形第3段时，连续短按或长按普攻，可持续攻击目标。
施放普攻·溯念留形第3段时抬起普攻，或普攻·溯念留形第3段结束后，将会自动施放断舍离。

断舍离
对范围内的目标造成冷凝伤害，洛瑟菈处于共鸣模态·霜渐/共鸣模态·声骸时，此次伤害为普攻伤害/声骸技能伤害。
断舍离免疫伤害和受击，期间不能切换角色。
施放断舍离期间，洛瑟菈额外回复自身20点协奏能量。
施放断舍离后，退出追忆状态。

空中攻击·追忆
消耗耐力进行空中下落攻击，造成冷凝伤害，此次伤害为普攻伤害。
施放该技能后在一定时间内短按普攻将会施放普攻·溯念留形第2段。

闪避反击·追忆
成功闪避后一定时间内短按普攻，将会攻击目标，造成冷凝伤害，此次伤害为普攻伤害。
施放该技能后在一定时间内短按普攻将会施放普攻·溯念留形第3段。
skills.descEn:
Lucilla holds up to 0 Resonance Energy. Clear As Day consumes no Resonance Energy.
Clear As Day unlocks when Lucilla holds all 3 Photos.

Clear As Day
Deal Glacio DMG and enter Reminiscence:
- When in Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe, the DMG dealt is considered Basic Attack DMG. Casting this skill grants Lucilla 30% Basic Attack DMG Bonus for 10s.
- When in Resonance Mode - Echo, the DMG dealt is considered Echo Skill DMG. Casting this skill grants Lucilla 30% Echo Skill DMG Bonus for 10s.
When in Reminiscence, Lucilla's resistance to interruption is increased, and she cannot cast Resonance Skill and Resonance Liberation. Her Basic Attack, Dodge Counter, Mid-air Attack, and Intro Skill - Clip It are replaced with Basic Attack - Tracing Forms, Dodge Counter - Reminiscence, Mid-air Attack - Reminiscence, and Intro Skill - Clip It: Hard Cut respectively.
Can be performed in mid-air close to the ground.

Basic Attack - Tracing Forms
Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Glacio DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.
Hold Normal Attack to cast Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 1, 2, & 3 consecutively.
While casting Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 3, consecutively {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=pess} or hold Normal Attack to continuously attack the target.
While casting Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 3, release the Normal Attack button or finish the whole Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 3 to automatically perform Letting It Go.

Letting It Go
Deal Glacio DMG to targets within the range. When in Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe/Resonance Mode - Echo, DMG dealt is considered Basic Attack DMG/Echo Skill DMG.
Lucilla is immune to interruption and damage during Letting It Go, and Resonator switching is disabled while casting.
While casting Letting It Go, Lucilla additionally restores 20 points of Concerto Energy.
Casting Letting It Go ends Reminiscence.

Mid-air Attack - Reminiscence
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing Glacio DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG. 
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 2.

Dodge Counter - Reminiscence
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG. 
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to perform Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 3.

skills.name: 慢镜头
skills.desc:
洛瑟菈展开聚焦环期间，减缓拍摄范围内目标的时间流速。
施放共鸣技能·追光时，洛瑟菈将根据共鸣模态提供不同的强化效果：
·处于共鸣模态·霜渐时，队伍中登场角色一定范围内的目标冷凝抗性降低8%，持续30秒。期间敌人被【霜渐效应】的伤害击败，本次击败将视为距离其最近的登场角色造成。
·处于共鸣模态·声骸时，队伍中的角色声骸技能伤害加成提升25%，持续30秒。
洛瑟菈切换模态时，上述效果提前结束。
skills.descEn:
When Focus Ring is deployed, Lucilla slows targets within her shot.
While casting Resonance Skill - Spotlight, Lucilla grants the following enhancements based on her Resonance Mode:
- When in Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe, Glacio RES of targets within a certain range around the active Resonator is reduced by 8% for 30s. If an enemy falls to Glacio Chafe DMG during this time, it counts as caused by the nearest active Resonator.
- When in Resonance Mode - Echo, Resonators in the team gain 25% Echo Skill DMG Bonus for 30s.
These enhancements end when Lucilla switches the Resonance Mode.

skills.name: 铭记
skills.desc:
胶卷的可叠加层数上限增加至10层，变焦的可叠加层数上限增加至4层。
洛瑟菈每次消耗【照片】时，若处于共鸣模态·霜渐/共鸣模态·声骸，获得2层胶卷/1层变焦。
skills.descEn:
Film Roll can now be stacked up to 10 stacks, and Zoom up to 4 stacks.
Each time Lucilla consumes Photo when in Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe/Resonance Mode - Echo, she gains 2 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=2} of Film Roll/1 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=3} of Zoom.

skills.name: 剪辑
skills.desc:
剪辑
攻击目标，造成冷凝伤害，为目标附加1层【霜渐效应】。

剪辑·硬切
追忆状态持续期间，变奏技能替换为剪辑·硬切。
攻击目标，造成冷凝伤害，为目标附加1层【霜渐效应】。
施放该技能后在一定时间内短按普攻将会施放普攻·溯念留形第3段。
skills.descEn:
Clip It
Attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG and inflicting 1 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=0} of Glacio Chafe.

Clip It: Hard Cut
When in Reminiscence, Intro Skill is replaced with Clip It: Hard Cut.
Attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG and inflicting 1 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=0} of Glacio Chafe.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 3.

skills.name: 记忆宫殿
skills.desc:
既视感
施放共鸣解放·历历在目时，洛瑟菈将根据共鸣模态提供不同的强化效果：
·处于共鸣模态·霜渐时，获得4层胶卷，持续30秒，可叠加4层，持续时间结束清除全部层数。
·处于共鸣模态·声骸时，获得1层变焦，持续30秒，可叠加1层，持续时间结束清除全部层数。
洛瑟菈切换模态时，上述效果提前结束。

胶卷
队伍中除洛瑟菈以外的登场角色为目标附加【霜渐效应】时，洛瑟菈将消耗1层胶卷，为周围的目标附加2次【霜渐效应】，每0.5秒可触发1次。

变焦
每层变焦使队伍中登场角色造成声骸技能伤害的暴击伤害提升10%。

遗忘
施放普攻·溯念留形第3段期间，洛瑟菈每隔一段时间将消耗1张【照片】施放遗忘造成1次冷凝伤害:
·处于共鸣模态·霜渐时，此次伤害为普攻伤害，并为命中目标附加1层【霜渐效应】。
·处于共鸣模态·声骸时，此次伤害为声骸技能伤害。每次施放遗忘时，视为施放不同名的声骸技能。

走马观花
短按瞄准键，洛瑟菈进入摄影状态。摄影状态下，洛瑟菈将标记镜头范围内的残响、环境采集物和部分收集品。按下快门时，洛瑟菈将拍摄当下值得纪念的瞬间，并收集上述内容。

【印象】获取规则
【印象】上限150点。
施放变奏技能·剪辑期间，回复100点【印象】。
施放共鸣技能·追光期间，回复50点【印象】。
施放普攻第3段·可圈可点期间，回复50点【印象】。
施放共鸣技能·补光或普攻第3段·乏善可陈期间，回复25点【印象】。

【照片】获取规则
【照片】上限3张。
每回复50点【印象】，将自动冲洗为1张【照片】。
skills.descEn:
Déjà Vu
While casting Resonance Liberation - Clear As Day, Lucilla grants the following enhancements based on her Resonance Mode:
- When in Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe, gain 4 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=0} of Film Roll for 30s, stacking up to 4 times. All stacks are removed when the duration ends.
- When in Resonance Mode - Echo, gain 1 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=6} of Zoom for 30s. Max 1 stack, which is removed when the duration ends.
The above effects end early when Lucilla switches Resonance Mode.

Film Roll
When an active Resonator in the team other than Lucilla inflicts Glacio Chafe onto the target, Lucilla consumes 1 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=3} of Film Roll to inflict Glacio Chafe 2 {Cus:Sap,S=time P=times SapTag=4} on nearby targets. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s.

Zoom
Each stack of Zoom increases the Crit. DMG of the active Resonator's Echo Skill by 10%.

Oblivion
During Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 3, Lucilla consumes 1 Photo intermittently to perform Oblivion, dealing 1 instance of Glacio DMG:
- When in Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe, this instance of DMG is considered Basic Attack DMG. The skill inflicts 1 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=B} of Glacio Chafe on the target.
- When in Resonance Mode - Echo, this instance of DMG is considered Echo Skill DMG. Each cast of Oblivion is considered as casting a different Echo Skill.

Quick Glance
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Aim to enter the camera mode. During this mode, Reverberations, environmental collectibles, and special collectibles within a certain range of Lucilla's shot will be marked. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} the shutter button to capture the moment, and the marked items will be gathered.

Trace
Lucilla can hold up to 150 points of Trace.
Restore 100 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=C} of Trace while casting Intro Skill - Clip It.
Restore 50 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=D} of Trace while casting Resonance Skill - Spotlight.
Restore 50 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=D} of Trace while casting Basic Attack Stage 3 - Commendable.
Restore 25 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=E} of Trace while casting Resonance Skill - Compensate or Basic Attack Stage 3 - Unremarkable.

Photos
Lucilla can hold up to 3 Photos.
Every 50 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=F} of Trace restored generates 1 Photo.

skills.name: 巧手烹调
skills.desc: 当前角色烹饪时有概率产出特色料理
skills.descEn: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.

skills.name: 蒙太奇
skills.desc:
处于共鸣模态·霜渐时，队伍中登场角色一定范围内的目标受到【霜渐效应】的伤害加深60%，持续30秒。
洛瑟菈切换模态时，该效果提前结束。

处于共鸣模态·声骸时，下一个登场角色声骸技能伤害加深50%，持续14秒。
切换至其他角色或洛瑟菈切换模态时，该效果提前结束。
skills.descEn:
When in Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe, Glacio Chafe DMG against targets within a certain range around the active Resonator is Amplified by 60% for 30s.
This effect ends when Lucilla switches Resonance Modes.

When in Resonance Mode - Echo, grant 50% Echo Skill DMG Amplification to the incoming Resonator for 14s.
This effect ends when the incoming Resonator is switched off the field or when Lucilla switches Resonance Modes.

skills.name: 谐度破坏·音感仪
skills.desc: 目标【偏谐值】满时，可对其施放【谐度破坏】。
skills.descEn: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.

energy.note: no resonance-energy cost (EnergyMax=0, liberation uses a character-specific resource)

inherents.name: 慢镜头
inherents.desc:
洛瑟菈展开聚焦环期间，减缓拍摄范围内目标的时间流速。
施放共鸣技能·追光时，洛瑟菈将根据共鸣模态提供不同的强化效果：
·处于共鸣模态·霜渐时，队伍中登场角色一定范围内的目标冷凝抗性降低8%，持续30秒。期间敌人被【霜渐效应】的伤害击败，本次击败将视为距离其最近的登场角色造成。
·处于共鸣模态·声骸时，队伍中的角色声骸技能伤害加成提升25%，持续30秒。
洛瑟菈切换模态时，上述效果提前结束。

inherents.name: 铭记
inherents.desc:
胶卷的可叠加层数上限增加至10层，变焦的可叠加层数上限增加至4层。
洛瑟菈每次消耗【照片】时，若处于共鸣模态·霜渐/共鸣模态·声骸，获得2层胶卷/1层变焦。

chains.name: 遥远的晌午
chains.desc:
施放共鸣技能·幻象定帧展开聚焦环期间，指针首次进入完美焦距时将立即使完美焦距充满聚焦环。
施放共鸣技能·追光时，洛瑟菈的暴击提升20%，持续10秒。
共鸣技能·幻象定帧、普攻·溯念留形第3段免疫打断。
chains.descEn:
While casting Resonance Skill - Phantom Frame to deploy Focus Ring, the first time landing the cursor within Perfect Focus will immediately expand Perfect Focus to fill up Focus Ring. 
Lucilla's Crit. Rate increases by 20% for 10s when Resonance Skill - Spotlight is cast.
Lucilla is immune to interruptions while casting Resonance Skill - Phantom Frame and Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 3.

chains.name: 酣睡的月光
chains.desc:
施放共鸣解放·历历在目时，洛瑟菈将根据共鸣模态提供额外的强化效果：
·处于共鸣模态·霜渐时，队伍中登场角色一定范围内的目标受到【霜渐效应】的伤害加深80%。
·处于共鸣模态·声骸时，队伍中角色的声骸技能伤害加成提升40%。
追忆状态持续期间，上述效果持续存在。退出追忆状态后，上述效果保留30秒。
洛瑟菈切换模态时，上述效果提前结束。
chains.descEn:
While casting Resonance Liberation - Clear As Day, Lucilla grants the following enhancements based on her Resonance Mode:
- When in Resonance Mode - Glacio Chafe, Glacio Chafe DMG against targets within a certain range around the active Resonator is Amplified by 80%.
- When in Resonance Mode - Echo, grant 40% Echo Skill DMG Bonus to Resonators in the team.
These enhancements last as long as Reminiscence is active and remain effective for 30s after Reminiscence ends.
These effects end when Lucilla switches Resonance Modes.

chains.name: 时间自无声处消逝
chains.desc: 断舍离的伤害倍率提升100%。
chains.descEn: The DMG Multiplier of Letting It Go is increased by 100%.

chains.name: 过去悄然沉默
chains.desc:
遗忘命中将牵引周围的目标。施放遗忘时，洛瑟菈的攻击提升10%，可叠加3层，持续6秒，持续时间结束清除全部层数。
施放普攻·溯念留形第3段时，洛瑟菈受到的伤害降低30%。
chains.descEn:
Oblivion pulls in nearby targets on hit. While casting Oblivion, Lucilla's ATK is increased by 10% for 6s, stacking up 3 times. All stacks are removed when the duration ends.
While casting Basic Attack - Tracing Forms Stage 3, Lucilla takes 30% less DMG.

chains.name: 岁月如溪水
chains.desc: 遗忘的伤害倍率提升50%。
chains.descEn: The DMG Multiplier of Oblivion is increased by 50%.

chains.name: 在如烟的时间里张望
chains.nameEn: Gazing In the Mist of Time
chains.desc:
追忆状态持续期间，洛瑟菈每次消耗【照片】将获得1层铭记，可叠加3层。每层铭记使断舍离造成的伤害提升200%，至多提升600%。施放断舍离后清除全部的铭记层数。
若洛瑟菈在追忆状态持续期间击败了任意目标，将获得怀恋：退出追忆状态且处于非战斗状态时，消耗怀恋，洛瑟菈回复150点【印象】。
chains.descEn:
When in Reminiscence, each time Lucilla consumes Photo, she gains 1 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=0} of Remembrance, stacking up to 3 times. Each stack of Remembrance increases Letting It Go's DMG dealt to the target by 200%, up to 600%. Casting Letting It Go removes all stacks of Remembrance.
Lucilla gains Longing if she has defeated a target while in Reminiscence: Upon ending Reminiscence while not in combat, consume Longing to restore 150 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=4} of Trace.

skills.name: 解春风
skills.desc:
普攻·浣尘时
连续短按或按住普攻，进行最多4段的连续攻击，造成冷凝伤害，命中目标时，回复【水云息】。

空中攻击·浣尘时
消耗耐力进行空中下落攻击，造成冷凝伤害。

闪避反击·浣尘时
成功闪避后一定时间内短按普攻，将会攻击目标，造成冷凝伤害，命中目标时，回复【水云息】。
施放该技能后在一定时间内短按普攻，将会施放普攻·浣尘时第4段。
skills.descEn:
Basic Attack - Zephyr Stance

Mid-air Attack - Zephyr Stance
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing Glacio DMG.

Dodge Counter - Zephyr Stance
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG and restoring Cloud Breath on hit.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to perform Basic Attack - Zephyr Stance Stage 4.

skills.name: 翠落画屏
skills.desc:
共鸣技能·浣尘时
浣尘时期间，【水云息】没满时，短按共鸣技能施放。穗穗向前突进，造成冷凝伤害。施放期间，若穗穗为队伍中登场角色，则回复【水云息】。
可在低空中施放。
该技能与共鸣技能·濯雨时共享冷却时间。

醒春潮
浣尘时期间，【水云息】满时，共鸣技能·浣尘时替换为醒春潮。施放时，消耗所有【水云息】，牵引周围的目标，进入濯雨时，造成冷凝伤害，为命中的目标附加1次【霜渐效应】。

润物
施放醒春潮和变奏技能·泠泠漱玉声时，使附近队伍中所有角色获得1层润物，每25秒最多触发1次。角色登场时，会消耗润物，使穗穗为其回复生命值。

共鸣技能·濯雨时
濯雨时期间，共鸣技能·浣尘时替换为共鸣技能·濯雨时。
短按共鸣技能施放。穗穗向前突进，造成冷凝伤害。施放期间，若穗穗为队伍中登场角色，则回复【芳菲信】。
可在低空中施放。
该技能与共鸣技能·浣尘时共享冷却时间。
skills.descEn:
Resonance Skill - Zephyr Stance
While in Zephyr Stance and Cloud Breath is not full, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Skill to have Suisui thrust forward, dealing Glacio DMG. If Suisui is the active Resonator while casting the skill, restore Cloud Breath.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
This skill shares a Cooldown with Resonance Skill - Drizzle Stance.

Awakening Spring
While in Zephyr Stance and at full Cloud Breath, Resonance Skill - Zephyr Stance is replaced with Awakening Spring. Casting this skill consumes all Cloud Breath, pulls in nearby targets, and sends Suisui into Drizzle Stance, dealing Glacio DMG and inflicting Glacio Chafe on the target 1 time on hit.

Enrichment
Casting Awakening Spring or Intro Skill - Tinkling Jade grants all nearby Resonators in the team 1 stack of Enrichment. This effect can be triggered once every 25s. Incoming Resonators receive healing from Suisui at the cost of Enrichment.

Resonance Skill - Drizzle Stance
While in Drizzle Stance, Resonance Skill - Zephyr Stance is replaced with Resonance Skill - Drizzle Stance.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Resonance Skill to have Suisui thrust forward, dealing Glacio DMG. If Suisui is the active Resonator while casting the skill, restore Floral Epistle.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
This skill shares a Cooldown with Resonance Skill - Zephyr Stance.

skills.name: 康衢之谣
skills.desc:
施放时，在场上展开山河水境，持续30秒。山河水境存在期间，穗穗施放延奏技能·渌水盈盈时，会进入仙游碧落状态。
山河水境内附近队伍中所有角色获得以下效果：
·为目标附加【光噪效应】、【聚爆效应】、【霜渐效应】、【风蚀效应】，或造成对应异常效应伤害后，使目标对应的【异常效应】层数上限增加3层，持续15秒，该效果无法叠加。
·为目标附加【电磁效应】，或造成对应异常效应伤害后，使目标【电磁效应】和【电磁爆发】的层数上限增加3层，持续15秒，该效果无法叠加。
·消耗目标【虚湮效应】层数后，使自身造成的湮灭伤害无视目标6%防御，且无视目标12%湮灭抗性，持续30秒，该效果无法叠加。
可在低空中施放。
skills.descEn:
Casting the skill deploys Ceaseless Landscape that lasts for 30s. When Ceaseless Landscape is active, Suisui enters the Roaming Transcendent state when casting Outro Skill - Rippling Waters.
Ceaseless Landscape grants all nearby Resonators in the team the following enhancements:
- Inflicting a target with Spectro Frazzle, Fusion Burst, Glacio Chafe, and Aero Erosion, or dealing the corresponding Negative Status DMG increases the max stack limit of the corresponding Negative Status the target can receive by 3 for 15s. This effect does not stack.
- Inflicting a target with Electro Flare or dealing the corresponding Negative Status DMG increases the max stack limits of Electro Flare and Electro Rage the target can receive by 3 for 15s. This effect does not stack.
- Consuming Havoc Bane stacks on the target after landing a skill allows the Resonator's Havoc DMG to ignore the target's DEF by 6% and Havoc RES by 12% for 30s. This effect does not stack.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

skills.name: 近水纳天光
skills.desc:
润物被消耗时，该角色还会获得10层春生，上限10层。拥有春生的角色如果当前生命值未达生命上限，则每2秒消耗1层春生，穗穗为其回复62+0.34%穗穗生命上限的生命值。

共鸣技能·醒春潮和变奏技能·泠泠漱玉声命中目标时，额外回复18点协奏和13点共鸣能量，并使该次攻击的暴击率提升80%，造成的冷凝伤害提升240%。每25秒最多触发1次。
skills.descEn:
Consuming Enrichment grants the Resonator 10 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=0} of Spring's Birth, up to 10 stacks. When the Resonator with Spring's Birth is not at full HP, restore their HP by 62 + 0.34% of Suisui's Max HP at the cost of 1 stack of Spring's Birth every 2s.

When Resonance Skill - Awakening Spring and Intro Skill - Tinkling Jade hit a target, they additionally restore 18 points of Concerto Energy and 13 points of Resonance Energy, and increase the attack's Crit. Rate by 80% and Glacio DMG by 240%. This effect can be triggered up to once every 25s.

skills.name: 浮光跃金处
skills.desc: 队伍中有穗穗以外的角色受到致死伤害时，此次伤害不会使该角色倒下并获得穗穗当前50%生命值，穗穗扣除等量生命值。穗穗最少保留1点生命值。该效果每10分钟可触发一次。
skills.descEn: When a Resonator other than Suisui takes a fatal blow, they will not be knocked out but will instead regain 50% of Suisui's current HP, while Suisui herself loses the same amount of HP. Suisui's HP will not go below 1 from this effect. This effect can be triggered once every 10 {Cus:Sap,S=minute P=minutes SapTag=2}.

skills.name: 泠泠漱玉声
skills.desc:
攻击目标，造成冷凝伤害，为命中的目标附加1次【霜渐效应】。
施放时，消耗所有【水云息】，牵引周围的目标，进入濯雨时。
skills.descEn:
Attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG, and inflict Glacio Chafe 1 time on the target.
While casting this skill, consume all Cloud Breath to pull in nearby targets and enter Drizzle Stance.

skills.name: 穗摇金
skills.desc:
浣尘时
穗穗初始处于浣尘时，浣尘时期间，可通过特定技能回复【水云息】。

濯雨时
进入濯雨时时，清除所有【芳菲信】。
濯雨时期间：
·解锁全新的战斗形态，可通过特定技能回复【芳菲信】。
·穗穗的抗打断提升。
·穗穗施放闪避技能触发成功闪避后的一定时间内，短按普攻，会施放普攻·濯雨时第一段。
进入濯雨时15秒后，退出濯雨时，退出时，清除所有【芳菲信】。

闪避·拨云雾见
地面攻击动作期间，短按闪避，会消耗耐力，施放闪避·拨云雾见。
浣尘时期间，施放闪避·拨云雾见触发成功闪避时，回复【水云息】，且一定时间内短按普攻，将会施放闪避反击·浣尘时。
濯雨时期间，施放闪避·拨云雾见触发成功闪避时，回复【芳菲信】，且一定时间内不会重置普攻·濯雨时连段。

普攻·濯雨时
濯雨时期间，普攻·浣尘时替换为普攻·濯雨时。
连续短按普攻，进行最多4段的连续攻击，造成冷凝伤害，命中目标时，回复【芳菲信】。
施放普攻·濯雨时第3段期间，持续牵引周围的目标。
普攻·濯雨时第4段会为命中的目标附加1次【霜渐效应】。

重击·濯雨时
消耗耐力，造成冷凝伤害，命中目标时，回复【芳菲信】。

重明枕露
濯雨时期间，施放重击·濯雨时后，保持按住普攻施放。
消耗耐力进行空中下落攻击，造成冷凝伤害。

飞燕裁风
濯雨时期间，可通过以下方式施放：
·施放重击·濯雨时期间，松开普攻施放。
·穗穗处于空中时，短按普攻施放。
消耗耐力进行空中下落攻击，造成冷凝伤害。

【水云息】获取规则
上限120点。
浣尘时期间：
·普攻·浣尘时、闪避反击·浣尘时命中目标时，回复【水云息】。
·施放共鸣技能·浣尘时期间为队伍中登场角色时，回复40点【水云息】。
·施放闪避·拨云雾见触发成功闪避时，回复35点【水云息】。

【芳菲信】获取规则
上限600点。
濯雨时期间：
·普攻·濯雨时、重击·濯雨时命中目标时，回复【芳菲信】。
·施放共鸣技能·濯雨时期间为队伍中登场角色时，回复100点【芳菲信】。
·施放闪避·拨云雾见触发成功闪避时，回复102点【芳菲信】。
skills.descEn:
Zephyr Stance
Suisui is in Zephyr Stance by default. When in Zephyr Stance, Suisui can obtain Cloud Breath through certain skills.

Drizzle Stance
Entering Drizzle Stance clears all Floral Epistle.
During Drizzle Stance:
- Suisui unlocks new combat moves and restores Floral Epistle through certain skills.
-Suisui gains increased resistance to interruption.
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack within a certain time after triggering a successful Dodge via Dodge skills to cast Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance Stage 1.
After entering Drizzle Stance for 15s, Suisui ends Drizzle Stance and clears all Floral Epistle upon exiting the state.

Dodge - Parting Mist
While performing attacks on the ground, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Dodge to cast Dodge - Parting Mist at the cost of STA.
When in Zephyr Stance, triggering a successful Dodge while casting Dodge - Parting Mist restores Cloud Breath. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after triggering the Dodge to cast Dodge Counter - Zephyr Stance.
- When in Drizzle Stance, triggering a successful Dodge while casting Dodge - Parting Mist restores Floral Epistle, and does not reset the cycle of Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance within a certain period.

Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance
When in Drizzle Stance, Basic Attack - Zephyr Stance is replaced with Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack repeatedly to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Glacio DMG and restoring Floral Epistle on hit.
When casting Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance Stage 3,  continuously pull in nearby targets.
Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance Stage 4 inflicts Glacio Chafe 1 time on the target on hit.

Heavy Attack - Drizzle Stance
Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Glacio DMG and restoring Floral Epistle on hit.

Illuminating Dew
When in Drizzle Stance, keep holding Normal Attack after casting Heavy Attack - Drizzle Stance to cast this skill.
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing Glacio DMG.

Swallow's Cut
When in Drizzle Stance, cast this skill in one of the following ways:
- Release the Normal Attack button while casting Heavy Attack - Drizzle Stance.
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack while Suisui is mid-air.
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing Glacio DMG.

Cloud Breath
Max 120 points.
When in Zephyr Stance: 
- Basic Attack - Zephyr Stance and Dodge Counter - Zephyr Stance restore Cloud Breath on hit.
- Casting Resonance Skill - Zephyr Stance restores 40 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=1} of Cloud Breath when Suisui is the active Resonator in the team.
- Triggering a successful Dodge while casting Dodge - Parting Mist restores 35 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=2} of Cloud Breath.

Floral Epistle
Max 600 points.
When in Drizzle Stance:
- Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance and Heavy Attack - Drizzle Stance restore Floral Epistle on hit.
- Casting Resonance Skill - Drizzle Stance restores 100 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=4} of Floral Epistle when Suisui is the active Resonator in the team.
- Triggering a successful Dodge while casting Dodge - Parting Mist restores 102 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=5} of Floral Epistle.

skills.name: 渌水盈盈
skills.desc:
队伍中的角色全伤害加深25%，持续30秒。

施放时，若当前场上存在山河水境，则穗穗进入仙游碧落状态。
施放时，退出濯雨时，并消耗所有【芳菲信】，且根据消耗的【芳菲信】解锁以下效果：

消耗至少0点【芳菲信】：
·附近队伍中所有角色获得6秒的重明照影。持有重明照影的角色抗打断提升。

消耗至少200点【芳菲信】：
·山河水境存在时，仙游碧落状态下，飞仙演舞一定时间后会进行第1次翾舞。

消耗至少400点【芳菲信】：
·本次仙游碧落状态期间，山河水境内登场角色获得额外效果：若持有重明照影，则造成的伤害提升：穗穗自身共鸣效率大于200%时，每超过1%的共鸣效率计算为0.2%的伤害提升，上限12%。
·山河水境存在时，仙游碧落状态下，飞仙演舞一定时间后会进行第2次翾舞。

消耗至少600点【芳菲信】：
·第1次翾舞时，山河水境内附近队伍中登场角色在穗穗本次仙游碧落期间获得额外效果：下一次施放延奏技能时，穗穗使下一个登场角色获得烟岚，持续14秒。持有烟岚的角色消耗目标【异常效应】或【电磁爆发】层数后，攻击提升：穗穗自身共鸣效率大于200%时，每超过0.12%的共鸣效率计算为0.1%的攻击提升，上限50%，持续6秒，烟岚被移除时移除攻击提升效果，若切换至其他角色则提前移除烟岚。
·山河水境存在时，仙游碧落状态下，飞仙演舞一定时间后会进行第3次翾舞。

仙游碧落
持续30秒。
仙游碧落状态期间，穗穗不是队伍中登场角色时，会依附于山河水境之上进行飞仙演舞，并根据施放延奏技能·渌水盈盈时消耗的【芳菲信】，每隔一定时间进行一次翾舞。
穗穗为队伍中登场角色时，暂停飞仙演舞。
山河水境不存在时，退出仙游碧落状态。

翾舞
每次进行翾舞时，使附近队伍中所有角色获得6秒的重明照影，为山河水境内敌方目标附加一层【霜渐效应】，为山河水境内附近队伍中登场角色回复生命值。
skills.descEn:
Resonators in the team gain 25% All DMG Amplification for 30s.

Suisui enters Roaming Transcendent when Ceaseless Landscape is active.
Suisui exits Drizzle Stance and consumes all Floral Epistle and unlocks the following effects based on the amount of Floral Epistle consumed:

0 Floral Epistle consumed:
- All nearby Resonators in the team gain Reflecting Shadows for 6s. Resonators with Reflecting Shadows have increased resistance to interruption.

At least 200 Floral Epistle consumed:
- If Ceaseless Landscape is active, Suisui may perform Plume Step for the first time within a certain time into her Transcendent Dance while in Roaming Transcendent.

At least 400 Floral Epistle consumed:
- During this Roaming Transcendent state, the active Resonator within the Ceaseless Landscape deals more DMG if they have Reflecting Shadows. For every 1% of Suisui's Energy Regen over 200%, the Resonator deals 0.2% more DMG, up to 12%.
- If Ceaseless Landscape is active, Suisui may perform the second Plume Step within a certain time into her Transcendent Dance while in Roaming Transcendent.

At least 600 Floral Epistle consumed:
- When Suisui performs the first Plume Step, all nearby active Resonators in the team within the Ceaseless Landscape gain the following effects for the duration of this Roaming Transcendent:
- When they cast Outro Skill, Suisui grants the incoming Resonator Undulating Mist. When Resonators with Undulating Mist consume Negative Status or Electro Rage stacks on the target, they gain an ATK increase: For every 0.12% of Suisui's Energy Regen over 200%, the Resonator's ATK is increased by 0.1% for 6s, up to 50%. Undulating Mist lasts for 14s or until the Resonator is switched off the field. When Undulating Mist is removed, the ATK increase effect is also removed.
- If Ceaseless Landscape is active, Suisui may perform the third Plume Step within a certain time into her Transcendent Dance while in Roaming Transcendent.

Roaming Transcendent
Lasts for 30s.
During Roaming Transcendent, Suisui will merge with Ceaseless Landscape and start a Transcendent Dance, during which she will perform Plume Steps at intervals based on the amount of Floral Epistle consumed when Outro Skill - Rippling Waters is cast.
When Suisui is the active Resonator in the team, she stops the Transcendent Dance.
When Ceaseless Landscape isn't active, she will exit the Roaming Transcendent state.

Plume Step
Performing Plume Step grants Reflecting Shadows to all nearby Resonators in the team for 6s, inflicts 1 stack of Glacio Chafe on all enemies within the Ceaseless Landscape, and heals the nearby active Resonators in the team within the Ceaseless Landscape.

skills.name: 谐度破坏·音感仪
skills.desc: 目标【偏谐值】满时，可对其施放【谐度破坏】。
skills.descEn: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.

inherents.name: 近水纳天光
inherents.desc:
润物被消耗时，该角色还会获得10层春生，上限10层。拥有春生的角色如果当前生命值未达生命上限，则每2秒消耗1层春生，穗穗为其回复62+0.34%穗穗生命上限的生命值。

共鸣技能·醒春潮和变奏技能·泠泠漱玉声命中目标时，额外回复18点协奏和13点共鸣能量，并使该次攻击的暴击率提升80%，造成的冷凝伤害提升240%。每25秒最多触发1次。

inherents.name: 浮光跃金处
inherents.desc: 队伍中有穗穗以外的角色受到致死伤害时，此次伤害不会使该角色倒下并获得穗穗当前50%生命值，穗穗扣除等量生命值。穗穗最少保留1点生命值。该效果每10分钟可触发一次。

chains.name: 雨洗千山皆入画
chains.desc:
持有烟岚的角色为目标附加【异常效应】或造成异常效应伤害后，也可以触发攻击提升效果。
第3次翾舞的时候获得的重明照影的时间提升100%。
普攻·濯雨时、重击·濯雨时、下落攻击·重明枕露和下落攻击·飞燕裁风免疫打断。
chains.descEn:
Resonators with Undulating Mist also gain ATK increase after inflicting Negative Status or dealing Negative Status DMG.
The duration of Reflecting Shadows obtained through the third Plume Step is extended by 100%.
Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance, Heavy Attack - Drizzle Stance, Plunging Attack - Illuminating Dew and Plunging Attack - Swallow's Cut are immune to interruption.

chains.name: 霞铺万顷欲流金
chains.desc:
山河水境内附近队伍中所有角色触发以下效果后，使触发效果的角色暴击伤害提升50%，持续30秒：
·为目标附加【光噪效应】、【聚爆效应】、【霜渐效应】、【风蚀效应】、【电磁效应】，或造成对应异常效应伤害。
·消耗目标【虚湮效应】层数。
队伍中登场角色不处于山河水境内时，该暴击伤害提升效果暂时失效。
chains.descEn:
All nearby Resonators in the team within the Ceaseless Landscape have their Crit. DMG increased by 50% for 30s after performing the following actions:
- Inflicting Spectro Frazzle, Fusion Burst, Glacio Chafe, Aero Erosion, and Electro Flare, or dealing the corresponding Negative Status DMG.
- Consuming Havoc Bane stacks on the target.
When the active Resonator is not in the Ceaseless Landscape, this Crit. DMG bonus effect is disabled.

chains.name: 半卷疏帘邀晚照
chains.desc:
施放共鸣技能·濯雨时后的一定时间内，短按普攻，将会施放普攻·濯雨时第4段。

施放共鸣技能·濯雨时时，获得点翠，切换至其他角色时移除。施放普攻·濯雨时第4段时，会消耗点翠，回复自身20点协奏，并回复350点【芳菲信】。每25秒最多消耗1次点翠。
chains.descEn:
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting Resonance Skill - Drizzle Stance to cast Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance Stage 4.

Casting Resonance Skill - Drizzle Stance grants Kingfisher. Switching to another Resonator ends this effect. Casting Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance Stage 4 consumes Kingfisher to restore 20 points of Concerto Energy and 350 points of Floral Epistle. Kingfisher can be consumed up to once every 25s.

chains.name: 一桁秋山共我吟
chains.desc: 润物和春生造成的治疗量提升50%。
chains.descEn: Healing provided by Enrichment and  Spring's Birth are increased by 50%.

chains.name: 愿乘东风千万里
chains.nameEn: I Long To Ride The Eastern Wind
chains.desc: 普攻·濯雨时和重击·濯雨时的伤害倍率提升100%。
chains.descEn: The DMG Multipliers of Basic Attack - Drizzle Stance and Heavy Attack - Drizzle Stance are increased by 100%.

chains.name: 不负江山锦绣心
chains.nameEn: Staying True To This Splendid Realm
chains.desc: 变奏技能·泠泠漱玉声和共鸣技能·醒春潮的暴击伤害提升500%。
chains.descEn: The Crit. DMG of Intro Skill - Tinkling Jade and Resonance Skill - Awakening Spring is increased by 500%.

skills.name: 砰砰
skills.desc:

进行最多4段连续射击，造成热熔伤害。
 
重击
进入瞄准状态，可以进行更强力的射击。
蓄力完成后攻击目标，造成热熔伤害。
 
空中攻击
消耗耐力，在空中进行连续攻击，造成热熔伤害。
 
闪避反击
成功闪避后一定时间内短按普攻，将会攻击目标，造成热熔伤害。
skills.descEn:
Basic Attack
Chixia fires up to 4 consecutive shots, dealing Fusion DMG.
 
Heavy Attack
Chixia enters the aiming state for a more powerful shot.
The aimed shot fired after charging finishes deals Fusion DMG.
 
Mid-air Attack
Chixia consumes STA to perform consecutive shots at the target in mid-air, dealing Fusion DMG.
 
Dodge Counter
Use Basic Attack after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Fusion DMG.

skills.descEn: Max Thermobaric Bullets is increased by 10 rounds. The damage of Resonance Skill Boom Boom is increased by 50%.

skills.desc: 共鸣技能咔咔压制持续期间，每发【热压弹】命中可使攻击提升1%，持续10秒，可叠加30层。
skills.descEn: Each Thermobaric Bullet that hits a target during Resonance Skill DAKA DAKA! increases ATK by 1% for 10s, stacking up to 30 times.

skills.name: 堂堂登场
skills.desc: 飒爽登场，对目标进行快速射击，造成热熔伤害。
skills.descEn: Chixia makes a heroic entrance and fires rapidly with her dual pistols at the target, dealing Fusion DMG.

skills.name: 英魂炽火流
skills.desc:
共鸣技能·咔咔压制
长按共鸣技能咻咻斗意，进入咔咔压制状态，在该状态下：
·持续消耗【热压弹】攻击目标，造成热熔伤害，此次伤害为共鸣技能伤害；
·短按普攻，将会施放第4段普攻攻击目标，造成热熔伤害，此次伤害为普攻伤害，并退出咔咔压制；
·若短按普攻时已消耗30发【热压弹】，将会施放共鸣技能轰轰，并退出咔咔压制；
·当【热压弹】消耗完毕后，退出咔咔压制。
 
共鸣技能·轰轰
造成热熔伤害，此次伤害为共鸣技能伤害。
 
热压弹获取规则
【热压弹】容量上限60发。
固有技能灼热弹匣可将【热压弹】容量上限扩充10发。
常态攻击砰砰命中目标时，可积攒【热压弹】。
施放变奏技能堂堂登场时，可积攒【热压弹】。
施放共鸣技能咻咻斗意时，可积攒【热压弹】。
skills.descEn:
Resonance Skill: DAKA DAKA!
Hold Resonance Skill Whizzing Fight Spirit to enter DAKA DAKA!. In this state:
- Chixia continuously consumes "Thermobaric Bullets" to attack the target, dealing Fusion DMG, considered as Resonance Skill DMG.
- Tap Basic Attack to cast Basic Attack 4, dealing Fusion DMG, considered as Basic Attack DMG. Then she exits the "DAKA DAKA!" state.
- If 30 "Thermobaric Bullets" have been fired when Basic Attack is activated, Chixia will cast Resonance Skill Boom Boom and exit "DAKA DAKA!" state.
- Chixia exits the "DAKA DAKA!" state when all "Thermobaric Bullets" are consumed.
 
Resonance Skill: Boom Boom
Deal Fusion DMG, considered as Resonance Skill DMG.
 
Thermobaric Bullets
Chixia can hold up to 60 "Thermobaric Bullets".
Inherent Skill Scorching Magazine increases Max "Thermobaric Bullets" by 10.
Chixia obtains "Thermobaric Bullets" for every Normal Attack POW POW on hit.
Chixia obtains "Thermobaric Bullets" upon casting Intro Skill Grand Entrance and Resonance Skill Whizzing Fight Spirit.

chains.name: 剧院的英雄戏
chains.desc: 施放共鸣技能轰轰时，必定暴击。
chains.descEn: Resonance Skill Boom Boom hits will always be Critical Hits.

chains.name: 跃动的火星
chains.desc: 施放共鸣解放炽烈焰火期间，每击败1个目标，回复5点共鸣能量，每次最多可回复20点。
chains.descEn: During Resonance Liberation Blazing Flames, for every 1 target defeated, Chixia recovers 5 Resonance Energy, up to 20 each time.

chains.desc: 共鸣解放炽烈焰火对生命值低于50%的目标，伤害提升40%。
chains.descEn: Resonance Liberation Blazing Flames deals 40% more DMG to targets whose HP is below 50%.

chains.name: 英雄的绝招
chains.desc: 施放共鸣解放炽烈焰火时，炽霞获得60发【热压弹】，并立即重置一次共鸣技能咻咻斗意的冷却时间。
chains.descEn: Resonance Liberation Blazing Flames grants 60 "Thermobaric Bullets" and immediately resets the Cooldown of Resonance Skill Whizzing Fight Spirit.

chains.name: 胜利的枪弹焰火
chains.desc: 固有技能加麻加辣叠加至满层时，攻击额外提升30%。
chains.descEn: When the Inherent Skill Numbingly Spicy! reaches max stacks, ATK is additionally increased by 30%.

chains.name: 剧终的回归彩蛋
chains.desc: 触发共鸣技能轰轰后，队伍中的角色普攻伤害加成提升25%，持续15秒。
chains.descEn: Resonance Skill Boom Boom increases the Basic Attack DMG Bonus of all team members by 25% for 15s.

skills.name: 羊咩出击
skills.desc:
普攻
进行最多4段的连续攻击，造成热熔伤害。
 
普攻·咩咩
在普攻第4段攻击后一定时间内短按普攻，将会攻击目标，造成热熔伤害。
 
重击
消耗耐力攻击目标，造成热熔伤害。
 
空中攻击
消耗耐力进行空中下落攻击，造成热熔伤害。
 
闪避反击
成功闪避后一定时间内短按普攻，将会攻击目标，造成热熔伤害。
skills.descEn:
Basic Attack
Encore performs up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Fusion DMG.
 
Basic Attack: Wooly Strike
After Basic Attack 4, press the Normal Attack button to attack the target, dealing Fusion DMG.
 
Heavy Attack
Encore consumes STA to attack the target, dealing Fusion DMG.
 
Mid-air Attack
Encore consumes STA to perform a Mid-Air Plunging Attack, dealing Fusion DMG.
 
Dodge Counter
Use Basic Attack after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Fusion DMG.

skills.name: 热力羊咩
skills.desc:
热力羊咩
召唤白咩与黑咩，以高温射线攻击目标，造成热熔伤害。
 
热情欢迎式
在施放热力羊咩后一定时间内，短按共鸣技能，将会施放热情欢迎式攻击目标，造成热熔伤害。
skills.descEn:
Flaming Woolies
Encore summons Cloudy and Cosmos to attack with burning rays, dealing Fusion DMG.
 
Energetic Welcome
After casting Flaming Woolies, use Resonance Skill to perform Energetic Welcome, dealing Fusion DMG.

params.label: 热力羊咩回复协奏能量
