skills.name: “天衣无缝”
skills.desc:
蚀域
施放共鸣解放帷幕终景·幻灭之形后，生成蚀域，持续30秒。自身生成的蚀域同时最多存在一个。
蚀域每4秒发动1次攻击，牵引周围的目标，对目标造成热熔伤害。该技能伤害为共鸣解放伤害。

【虚质粒子】
处于幻灭之形且【虚质粒子】大于0时，常态攻击命中目标，消耗【虚质粒子】，使本次技能获得以下效果：
·伤害为共鸣解放伤害，且伤害倍率提升50%。
·【共形能量】获取效率提升100%。

共鸣模态·聚爆
处于共鸣模态·聚爆时，获得以下效果：
·以下技能造成伤害时，可为目标附加2次【聚爆效应】，同一技能对同一目标2秒内只能触发1次。
变奏技能久疏问候！、变奏技能轻叩门扉、共鸣解放帷幕终景·布景之形、共鸣解放帷幕终景·幻灭之形、蚀域。
·以下技能造成伤害时，可为目标附加【聚爆效应】，同一技能对同一目标2秒内只能触发1次。
普攻·布景之形第3段、普攻·布景之形第4段、普攻·幻灭之形第3段、普攻·幻灭之形第4段、空中攻击·幻灭之形第3段、空中攻击·幻灭之形第4段。
·达妮娅处于编队时，敌人被【聚爆效应】的伤害击败，本次击败将视为距离其最近的登场角色造成。

共鸣模态·集谐
处于共鸣模态·集谐时，获得以下效果：
·以下技能造成伤害时，可为目标附加【集谐·偏移】，刷新目标【集谐·干涉】的持续时间，同一技能对同一目标2秒内只能触发1次。
变奏技能久疏问候！、变奏技能轻叩门扉、共鸣解放帷幕终景·布景之形、共鸣解放帷幕终景·幻灭之形、蚀域、普攻·布景之形第3段、普攻·布景之形第4段、普攻·幻灭之形第3段、普攻·幻灭之形第4段、空中攻击·幻灭之形第3段、空中攻击·幻灭之形第4段。
·队伍中的角色附加【集谐·偏移】时，目标将积累偏谐值上限50%的【偏谐值】，该效果对同一目标300秒内只能触发1次。

【黯核】获取规则
【黯核】上限3枚。
处于熵变强化时，每12秒获得1枚【黯核】。
施放变奏技能久疏问候！、变奏技能轻叩门扉获得1枚【黯核】。

【虚质粒子】获取规则
【虚质粒子】上限100点。
处于布景之形，常态攻击造成伤害时，获得【虚质粒子】。
施放变奏技能久疏问候！、变奏技能轻叩门扉、共鸣技能拟态泡泡·布景之形获得25点【虚质粒子】。

【共形能量】获取规则
【共形能量】上限100点。
处于幻灭之形，常态攻击、共鸣技能轻唤·幻灭之形造成伤害时，获得【共形能量】。
施放共鸣技能放逐·幻灭之形第2段获得40点【共形能量】。
skills.descEn:
Erosion Field
After casting Resonance Liberation Final Act - Breakdown Form, generate an Erosion Field, lasting for 30s. Only one Erosion Field generated by your own Resonator can exist at a time.
Erosion Field pulls in nearby targets once every 4s, dealing Fusion DMG, considered Resonance Liberation DMG.

Void Particle
When in the Breakdown Form while holding Void Particle, Normal Attack consumes Void Particle on hit and grants the following effects:
- The skill DMG is considered Resonance Liberation DMG and the DMG Multiplier is increased by 50%.
- Conformal Charge regenerates 100% faster.

Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst
While in Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst, Denia gains the following effects:
- Each time when the following skills deal damage, inflict 2 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=4} of Fusion Burst on the target. The same skill can only trigger this effect once every 2s against the same target.
Intro Skill It's Been A While!, Intro Skill Knock Knock, Resonance Liberation Final Act - Stagecraft Form, Resonance Liberation Final Act - Breakdown Form, and Erosion Field.
- Each time when the following skills deal damage, inflict Fusion Burst on the target. The same skill can only trigger this effect once every 2s against the same target.
Basic Attack - Stagecraft Form Stage 3, Basic Attack - Stagecraft Form Stage 4, Basic Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 3, Basic Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 4, Mid-air Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 3, and Mid-air Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 4.
- When Denia is in the team, if an enemy falls to Fusion Burst DMG, it counts as caused by the nearest active Resonator. 

Resonance Mode - Tune Strain
While in Resonance Mode - Tune Strain, Denia gains the following effects:
- Each time when the following skills deal damage, inflict Tune Strain - Shifting on the target and reset the duration of Tune Strain - Interfered on the target. The same skill can only trigger this effect once every 2s against the same target.
Intro Skill It's Been A While!, Intro Skill Knock Knock, Resonance Liberation Final Act - Stagecraft Form, Resonance Liberation Final Act - Breakdown Form, Erosion Field, Basic Attack - Stagecraft Form Stage 3, Basic Attack - Stagecraft Form Stage 4, Basic Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 3, Basic Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 4, Mid-air Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 3 and Mid-air Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 4.
- When Resonators in the team inflict Tune Strain - Shifting on the target, this target's Off-Tune Level is increased by 50% of the max. This effect can only be triggered on the same target once every 300s. 

Dark Core
- Denia can hold up to 3 Dark Cores.
- While in the Entropy Shift states,  Denia obtains 1 {Cus:Sap,S=Dark Core P=Dark Cores SapTag=A} every 12s.
Denia obtains 1 {Cus:Sap,S=Dark Core P=Dark Cores SapTag=B} upon casting Intro Skill It's Been A While! and Intro Skill Knock Knock.

Void Particle
- Denia can hold up to 100 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=C} of Void Particle.
- While in Stagecraft Form, dealing damage through Normal Attack grants Void Particle.
- Casting Intro Skill It's Been A While!, Intro Skill Knock Knock or Resonance Skill Phantom Bubble - Stagecraft Form grants 25 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=D} of Void Particle.

Conformal Charge
- Denia can hold up to 100 points of Conformal Charge.
- While in Breakdown Form, dealing damage through Normal Attack or Resonance Skill Beckon - Breakdown Form grants Conformal Charge.
- Casting Resonance Skill Banish - Breakdown Form Stage 2 grants 40 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=F} of Conformal Charge.

skills.name: 巧手烹调
skills.desc: 当前角色烹饪时有概率产出特色料理
skills.descEn: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.

skills.name: 未竟的谎言
skills.desc:
处于共鸣模态·聚爆时，队伍中登场角色周围的目标受到聚爆效应伤害加深60%，持续30秒。
达妮娅切换模态时，该效果提前结束。

处于共鸣模态·集谐时，下一个登场的角色全伤害加深15%，持续16秒。
效果持续期间，该角色附加【集谐·偏移】后，该全伤害加深效果提升至40%。
切换至其他角色或达妮娅切换模态时，该效果提前结束。
skills.descEn:
When in Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst, Fusion Burst DMG against targets near the active Resonator in the team is Amplified by 60% for 30s.
This effect ends early when Denia switches modes.

When in Resonance Mode - Tune Strain, the incoming Resonator has their All DMG Amplified by 15% for 16s.
After this Resonator under this effect inflicts Tune Strain - Shifting, they gain 40% DMG Amplification instead.
This effect ends early when this Resonator is switched out or when Denia switches modes.

skills.name: 计时的溃灭
skills.desc:
目标【偏谐值】满时，达妮娅可对其施放【谐度破坏】。

处于共鸣模态·集谐时，获得以下效果：
·达妮娅拥有为目标附加【集谐·偏移】的能力。
·达妮娅拥有响应【集谐·干涉】的能力。
响应【集谐·干涉】：目标每有一层【集谐·干涉】效果，达妮娅自身的每点谐度破坏增幅会使自身对该目标造成的最终伤害提升0.12%。达妮娅在编队中时，目标的【集谐·干涉】效果的层数上限增加1层。
skills.descEn:
When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, Denia can cast Tune Break on the target.

When in Resonance Mode - Tune Strain, Denia gains the following effects:
- Denia can inflict Tune Strain - Shifting on the target.
- Denia can respond to Tune Strain - Interfered.
When responding to Tune Strain - Interfered: For each stack of Tune Strain - Interfered on the target, each point of Denia's Tune Break Boost increases her total DMG against the target by 0.12%. While Denia is in the team, the max stack limit of Tune Strain - Interfered on a target is increased by 1.

inherents.name: 伪物弥留
inherents.desc: 处于布景之形进入战斗时，【黯核】不足2枚则回复至2枚，【虚质粒子】不足20点则回复至20点。该效果每12秒可触发1次。

inherents.name: 蚀刻繁彩
inherents.desc:
处于熵变强化时，根据共鸣模态获得以下效果：
·若处于共鸣模态·聚爆，队伍中的角色热熔伤害加成提升30%。
·若处于共鸣模态·集谐，队伍中的角色谐度破坏增幅提升10点。队伍中的角色偏谐值累积效率超过100%时，每超过10%的偏谐值累积效率使对应角色谐度破坏增幅提升8点，上限40点。

chains.name: 薄明梦中的寂静光辉
chains.nameEn: Silent Glows in a Dimlit Dream
chains.desc:
暴击伤害提升30%。

施放共鸣技能拟态泡泡·布景之形、共鸣技能放逐·幻灭之形、普攻·幻灭之形第3段、普攻·幻灭之形第4段、空中攻击·幻灭之形第3段、空中攻击·幻灭之形第4段期间，免疫打断。

处于布景之形进入战斗时，获得熵变强化·布景之形，持续30秒。
处于幻灭之形进入战斗时，获得熵变强化·幻灭之形，持续12秒。
chains.descEn:
Crit. DMG is increased by 30%.

When performing Resonance Skill Phantom Bubble - Stagecraft Form, or Resonance Skill Banish - Breakdown Form, Basic Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 3, Basic Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 4, Mid-air Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 3, and Mid-air Attack - Breakdown Form Stage 4,  Denia becomes immune to interruption.

When Denia enters combat in Stagecraft Form, she obtains the Entropy Shift: Stagecraft Form effect for 30s.
When Denia enters combat in Breakdown Form, she obtains the Entropy Shift: Breakdown Form effect for 12s.

chains.name: 坠入此世一片潮水
chains.nameEn: Tossed in the Tides of Reality
chains.desc:
处于共鸣模态·聚爆，队伍中的角色施加【聚爆效应】后，该角色热熔伤害加成提升50%，持续15秒。登场角色附近的敌人触发【聚爆效应】引爆后，达妮娅获得1层简并虚质，持续15秒，上限10层。每层简并虚质使达妮娅造成伤害无视目标1%热熔伤害抗性。
达妮娅切换模态时，该效果提前结束。

处于共鸣模态·集谐，共鸣回路效果提升：队伍中的角色施加【集谐·偏移】后，该角色谐度破坏增幅提升20点，持续15秒，目标将积累偏谐值上限100%的【偏谐值】，积累【偏谐值】效果对同一目标300秒内只能触发1次。
达妮娅切换模态时，该效果提前结束。

共鸣技能放逐·幻灭之形伤害倍率提升40%。
chains.descEn:
When Denia is in Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst, after a Resonator in the team inflicts Fusion Burst on the target, they gain 50% Fusion DMG Bonus for 15s. After Fusion Burst is triggered on enemies near the active Resonator in the team, Denia gains 1 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=2} of Degenerate Voidmatter for 15s, up to 10 stacks. Each stack of Degenerate Voidmatter causes Denia to ignore 1% of the target's Fusion RES.
This effect ends when Denia switches modes.

When Denia is in Resonance Mode - Tune Strain, her Forte Circuit effect is enhanced: After a Resonator in the team inflicts Tune Strain - Shifting on the target, their Tune Break Boost is increased by 20 for 15s, and the target's Off-Tune Level is increased by 100% of the max. This effect can only be triggered once per 300s on the same target.
This effect ends when Denia switches forms.

The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Skill Banish - Breakdown Form is increased by 40%.

chains.name: 黑夜与风中奔驰着赤杨
chains.nameEn: Through Dark and Wind, the Erlking Follows
chains.desc:
共鸣解放帷幕终景·幻灭之形伤害倍率提升80%。

【黯核】上限提升至5枚，处于熵变强化时，【黯核】的获取间隔缩短至6秒。
熵变强化·布景之形效果获得强化：每秒获得【虚质粒子】提升至4点。
熵变强化·幻灭之形效果获得强化：施放共鸣解放帷幕终景·幻灭之形时，额外回复30点协奏能量。

固有技能伪物弥留效果强化：
进入战斗时，【黯核】与【虚质粒子】回复至上限。该效果每12秒可触发1次。

【黯核】数量达到上限时，施放普攻·布景之形第4段、共鸣技能拟态泡泡·布景之形消耗所有【黯核】，使本次技能伤害倍率增加1200%，本次伤害为共鸣解放伤害。
chains.descEn:
The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation Final Act - Breakdown Form is increased by 80%.

Denia now holds up to 5 Dark Cores. While in Entropy Shift,  the shortest interval at which she can obtain Dark Core is reduced to 6s.
The Entropy Shift: Stagecraft Form effect is enhanced and now grants 4 points of Void Particle per second.
The Entropy Shift: Breakdown Form effect is enhanced: Casting Resonance Liberation Final Act - Breakdown Form additionally restores 30 points of Concerto Energy.

Denia's Inherent Skill Vestiges of Falsehood is enhanced:
Upon entering combat, Dark Core and Void Particle are restored to the max. This effect can be triggered once every 12s. 

When the number of Dark Cores reaches the limit, casting Basic Attack - Stagecraft Form Stage 4 or Resonance Skill Phantom Bubble - Stagecraft Form consumes all Dark Cores and increases the DMG Multiplier of this skill by 1200%. The DMG dealt is considered Resonance Liberation DMG.

chains.name: 从远方，回到远方
chains.nameEn: From the Far Beyond, to the Far Beyond
chains.desc: 蚀域攻击间隔缩短至3秒。
chains.descEn: The attack interval of Erosion Field is reduced to 3s.

chains.name: 若能以谎言缝补心脏
chains.nameEn: If Lies Patch Up a Heart
chains.desc: 共鸣解放帷幕终景·布景之形造成的伤害提升100%。
chains.descEn: The DMG of Resonance Liberation Final Act -  Stagecraft Form is increased by 100%.

chains.name: 祝愿你于静默中，得到太阳
chains.nameEn: May You Find Your Sun in the Silence
chains.desc:
处于熵变强化时，攻击提升60%，热熔伤害加成提升60%。

处于共鸣模态·聚爆时，蚀域对目标造成伤害后，根据【聚爆效应】层数上限引爆【聚爆效应】，本次引爆对【聚爆效应】主目标的伤害倍率提升200%，且不移除【聚爆效应】层数。同一目标最多可受到1次该效果，目标受到共鸣解放帷幕终景·幻灭之形的伤害后，重置该次数，重置效果对同一目标2秒内只能触发1次。

处于共鸣模态·集谐时，队伍中的角色对拥有【集谐·偏移】的【失谐】目标造成谐度破坏伤害时，将额外附加1层【集谐·干涉】，该效果对同一目标3秒内只能触发1次。
chains.descEn:
While in Entropy Shift states, gain 60% ATK increase and 60% Fusion DMG Bonus.

While Denia is in Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst,  after Erosion Field deals damage, trigger Fusion Burst on the target based on its max limit. The Fusion Burst DMG triggered gains a 200% DMG Multiplier increase against the main target and does not remove the Fusion Burst stacks on the targets hit. The effect can be triggered on the same target up to 1 {Cus:Sap,S=time P=times SapTag=3}. When the target is damaged by Resonance Liberation Final Act: Breakdown Form, the effect's trigger count is reset. The trigger count can be reset for the same target once every 2s.

While Denia is in Resonance Mode - Tune Strain, when Resonators in the team deal Tune Break DMG to Mistuned enemies in Tune Strain - Shifting, they additionally inflict 1 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=5} of Tune Strain - Interfered on the target. This effect can only be triggered on the same target once every 3s.

skills.name: 死生徘徊
skills.desc:
普攻·摄召
若景燃处于负阴状态，可进行最多4段连续攻击，造成热熔伤害。
施放普攻·摄召第3段时可获得50点【炁】，且此伤害为重击伤害。
施放普攻·摄召第4段时可获得50点【炁】，且此伤害为重击伤害。

普攻·灭煞
若景燃处于抱阳状态，可进行最多4段连续攻击，造成热熔伤害。
施放普攻·灭煞第3段时可获得50点【炁】，且此伤害为重击伤害。
施放普攻·灭煞第4段时可获得50点【炁】，且此伤害为重击伤害。

空中攻击
消耗耐力进行空中下落攻击，造成热熔伤害。
若景燃处于负阴状态，施放该技能后的一定时间内，按下普攻将会施放普攻·摄召第2段。
若景燃处于抱阳状态，施放该技能后的一定时间内，按下普攻将会施放普攻·灭煞第2段。

闪避反击·探幽
若景燃处于负阴状态，成功闪避后一定时间内按下普攻，将会攻击目标，造成热熔伤害。
施放闪避反击·探幽时可获得100点【炁】，且此伤害为重击伤害。
施放该技能后的一定时间内，按下普攻将会施放普攻·摄召第4段。

闪避反击·守明
若景燃处于抱阳状态，成功闪避后一定时间内按下普攻，将会攻击目标，造成热熔伤害。
施放闪避反击·守明时可获得100点【炁】，且此伤害为重击伤害。
施放该技能后的一定时间内，按下普攻将会施放普攻·灭煞第4段。

潜影
景燃处于战斗状态下，且在地面时，向前短按闪避可施放潜影，造成固定热熔伤害，此次伤害为普攻伤害，不受伤害加成影响，施放该技能一定时间内可以触发成功闪避。
若景燃处于负阴状态，施放该技能后的一定时间内，按下普攻将会施放普攻·摄召第2段。
若景燃处于抱阳状态，施放该技能后的一定时间内，按下普攻将会施放普攻·灭煞第2段。
skills.descEn:
Basic Attack - Drink Soul
While in the Yin Vessel state, perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Fusion DMG.
Casting Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 3 restores 50 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=0} of Qi, dealing Heavy Attack DMG.
Casting Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 4 restores 50 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=1} of Qi, dealing Heavy Attack DMG.

Basic Attack - Devil's Bane
While in the Yang Font state, perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Fusion DMG.
Casting Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 3 restores 50 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=2} of Qi, dealing Heavy Attack DMG.
Casting Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 4 restores 50 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=3} of Qi, dealing Heavy Attack DMG.

Mid-air Attack
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack in the air, dealing Fusion DMG.
While in the Yin Vessel state, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 2.
While in the Yang Font state, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 2.

Dodge Counter - Nether Dive
While in the Yin Vessel state, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} or hold Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Fusion DMG.
Casting Dodge Counter - Nether Dive restores 100 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=4} of Qi, dealing Heavy Attack DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 4.

Dodge Counter - Light Watch
While in the Yang Font state, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} or hold Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Fusion DMG.
Casting Dodge Counter - Light Watch restores 100 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=5} of Qi, dealing Heavy Attack DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 4.

Shadow Step
While in combat and on the ground, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Dodge with directional input to cast Shadow Step, dealing a fixed amount of Fusion DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG. This instance of damage is not affected by any DMG Bonus effects. A successful Dodge may be triggered within a certain time during the action of this skill.
While in the Yin Vessel state, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 2.
While in the Yang Font state, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 2.

skills.name: 撞煞
skills.desc:
共鸣技能·阴蚀骨
若景燃处于负阴状态，可施放共鸣技能·阴蚀骨，攻击目标，造成热熔伤害。
共鸣技能·阴蚀骨可在空中施放。

共鸣技能·阳焚身
若景燃处于抱阳状态，可施放共鸣技能·阳焚身，攻击目标，造成热熔伤害。
共鸣技能·阳焚身可在空中施放。

破秽
施放共鸣技能·阴蚀骨或共鸣技能·阳焚身时，获得破秽，持续4秒，满足下述条件之一时，破秽提前结束。
·切换至其他角色。
·切换至负阴状态或抱阳状态时。
·施放共鸣技能·黄泉渡或共鸣技能·往生送时。

共鸣技能·黄泉渡
若景燃处于负阴状态且持有破秽时，在空中按下普攻可施放共鸣技能·黄泉渡，攻击目标，造成热熔伤害，本次伤害为重击伤害。
施放共鸣技能·黄泉渡时可获得100点【炁】。
施放该技能后的一定时间内，按下普攻将会施放普攻·摄召第2段。

共鸣技能·往生送
若景燃处于抱阳状态且持有破秽时，在空中按下普攻可施放共鸣技能·往生送，攻击目标，造成热熔伤害，本次伤害为重击伤害。
施放共鸣技能·往生送时可获得100点【炁】。
施放该技能后的一定时间内，按下普攻将会施放普攻·灭煞第2段。
skills.descEn:
Resonance Skill - Encroaching Yin
While in the Yin Vessel state, Resonance Skill - Encroaching Yin is available, which deals Fusion DMG.
Resonance Skill - Encroaching Yin can be cast in mid-air.

Resonance Skill - Scorching Yang
While in the Yang Font state, Resonance Skill - Scorching Yang is available, which deals Fusion DMG.
Resonance Skill - Scorching Yang can be cast in mid-air.

Cleanse of Impurity
Casting Resonance Skill - Encroaching Yin or Resonance Skill - Scorching Yang grants Cleanse of Impurity for 4s or until one of the following conditions is met:
- Switching to another Resonator.
- Switching to the Yin Vessel or Yang Font state.
- Casting Resonance Skill - Netherworld Traverse or Resonance Skill - Afterlife's Guide.

Resonance Skill - Netherworld Traverse
While in the Yin Vessel state with Cleanse of Impurity, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} or hold Normal Attack in mid-air to cast Resonance Skill - Netherworld Traverse, dealing Fusion DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
Casting Resonance Skill - Netherworld Traverse restores 100 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=1} of Qi.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 2.

Resonance Skill - Afterlife's Guide
While in the Yang Font state with Cleanse of Impurity, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} or hold Normal Attack in mid-air to cast Resonance Skill - Afterlife's Guide, dealing Fusion DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
Casting Resonance Skill - Afterlife's Guide restores 100 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=2} of Qi.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 2.

skills.name: 万鬼同葬
skills.desc:
共鸣解放·万鬼同葬可在低空施放。
攻击目标，造成热熔伤害，本次伤害为重击伤害，施放时获得100点【命火】。
施放后获得下述效果。
·若景燃的当前生命值大于生命上限的50%，将当前生命值降至生命上限的50%。
·获得200点【炁】。
·获得3层行途。
·进入荧惑状态，持续15秒。

行途
行途上限为3层，施放重击·劫魄或重击·踏罡时，获得200点【炁】，并减少1层行途，持续15秒。

荧惑
·重击·劫魄或重击·踏罡造成伤害时景燃召唤魑魅魍魉进行攻击，造成热熔伤害，本次伤害为重击伤害。每次重击·劫魄或重击·踏罡仅可触发一次。
·荧惑状态结束时清空【命火】。
skills.descEn:
Resonance Liberation - Burial of Thousand Souls can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
Attack the target, dealing Fusion DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG, and granting 100 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=0} of Fire of Life.
Gain the following effects after casting this skill:
- If Jingran's current HP is above 50% of the Max HP, reduce his current HP to 50% of the Max HP.
- Gain 200 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=3} of Qi.
- Gain 3 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=4} of Wayfarer's Mark.
- Enter the Yinghuo state for 15s.

Wayfarer's Mark
Max 3 stacks.
Casting Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander restores 200 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=7} of Qi and reduces 1 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=8} of Wayfarer's Mark. This effect lasts for 15s.

Yinghuo
- Dealing damage with Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander summons Chimei Wangliang to attack the targets, which deals Fusion DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG. This effect can be triggered once per Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander.
- All Fire of Life will be removed as Yinghuo ends.

skills.name: 贴壁听尘
skills.desc:
施放变奏技能·挑灯问冢，共鸣技能·阴蚀骨或共鸣技能·阳焚身时可获得画地。

画地
15秒内，若景燃为队伍中登场角色，造成伤害时获得生命上限1.6%+700的护盾，不可叠加，持续5秒，每0.5秒可生效一次。该护盾在切换至其他角色时不会继承。
处于荧惑状态时，若景燃为队伍中登场角色，造成伤害时额外获得生命上限0.8%+350的护盾，不可叠加，持续5秒，每0.5秒可生效一次。该护盾在切换至其他角色时不会继承。
skills.descEn:
Casting Intro Skill - Question the Tombs, Resonance Skill - Encroaching Yin, or Resonance Skill - Scorching Yang grants Earth Charm.

Earth Charm
For 15s, if Jingran is the active Resonator in the team, gain an unstackable Shield equal to 1.6% of Max HP + 700 that lasts for 5s when dealing damage. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s. This Shield will not be passed on to the incoming Resonator.
While Jingran is in the Yinghuo state, if he is the active Resonator in the team, he gains an unstackable Shield equal to 0.8% of Max HP + 350 that lasts for 5s when dealing damage. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s. This Shield will not be passed on to the incoming Resonator.

skills.name: 扫痕观迹
skills.desc:
每次进入战斗时，若景燃持有的【鬼护】不足25点，补充至25点，每4秒可触发1次。

附近队伍中除景燃以外的角色获得护盾时，景燃获得2点【鬼护】，每0.5秒可触发一次。

敛神
·每次进入战斗时，景燃获得敛神，每4秒可触发1次。
·施放延奏技能·收山出煞时，景燃获得敛神。
·附近队伍中除景燃以外的角色获得护盾时，景燃获得15点【鬼护】，并移除敛神。
skills.descEn:
Upon entering combat, if Jingran's Ghost Shroud is below 25 points, restore it to 25 points. This effect can be triggered once every 4s.

When nearby Resonators in the team other than Jingran gain a Shield, Jingran gains 2 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=3} of Ghost Shroud. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s.

Fixation
- Upon entering combat, Jingran gains Fixation. This effect can be triggered once every 4s.
- Casting Outro Skill - Rising Fortune and Ebbing Evil grants Fixation.
- When nearby Resonators in the team other than Jingran gain a Shield, Jingran gains 15 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=6} of Ghost Shroud and removes Fixation.

skills.name: 挑灯问冢
skills.desc:
攻击目标，造成热熔伤害。消耗全部【鬼护】，并转化为相同层数的祸兮福兮。
施放变奏技能·挑灯问冢时可获得100点【炁】。
若景燃处于负阴状态，施放该技能后的一定时间内，按下普攻将会施放普攻·摄召第2段。
若景燃处于抱阳状态，施放该技能后的一定时间内，按下普攻将会施放普攻·灭煞第2段。

祸兮福兮
祸兮福兮上限为50层，每层祸兮福兮使得景燃基于生命上限获得额外热熔伤害加成提升：景燃每1000生命上限获得0.05%热熔伤害加成提升，每层最多以此方式使得景燃获得2.5%热熔伤害加成提升，持续15秒。
若切换至其他角色则该效果提前结束。

【鬼护】获取规则
·【鬼护】上限为50点。
·景燃获得护盾时，可获得1点【鬼护】，每0.5秒可生效一次。
skills.descEn:
Attack the target, dealing Fusion DMG. Consume and convert all Ghost Shroud to equal stacks of Fortune in Disguise.
Casting Question the Tombs restores 100 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=0} of Qi.
While in the Yin Vessel state, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 2.
While in the Yang Font state, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 2.

Fortune in Disguise
Max 50 stacks. Each stack of Fortune in Disguise grants additional Fusion DMG Bonus based on Jingran's Max HP: For every 1000 points of Max HP, Jingran gains 0.05% additional Fusion DMG Bonus for 15s, up to 2.5% for each stack of Fortune in Disguise.
Switching to another Resonator ends the effect.

Ghost Shroud
- Max 50 points.
- When Jingran gains a Shield, he gains 1 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=7} of Ghost Shroud. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s.

skills.name: 逆渡三途
skills.desc:
炁机斡旋
景燃施放重击·劫魄或重击·踏罡可以在负阴状态和抱阳状态之间切换，景燃初始处于抱阳状态。

重击·劫魄
若景燃拥有300点【炁】，且处于负阴状态，长按普攻消耗300点【炁】可施放重击·劫魄，造成热熔伤害。
施放重击·劫魄后切换至抱阳状态。
施放该技能后的一定时间内，按下普攻将会施放普攻·灭煞第2段。

重击·踏罡
若景燃拥有300点【炁】，且处于抱阳状态，长按普攻消耗300点【炁】可施放重击·踏罡，造成热熔伤害。
施放重击·踏罡后切换至负阴状态。
施放该技能后的一定时间内，按下普攻将会施放普攻·摄召第2段。
重击·踏罡可在空中施放。

【炁】获取规则
【炁】上限300点。
·施放普攻·摄召第3段、普攻·摄召第4段、普攻·灭煞第3段或普攻·灭煞第4段时，获得50点【炁】。
·施放闪避反击·探幽、闪避反击·守明、共鸣技能·黄泉渡、共鸣技能·往生送或变奏技能·挑灯问冢时，获得100点【炁】。
·施放共鸣解放·万鬼同葬或持有行途时施放重击·劫魄或重击·踏罡，获得200点【炁】。

【命火】获取规则
【命火】上限100点。
·施放共鸣解放·万鬼同葬时获得100点【命火】。
·荧惑状态结束时清空【命火】。
若景燃处于荧惑状态且景燃持有的【命火】不为0时，施放重击·劫魄或重击·踏罡时消耗25点【命火】，并使本次重击·劫魄或重击·踏罡的伤害倍率基于景燃生命上限增加：景燃自身生命上限大于25000点时，每超过1000点生命上限增加重击·劫魄或重击·踏罡伤害倍率，最多计入25000点生命上限。

幽而复明
·景燃的防御始终为0。
·景燃基于生命上限提升受到的治疗效果：景燃每1000点生命上限提升6.2%受到的治疗效果，上限310%。
·景燃基于生命上限获得热熔伤害加成提升：景燃每1000点生命上限获得1.5%热熔伤害加成提升，上限75%。

阳变阴合
景燃基于生命上限获得额外攻击：景燃每1000点生命上限获得36点攻击，上限1800。
skills.descEn:
Qi Modulation
Jingran switches between the Yin Vessel and Yang Font states by casting Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander. Jingran is in the Yang Font state by default.

Heavy Attack - Soul Raid
When Jingran holds 300 points of Qi while in the Yin Vessel state, hold Normal Attack to consume 300 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=1} of Qi to cast Heavy Attack - Soul Raid, dealing Fusion DMG.
After casting Heavy Attack - Soul Raid, Jingran switches to the Yang Font state.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 2.

Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander
When Jingran holds 300 points of Qi while in the Yang Font state, hold Normal Attack to consume 300 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=3} of Qi to cast Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander, dealing Fusion DMG.
After casting Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander, Jingran switches to the Yin Vessel state.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 2.
Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander can be cast in mid-air.

Qi
Max 300 points.
- Casting Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 3, Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 4, Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 3, or Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 4 restores 50 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=5} of Qi.
- Casting Dodge Counter - Nether Dive, Dodge Counter - Light Watch, Resonance Skill - Netherworld Traverse, Resonance Skill - Afterlife's Guide, or Intro Skill - Question the Tombs restores 100 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=6} of Qi.
- Casting Resonance Liberation - Burial of Thousand Souls or casting Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander with Wayfarer's Mark restores 200 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=7} of Qi.

Fire of Life
Max 100 points.
- Casting Resonance Liberation - Burial of Thousand Souls grants 100 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=9} of Fire of Life.
- All Fire of Life is cleared when Yinghuo ends.
While in Yinghuo, if Fire of Life is not at 0 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=A}, casting Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander consumes 25 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=B} of Fire of Life, and the DMG Multiplier of this Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander is increased based on Jingran's Max HP: The DMG Multiplier of this Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander is increased for every 1000 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=C} of Jingran's Max HP over 25000. Up to 25000 points of Jingran's Max HP count towards this effect.

Nether to Light
- Jingran's DEF is fixed at 0.
- Jingran gains Incoming Healing Bonus based on Max HP: For every 1000 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=D} of Max HP, Jingran receives 6.2% Incoming Healing Bonus, up to 310%.
- Jingran gains Fusion DMG Bonus based on Max HP: For every 1000 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=E} of Max HP, Jingran receives 1.5% Fusion DMG Bonus, up to 75%.

Yang Changes, Yin Unites
Jingran gains additional ATK based on Max HP: For every 1000 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=F} of Max HP, Jingran gains 36 additional ATK, up to 1800.

skills.descEn: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.

skills.name: 收山出煞
skills.desc: 造成景燃795%攻击的热熔伤害。
skills.descEn: Deal Fusion DMG equal to 795% of Jingran's ATK.

skills.name: 谐度破坏·长刃
skills.desc:
目标【偏谐值】满时，可对其施放【谐度破坏】。
若景燃处于负阴状态，施放该技能后的一定时间内，按下普攻将会施放普攻·摄召第2段。
若景燃处于抱阳状态，施放该技能后的一定时间内，按下普攻将会施放普攻·灭煞第2段。
skills.descEn:
When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.
While in Yin Vessel, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 2.
While in Yang Font, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 2.

inherents.name: 贴壁听尘
inherents.desc:
施放变奏技能·挑灯问冢，共鸣技能·阴蚀骨或共鸣技能·阳焚身时可获得画地。

画地
15秒内，若景燃为队伍中登场角色，造成伤害时获得生命上限1.6%+700的护盾，不可叠加，持续5秒，每0.5秒可生效一次。该护盾在切换至其他角色时不会继承。
处于荧惑状态时，若景燃为队伍中登场角色，造成伤害时额外获得生命上限0.8%+350的护盾，不可叠加，持续5秒，每0.5秒可生效一次。该护盾在切换至其他角色时不会继承。

inherents.name: 扫痕观迹
inherents.desc:
每次进入战斗时，若景燃持有的【鬼护】不足25点，补充至25点，每4秒可触发1次。

附近队伍中除景燃以外的角色获得护盾时，景燃获得2点【鬼护】，每0.5秒可触发一次。

敛神
·每次进入战斗时，景燃获得敛神，每4秒可触发1次。
·施放延奏技能·收山出煞时，景燃获得敛神。
·附近队伍中除景燃以外的角色获得护盾时，景燃获得15点【鬼护】，并移除敛神。

chains.name: 阴阳其和，终始其义
chains.nameEn: Yin and Yang in Harmony, the Ultimate Law of Being
chains.desc:
共鸣技能·阴蚀骨，共鸣技能·黄泉渡，共鸣技能·阳焚身，共鸣技能·往生送伤害倍率提升80%。
共鸣技能·阴蚀骨，共鸣技能·黄泉渡，共鸣技能·阳焚身，共鸣技能·往生送免疫打断。
chains.descEn:
The DMG Multipliers of Resonance Skill - Encroaching Yin, Resonance Skill - Netherworld Traverse, Resonance Skill - Scorching Yang, and Resonance Skill - Afterlife's Guide are increased by 80%.
Resonance Skill - Encroaching Yin, Resonance Skill - Netherworld Traverse, Resonance Skill - Scorching Yang, and Resonance Skill - Afterlife's Guide are now immune to interruption.

chains.name: 孤灯踩影，有迹山河
chains.nameEn: A Solitary Lantern, Across Lands Shade-Trodden
chains.desc:
重击·劫魄和重击·踏罡伤害倍率提升46%。荧惑状态下【命火】对重击·劫魄或重击·踏罡的倍率增加效果提升46%。

每次进入战斗时，景燃获得下述效果，每4秒可触发1次。
·获得300点【炁】。
·景燃获得通幽。

通幽
施放重击·劫魄或重击·踏罡时，回复共鸣能量上限25%的共鸣能量且重击·劫魄和重击·踏罡造成的伤害加深180%，持续4秒。
chains.descEn:
The DMG Multipliers of Heavy Attack - Soul Raid and Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander are increased by 46%. While in the Yinghuo state, the DMG Multiplier increase effect via Fire of Life on Heavy Attack - Soul Raid and Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander is increased by 46%.

Upon entering combat, Jingran gains the following effects, triggered once every 4s:
- Gains 300 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=3} of Qi.
- Gains Netherworld's Boon.

Netherworld's Boon
Casting Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander restores 25% of Max Resonance Energy and grants Heavy Attack - Soul Raid and Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander 180% DMG Amplification for 4s.

chains.name: 乾道变化，各正性命
chains.nameEn: World's Course Shifts, Each to Their Rightful Paths
chains.desc:
景燃施放重击·劫魄或重击·踏罡时，获得5点【鬼护】。

景燃施放共鸣解放·万鬼同葬后，阳变阴合替换为阴阳交错，持续15秒。

阴阳交错
景燃基于生命上限获得额外攻击：景燃每1000点生命上限获得50点攻击，上限2500。
chains.descEn:
When Jingran casts Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander, gain 5 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=0} of Ghost Shroud.

When Jingran casts Resonance Liberation - Burial of Thousand Souls, Yang Changes, Yin Unites is replaced by Yin-Yang Everflow for 15s.

Yin-Yang Everflow
Jingran gains additional ATK based on Max HP: For every 1000 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=2} of Jingran's Max HP, gain 50 additional ATK, up to 2500.

chains.name: 虚实莫辨，人鬼无间
chains.nameEn: Where Reality Meets Illusion, Where Living Meet Dead
chains.desc: 队伍中的角色获得护盾时，使队伍中的角色全属性伤害加成提升20%，持续30秒。
chains.descEn: When a Resonator in the team gains a Shield, all Resonators in the team gain 20% All-Attribute DMG Bonus for 30s.

chains.name: 原始反终，故知死生
chains.nameEn: Ends Return to Beginnings, Truth of Life Laid Bare
chains.desc: 景燃受到致死伤害时，此次伤害不会使景燃倒下，并获得基于景燃生命上限50%的护盾，护盾持续15秒，该效果每10分钟可触发一次，该护盾在切换至其他角色时不会继承。
chains.descEn: When Jingran takes a fatal blow, he will not fall and will instead gain a Shield equal to 50% of Max HP for 15s. This effect can be triggered once every 10 min. This Shield will not be passed on to the incoming Resonator.

chains.name: 恩仇了了，后文有期
chains.nameEn: As Favors and Feuds Fade, New Stories Await
chains.desc:
目标受到景燃的重击伤害提升40%。

魑魅魍魉伤害倍率提升80%。

进入荧惑状态后，景燃获得万鬼同行，持续15秒。万鬼同行持续期间，若景燃为队伍中登场角色，景燃造成伤害时，召唤魑魅魍魉攻击目标，对目标造成热熔伤害，本次伤害为重击伤害。

此方式召唤魑魅魍魉间隔为1秒，最多以此方式召唤8次，满足任一下述条件时，移除万鬼同行并重置魑魅魍魉的召唤次数。
·施放共鸣解放·万鬼同葬时。
·荧惑持续时间结束或被移除时。
chains.descEn:
Targets take 40% more Heavy Attack DMG from Jingran.

The DMG Multiplier of Chimei Wangliang is increased by 80%.

Upon entering the Yinghuo state, Jingran gains the Parade of Thousand Souls effect for 15s. During this effect, if Jingran is the active Resonator in the team, upon dealing damage, Jingran summons Chimei Wangliang to attack the targets, dealing Fusion DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.

Chimei Wangliang can be summoned this way at an interval of 1s for up to 8 times. Parade of Thousand Souls ends and the available summon charges of Chimei Wangliang reset when either of the following conditions is met:
- Cast Resonance Liberation - Burial of Thousand Souls.
- Yinghuo ends or is removed.

skills.name: 猎犬剑技·獠牙撕扯
skills.desc:
普攻
最多进行4段攻击，造成导电伤害。
 
重击
消耗耐力攻击目标，造成导电伤害。
 
空中攻击
消耗耐力进行空中下落攻击，造成导电伤害。
 
闪避反击
成功闪避后一定时间内短按普攻，将会攻击目标，造成导电伤害。
skills.descEn:
Basic Attack
Calcharo performs up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Electro DMG.
 
Heavy Attack
Consumes STA to attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.
 
Mid-air Attack
Consumes STA to perform a Mid-Air Plunging Attack, dealing Electro DMG.
 
Dodge Counter
Use Basic Attack after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.

skills.name: 灭杀指令
skills.desc:
进行最多3段攻击，造成导电伤害。
若切换至其他角色或者一定时间内没有施放共鸣技能灭杀指令，则技能进入冷却状态。 
共鸣技能灭杀指令不会打断普攻段数。
skills.descEn:
Calcharo performs up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Electro DMG.
If Calcharo is switched off field, or if Resonance Skill Extermination Order is not activated again in a while, this skill will enter Cooldown.
Resonance Skill Extermination Order does not interrupt Calcharo's Basic Attack cycle.

params.label: 每段灭杀指令回复协奏能量

skills.name: 幻影蚀刻
skills.desc:
攻击目标，造成导电伤害，并进入杀戮武装状态。状态结束后，卡卡罗下次变奏技能替换为变奏技能「必要的手段」，造成导电伤害，此次伤害为变奏技能伤害。
 
杀戮武装
·普攻将变为普攻猎犬剑技·狂噬影狱；
·重击的伤害提升，此次伤害为共鸣解放伤害；
·闪避反击的伤害提升，此次伤害为共鸣解放伤害。
 
普攻·猎犬剑技·狂噬影狱
进行最多5段的连续攻击，造成导电伤害，此次伤害为普攻伤害。
skills.descEn:
Calcharo attacks the target, dealing Electro DMG and enters Deathblade Gear state. After Deathblade Gear state ends, Calcharo's next Intro Skill is replaced with Intro Skill "Necessary Means", which deals Electro DMG, considered as Intro Skill DMG.
 
Deathblade Gear
-Basic Attack is replaced with Basic Attack Hounds Roar.
-Heavy Attack deals increased DMG, considered as Resonance Liberation DMG.
-Dodge Counter deals increased DMG, considered as Resonance Liberation DMG.
 
Basic Attack: Hounds Roar
Calcharo performs up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing Electro DMG, considered as Basic Attack DMG.

skills.name: 喋血觉悟
skills.desc: 施放重击「仁慈」时，卡卡罗的共鸣解放伤害加成提升10%，持续15秒。
skills.descEn: Casting Heavy Attack Mercy gives Calcharo 10% Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus for 15s.

skills.name: 无暇赴死
skills.desc: 重击「死告」命中目标时，卡卡罗受到伤害降低15%，持续5秒。
skills.descEn: When Heavy Attack "Death Messenger" hits the target, the damage taken by Calcharo is reduced by 15% for 5s.

skills.name: 全境通缉
skills.desc: 攻击目标，造成导电伤害。
skills.descEn: Attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.

skills.name: 猎杀使命
skills.desc:
重击·「仁慈」
持有3点【残忍】时，重击替换为重击「仁慈」。
施放重击「仁慈」时，消耗3点【残忍】，造成导电伤害，此次伤害为重击伤害，并额外回复共鸣能量和协奏能量。
 
残忍的获取规则
【残忍】上限3点。
共鸣解放杀戮武装状态下，无法获得【残忍】。
共鸣技能灭杀指令命中目标时，获得1点【残忍】。
 
重击·「死告」
持有5点【杀意】时，普攻替换为重击「死告」。
施放重击「死告」时，消耗5点【杀意】，造成导电伤害，此次伤害为共鸣解放伤害，并额外回复共鸣能量和协奏能量。
 
【杀意】的获取规则
共鸣解放杀戮武装状态下，特殊能量替换为【杀意】。
【杀意】上限5点。
普攻猎犬剑技·狂噬影狱命中目标时，回复1点【杀意】。
skills.descEn:
Heavy Attack: "Mercy"
When Calcharo has 3 "Cruelty", his Heavy Attack is replaced with Heavy Attack "Mercy."
When casting Heavy Attack "Mercy", Calcharo consumes 3 "Cruelty" to deal Electro DMG, considered as Heavy Attack DMG, and recovers Resonance Energy and Concerto Energy.
 
"Cruelty"
Calcharo can hold up to 3 "Cruelty."
In Resonance Liberation Deathblade Gear state, "Cruelty" cannot be acquired.
When Resonance Skill Extermination Order hits the target, gain 1 "Cruelty."
 
Heavy Attack: "Death Messenger"
When Calcharo has 5 "Killing Intent", his Basic Attack is replaced with Heavy Attack "Death Messenger."
When casting Heavy Attack "Death Messenger," Calcharo consumes 5 "Killing Intent" to deal Electro DMG, considered as Resonance Liberation DMG, and recovers Resonance Energy and Concerto Energy.
 
"Killing Intent"
In Resonance Liberation Deathblade Gear state, Calcharo's Forte Gauge is replaced with "Killing Intent", stacking up to 5.
When Basic Attack Hounds Roar hits the target, Calcharo gains 1 "Killing Intent."

skills.desc: 当前角色烹饪时有概率产出特色料理
skills.descEn: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.

skills.name: 掠影奇袭
skills.desc: 卡卡罗召唤猎杀影支援共鸣者，挥刀肃清前方的目标。猎杀影的攻击将造成卡卡罗195.98%+391.96%攻击的导电伤害。
skills.descEn: Calcharo summons Phantom to support the active Resonator, clearing the targets in front with a slash. The Phantom's attack deals Electro DMG equal to 195.98%+391.96% of Calcharo's ATK.

skills.name: 谐度破坏·长刃
skills.desc: 目标【偏谐值】满时，可对其施放【谐度破坏】。
skills.descEn: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.

inherents.desc: 施放重击「仁慈」时，卡卡罗的共鸣解放伤害加成提升10%，持续15秒。

inherents.desc: 重击「死告」命中目标时，卡卡罗受到伤害降低15%，持续5秒。

chains.name: 隐秘谈判
chains.desc: 共鸣技能灭杀指令命中目标时，额外回复10点共鸣能量，每20秒可触发1次。
chains.descEn: When Resonance Skill Extermination Order hits a target, it additionally recovers 10 Resonance Energy. This can be triggered once every 20s.

chains.name: 零和博弈
chains.desc: 施放变奏技能全境通缉或变奏技能「必要的手段」后，共鸣技能伤害加成提升30%，持续15秒。
chains.descEn: After Calcharo casts Intro Skill Wanted Criminal or Intro Skill "Necessary Means", his Resonance Skill DMG Bonus is increased by 30% for 15s.

chains.name: 铁腕外交
chains.desc: 共鸣解放杀戮武装状态持续期间，卡卡罗的导电伤害加成提升25%。
chains.descEn: During the Resonance Liberation Deathblade Gear state, Calcharo's Electro DMG Bonus is increased by 25%.

chains.name: 集群威胁
chains.desc: 施放延奏技能掠影奇袭时，队伍中的角色导电伤害加成提升20%，持续30秒。
chains.descEn: After casting Outro Skill Shadowy Raid, Electro DMG Bonus of all team members is increased by 20% for 30s.

chains.name: 替代协议
chains.desc: 变奏技能全境通缉及变奏技能「必要的手段」的伤害提升50%。
chains.descEn: Intro Skill Wanted Criminal and Intro Skill "Necessary Means" deal 50% more DMG.

chains.name: 最后通牒
chains.desc: 施放重击「死告」时，卡卡罗将会召唤2个猎杀影进行协同攻击，每个猎杀影可造成卡卡罗100.00%攻击的导电伤害，此次伤害为共鸣解放伤害。
chains.descEn: When casting Resonance Liberation "Death Messenger", Calcharo will summon 2 Phantoms to perform Coordinated Attacks. Each Phantom deals Electro DMG equal to 100.00% of Calcharo's ATK, which is considered Resonance Liberation DMG.

skills.name: 悬丝华刃舞
skills.desc:
普攻
控制人偶“悬丝”，进行最多4段的连续攻击，造成导电伤害。
 
重击
消耗耐力操纵人偶“悬丝”攻击目标，造成导电伤害。
 
空中攻击
消耗耐力，操控人偶“悬丝”进行空中下落攻击，造成导电伤害。
 
闪避反击
成功闪避后一定时间内短按普攻，将会攻击目标，造成导电伤害。
skills.descEn:
Basic Attack
Yinlin controls the puppet "Zapstring" to perform up to 4 attacks, dealing Electro DMG.
 
Heavy Attack
Yinlin consumes STA to control "Zapstring", dealing Electro DMG.
 
Mid-air Attack
Yinlin consumes STA to control "Zapstring" to perform a Mid-air Plunging Attack, dealing Electro DMG.
 
Dodge Counter
Use Basic Attack after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.

skills.name: 磁殛咆哮
skills.desc:
磁殛咆哮
人偶“悬丝”对目标造成导电伤害，并使吟霖进入共鸣技能磁殛状态。
 
磁殛状态
·普攻和闪避反击命中目标时，触发1次磁殛爆发；
·每段普攻和闪避反击仅可触发1次磁殛爆发，最多可触发4次。
 
磁殛爆发
攻击所有携带共鸣回路缚罪标记的目标，造成导电伤害。
 
召雷磁爆
施放共鸣技能磁殛咆哮后一定时间内，短按共鸣技能，将会施放召雷磁爆攻击目标，造成导电伤害。
若一定时间内没有施放共鸣技能召雷磁爆或者切换至其他角色，则技能进入冷却状态。
skills.descEn:
Magnetic Roar
The puppet "Zapstring" deals Electro DMG to the target, and puts Yinlin in Resonance Skill Execution Mode.
 
Execution Mode
Basic Attack and Dodge Counter will trigger 1 Electromagnetic Blast when hitting a target.
Each stage of Basic Attack or Dodge Counter can only trigger 1 Electromagnetic Blast, up to 4 times.
 
Electromagnetic Blast
Attack all targets marked with Forte Circuit Sinner's Mark, dealing Electro DMG.
 
Lightning Execution
Use Resonance Skill after casting Resonance Skill Magnetic Roar to cast Lightning Execution to attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.
If Resonance Skill Lightning Execution is not activated in a while or this Character is switched, this Skill will be put on Cooldown.

skills.name: 千面魅影
skills.desc:
千面魅影
当吟霖【审判值】满时，重击将替换为千面魅影，消耗所有【审判值】攻击目标，造成导电伤害，命中携带缚罪标记的目标时，缚罪标记被替换为惩罚印记，持续18秒。千面魅影造成的伤害为重击伤害。
 
缚罪标记
常态攻击悬丝华刃舞、共鸣解放破天雷灭击或变奏技能狂雷飓风命中目标时，附加缚罪标记。
吟霖离场时缚罪标记消失。
 
惩罚印记
携带惩罚印记的目标受到伤害时会降下审判之雷，对所有携带惩罚印记的目标造成导电伤害，每秒最多可触发1次。审判之雷造成的伤害为共鸣技能伤害。
 
审判值
【审判值】上限100点。
施放变奏技能狂雷飓风时，回复【审判值】。
常态攻击悬丝华刃舞命中目标时，回复【审判值】。
施放共鸣技能磁殛咆哮时，回复【审判值】。
共鸣技能磁殛爆发命中目标时，回复【审判值】。
施放共鸣技能召雷磁爆时，回复【审判值】。
skills.descEn:
Chameleon Cipher
When Yinlin's Judgment Points are full, her Heavy Attack is replaced with Chameleon Cipher, which consumes all Judgment Points to attack the target, dealing Electro DMG. When it hits a target marked with Sinner's Mark, the Sinner's Mark is replaced with Punishment Mark, lasting for 18s. Chameleon Cipher deals Heavy Attack DMG.
 
Sinner's Mark
Basic Attack Zapstring's Dance, Resonance Liberation Thundering Wrath, and Intro Skill Roaring Storm apply Sinner's Mark to the target on hit.
Sinner's Mark is removed when Yinlin is switched out.
 
Punishment Mark
When a target marked with Punishment Mark takes damage, Judgement Strike will fall, triggering Coordinated Attacks to all targets marked with Punishment Mark, dealing Electro DMG. This can be triggered up to 1 time per second. Judgement Strike deals Resonance Skill DMG.
 
Judgment Points
Yinlin can hold up to 100 Judgement Points. Yinlin gains Judgement Points through the following ways:
Upon casting Intro Skill Raging Storm
When Basic Attack Zapstring's Dance hits a target
Upon casting Resonance Skill Magnetic Roar;
When Resonance Skill Electromagnetic Blast hits a target;
Upon casting Resonance Skill Lightning Execution.

Thunder Field
The active character gains the effects below when in the Thunder Field: a Coordinated Attack from Resonance Skill Thunder Wedge is triggered when attacks hit a target, dealing Electro DMG. This can be triggered once every 1.2s. The effect lasts for 1.5s.

skills.name: 沉雷藏锋

万壑雷
 【锋芒】充满时，长按共鸣技能，将会消耗所有【锋芒】，施放万壑雷，造成导电伤害，并使渊武进入雷厉风行状态。
 
掀雷
【锋芒】充满时，共鸣技能雷之楔将会施放掀雷，造成导电伤害。
 
 雷厉风行
 在雷厉风行状态下的角色抗打断能力提升。
 渊武处于该状态下时：
 ·普攻的攻击范围扩大，削减怪物共振度的能力提升；
 ·重击的攻击更为迅猛，削减怪物共振度的能力提升；
 ·闪避反击的攻击更为迅猛，削减怪物共振度的能力提升；
 ·施放重击或成功触发逆势回击后3秒内短按普攻，将会施放蹑风追雷攻击目标，造成导电伤害，此次伤害为普攻伤害；
 ·不会回复【锋芒】。
  
 锋芒获取规则
 【锋芒】上限100点。
 场上存在共鸣技能雷之楔时，每秒回复6点【锋芒】，渊武不在场时该效果依然生效。
 共鸣技能雷之楔协同攻击命中目标时，回复5点【锋芒】。
skills.descEn:
Rumbling Spark
When "Readiness" is full, hold Resonance Skill to consume all "Readiness" and cast Rumbling Spark, dealing Electro DMG and entering the Lightning Infused state.

Thunder Uprising
When "Readiness" is full, Resonance Skill Thunder Wedge will be replaced with Thunder Uprising, dealing Electro DMG.

Lightning Infused
The character in Lightning Infused state has a greatly increased resistance to interruption.
When Yuanwu is in this state:
-Basic Attacks: Hit targets in a larger range, reduce enemy Vibration Strength with increased efficiency.
-Heavy Attacks: Have increased attack speed, reduce enemy Vibration Strength with increased efficiency.
-Dodge Counters: Have increased attack speed, reduce enemy Vibration Strength with increased efficiency.
-Use Basic Attack within 3s after casting a Heavy Attack or a successful Counterattack to cast Thunderweaver, dealing Electro DMG, considered as Basic Attack DMG.
-Does not recover "Readiness".

Readiness
Yuanwu can hold up to 100 "Readiness".
When Resonance Skill Thunder Wedge is on the field, Yuanwu gains 6 "Readiness" every second, even when he is not the active character;
When Resonance Skill Thunder Wedge hits a target with a Coordinated Attack, Yuanwu gains 5 "Readiness".

·闪避反击，替换为闪避反击凌霄·闪避反击，造成衍射伤害。
可以在空中施放。
 
共鸣技能·惊龙破空
施放普攻凌霄·普攻第4段后，将立刻结束乘岁凌霄状态，并获得效果游龙廻光。
可以在空中施放。
游龙廻光效果持续期间：
·处于空中时，普攻替换为重击凌霄·重击，消耗耐力攻击目标，造成衍射伤害。
·共鸣技能替换为共鸣技能惊龙破空，形成熠日攻击目标，并在短暂时间后引爆炳星。施放时可以消耗今汐至多50点【韶光】，造成衍射伤害，每消耗1点【韶光】，使本次共鸣技能惊龙破空的炳星的伤害倍率增加。
可以在空中施放。
·施放共鸣技能惊龙破空后，今汐可获得同奏，每25秒内只能获得一次。
 
同奏
今汐拥有同奏时，今汐切换其他角色时，登场角色将施放自身变奏技能，今汐则施放自身延奏技能，并移除今汐身上的同奏效果。今汐协奏能量达到最大值，并且拥有同奏效果时，只消耗同奏效果。
 
韶光的获取规则
【韶光】上限50点。
当今汐处于队伍中时，附近队伍中所有角色获得效果韶华共济。
韶华共济包含两个独立效果：
造成属性伤害时，为今汐提供1点【韶光】，同类属性伤害每3秒可触发1次。
协同攻击造成伤害时，为今汐提供2点【韶光】，同类属性伤害每3秒可触发1次。
skills.descEn:
Incarnation
While in Incarnation:
- Alternative Basic Attack "Incarnation - Basic Attack" becomes available. Perform up to 4 consecutive strikes, dealing Spectro DMG considered as Resonance Skill DMG. The basic attack cycle of this will not be reset. Can be cast in mid-air.
- Alternative Resonance Skill "Crescent Divinity" becomes available. Deal Spectro DMG. Can be cast in mid-air.
- Alternative Heavy Attack "Incarnation - Heavy Attack" becomes available. Attack the target in mid-air at the cost of Stamina, dealing Spectro DMG.
- Alternative Dodge "Incarnation - Dodge" is available while in mid-air. Can be cast multiple times at the cost of Stamina.
- Alternative Dodge Counter "Incarnation - Dodge Counter" becomes available. Deal Spectro DMG.
Can be cast in mid-air.

Resonance Skill - Illuminous Epiphany
After Stage 4 of Incarnation - Basic Attack, Incarnation terminates and Jinhsi gains Ordination Glow. 
Can be cast in mid-air.
While Ordination Glow lasts:
- Basic Attack is replaced with Heavy Attack "Incarnation - Heavy Attack". Attack the target in mid-air at the cost of Stamina, dealing Spectro DMG.
- Resonance Skill is replaced with Resonance Skill "Illuminous Epiphany". Send out Solar Flare that detonates as Stella Glamor, dealing Spectro DMG after a short delay. Consume up to 50 Incandescence, with each point of Incandescence granting bonus DMG Multiplier percentage to Stella Glamor.
Can be cast in mid-air.
- After casting Resonance Skill Illuminous Epiphany, Jinhsi gains Unison. This can be triggered once every 25s.

Unison
While Jinhsi has Unison, switching to other Resonators will remove Jinhsi's Unison to trigger Jinhsi's Outro Skill and the incoming Resonator's Intro Skill. Unison will be consumed in priority in place of Concerto Energy when Concerto Energy is full.

Incandescence
Jinhsi can hold up to 50 Incandescence.
When Jinhsi is in the party, all nearby Resonators in the party gain Eras in Unity.
Eras in Unity provides 2 independent effects:
Jinhsi gains 1 Incandescence anytime Resonators in the party inflict Attribute DMG. This effect may be triggered by damage of the same Attribute for up to 1 time(s) every 3s. Additionally, Jinhsi gains 2 Incandescence when Resonators in the party damage the enemy with Coordinated Attacks. This effect may be triggered by Coordinated Attacks of the same Attribute for up to 1 time(s) every 3s.

{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack after a successful Mid-air Dodge to perform Plunging Attack at the cost of STA, dealing Electro DMG.

Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Backstep
When Prowess is full, Heavy Attack - Steelclash is replaced with Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Backstep, dealing Electro DMG and consuming all Prowess.
- While in action, release or {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack again within a certain period to perform Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Spinslash.
- Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Spinslash is available if Augusta remains on the ground for a certain period after this skill is interrupted.

Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Spinslash
Augusta whirls and lashes out with her Broadblade, dealing Electro DMG.

Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Uppercut
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Jump when Prowess is full to perform Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Uppercut, dealing Electro DMG and consuming all Prowess.
If Prowess is full when casting Resonance Skill - Warrior's Blade, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Skill or Jump to perform Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Uppercut, dealing Electro DMG and consuming all Prowess.
If Prowess is full when casting Heavy Attack - Steelclash or Dodge Counter – Heavy Attack: Steelclash, release Normal Attack after a certain period or {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack or Jump again to perform Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Uppercut, dealing, Electro DMG and consuming all Prowess.

Dodge Counter - Heavy Attack: Steelclash
When Prowess is full, Dodge Counter is replaced with Dodge Counter - Heavy Attack: Steelclash, dealing Electro DMG, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.

Dodge Counter - Thunderoar: Backstep
When Ascendancy is full, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack following a successful Dodge on the ground to cast Dodge Counter - Thunderoar: Backstep in place of Dodge Counter and Dodge Counter - Heavy Attack: Steelclash, dealing Electro DMG, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.
- Release or {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack again within a certain period into the action to perform Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Spinslash.
- Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Spinslash is available if Augusta remains on the ground for a certain period after this skill is interrupted.

Prowess
Augusta can hold up to 100 points of Prowess.
- Prowess is obtained when Basic Attack, Heavy Attack - Steelclash, Mid-air Attack, Mid-air Dodge Counter, Resonance Skill - Warrior's Blade, Dodge Counter, or Dodge Counter - Heavy Attack: Steelclash deals damage.
- Prowess is fully restored when casting Intro Skill - Stride of Goldenflare.

skills.name: 至日的征伐
skills.desc:
共鸣解放·誓锋不殒
短按共鸣解放松开时可施放该技能，奥古斯塔发动横扫斩击，造成导电伤害，此次伤害为重击伤害。

共鸣解放·赫日威临
当存在2层【威慑】时，长按共鸣解放可施放共鸣解放·赫日威临。共鸣解放·赫日威临施放时不消耗共鸣能量，而是消耗2层【威慑】。
·施放共鸣解放·赫日威临时，展开王之界域，并且进入7秒的俯首之刻，俯首之刻持续期间时间暂时停止，不能切换角色，仅能施放赫日威临·烈阳、赫日威临·不朽者之肃、闪避，处于空中状态时可以施放空中攻击。
·俯首之刻期间，短按普攻或长按普攻可施放赫日威临·烈阳。可在水面行走且不消耗耐力。
·若进行场景、玩法、或功能交互时，将强制结束俯首之刻，且不会自动施放赫日威临·不朽者之肃。

赫日威临·烈阳
造成导电伤害，此伤害为重击伤害。施放9次赫日威临·烈阳后，短按普攻或共鸣解放可施放赫日威临·不朽者之肃。

赫日威临·不朽者之肃
造成导电伤害，此次伤害为重击伤害。施放赫日威临·不朽者之肃时解除俯首之刻，技能结束时消耗全部的【以众愿为冕】，且队伍中除奥古斯塔外的其他角色离场。
·俯首之刻结束时自动施放赫日威临·不朽者之肃。
·俯首之刻持续期间可长按共鸣解放，提前施放赫日威临·不朽者之肃。

王之界域
·王之界域持续30秒。
·王之界域存在时：队伍中角色施放变奏技能时，获得基于奥古斯塔最大生命5%+650的护盾，不可叠加，持续10秒。该护盾在切换至其他角色时不会继承。

【威慑】获取方式
【威慑】上限为2层。
·施放共鸣技能·不败恒阳·落袭时，奥古斯塔获得1层【威慑】。
·队友处于奥古斯塔延奏技能·不屈的战歌的效果期间，施放延奏技能时，奥古斯塔获得1层【威慑】。
skills.descEn:
Resonance Liberation - Sword of Eternal Oath
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} and release Resonance Liberation to cast this skill. Augusta will sweep her Broadblade forward, dealing Electro DMG, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.

Resonance Liberation - Sublime is the Sun
When Majesty reaches 2 stacks, hold Resonance Liberation to cast Resonance Liberation - Sublime is the Sun. Casting Resonance Liberation - Sublime is the Sun costs no Resonance Energy but 2 stacks of Majesty instead.
- When casting Resonance Liberation - Sublime is the Sun, Augusta generates the Ruler's Realm and enters the Sworn Allegiance state for 7s. Within this duration, time is temporarily stopped, and Resonator switching is disabled. Only Sublime is the Sun - Sunborne, Sublime is the Sun - Everbright Protector, and Dodge can be performed in the Sworn Allegiance state. Mid-air Attack is available while airborne.
- In the Sworn Allegiance state, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} or hold Normal Attack to cast Sublime is the Sun - Sunborne. Augusta can walk on water without consuming STA in this state.
- Performing environmental, gameplay, or other interactions ends Sworn Allegiance without triggering Sublime is the Sun - Everbright Protector.

Sublime is the Sun - Sunborne
Deal Electro DMG, considered as Heavy Attack DMG. After casting Sublime is the Sun - Sunborne 9 times, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack or Resonance Liberation to perform Sublime is the Sun - Everbright Protector.

Sublime is the Sun - Everbright Protector
Deal Electro DMG, considered as Heavy Attack DMG. Casting Sublime is the Sun - Everbright Protector ends the Sworn Allegiance state and consumes all stacks of Crown of Wills later. All other Resonators in the team will be made to leave the field.
- When Sworn Allegiance ends, Sublime is the Sun - Everbright Protector is automatically cast.
- During Sworn Allegiance, hold Resonance Liberation to cast Sublime is the Sun - Everbright Protector early.

Ruler's Realm
- Ruler's Realm lasts for 30s.
- When Resonators in the team cast Intro Skill within Ruler's Realm, they gain a shield equal to 650 + 5% of Augusta's Max HP for 10s. This effect is unstackable. This Shield will not be passed on to the incoming Resonator.

Majesty
Augusta can hold up to 2 stacks of Majesty.
- 1 stack of Majesty is obtained when casting Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Plunge.
- 1 stack of Majesty is obtained when other Resonators in the team cast Outro Skill under the effect of Augusta's Outro Skill - Battlesong of the Unyielding.

skills.desc: 造成导电伤害。

skills.name: 曜阳如我
skills.desc:
共鸣技能·不败恒阳·迅击
【权炳】满时，奥古斯塔的共鸣技能·斩锋替换为共鸣技能·不败恒阳·迅击，造成导电伤害。
·技能施放时，短按普攻或共鸣技能，可以施放共鸣技能·不败恒阳·跃空。
·短时间内被打断则可重新施放共鸣技能·不败恒阳·迅击。
·一定时间后被打断则可施放共鸣技能·不败恒阳·跃空。
·可在空中施放。

共鸣技能·不败恒阳·跃空
造成导电伤害。
·技能施放时，短按普攻或共鸣技能，可以施放共鸣技能·不败恒阳·落袭。
·短时间内被打断则可重新施放共鸣技能·不败恒阳·跃空。
·一定时间后被打断则可施放共鸣技能·不败恒阳·落袭。
·仅可在空中施放。

共鸣技能·不败恒阳·落袭
施放时消耗全部的【权炳】，造成导电伤害，此次伤害为重击伤害。
·施放时，获得1层【威慑】。
·仅可在空中施放。

闪避反击·不败恒阳·迅击
【权炳】满时，地面闪避成功后短按共鸣技能，或者空中闪避成功后短按普攻或共鸣技能，可施放闪避反击·不败恒阳·迅击，施放时造成导电伤害，此次伤害为共鸣技能伤害。
·技能施放时，短按普攻或共鸣技能，可以施放共鸣技能·不败恒阳·跃空。
·一定时间后被打断则可施放共鸣技能·不败恒阳·跃空。

【权炳】获取规则
【权炳】上限为100点。
·常态攻击造成伤害时，可以获得【权炳】。
·施放变奏技能·灼金的巡行时回复20%【权炳】。
·施放共鸣技能·斩锋时回复10%【权炳】。
·施放共鸣解放·誓锋不殒时回复40%【权炳】。
skills.descEn:
Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Strike
When Ascendancy is full, Resonance Skill - Warrior's Blade is replaced with Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Strike, dealing Electro DMG.
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack or Resonance Skill during the action to cast Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Leap.
- Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Strike can be re-cast shortly after being interrupted.
- Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Leap can be cast some time again after being interrupted.
- Can be cast mid-air.

Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Leap
Deal Electro DMG.
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack or Resonance Skill during the action to cast Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Plunge.
- Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Leap can be re-cast shortly after being interrupted.
- Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Plunge can be cast some time again after being interrupted.
- Can only be cast mid-air.

Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Plunge
Consume all Ascendancy to cast this skill, dealing Electro DMG, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.
- Casting this skill grants 1 stack of Majesty.
- Can only be cast mid-air.

Dodge Counter - Undying Sunlight: Strike
When Ascendancy is full, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Skill after a successful ground Dodge or {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack or Resonance Skill after successful Mid-air Dodge to cast Dodge Counter - Undying Sunlight: Strike, dealing Electro DMG, considered as Resonance Skill DMG.
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack or Resonance Skill during the action to cast Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Leap.
- Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Leap can be cast again some time after being interrupted.

Ascendancy
Augusta can hold up to 100 points of Ascendancy.
- Ascendancy is obtained when Normal Attacks deal damage.
- Casting Intro Skill - Stride of Goldenflare restores 20% Ascendancy.
- Casting Resonance Skill - Warrior's Blade restores 10% Ascendancy.
- Casting Resonance Liberation - Sword of Eternal Oath restores 40% Ascendancy.

- Trigram - Mountain is obtained when Basic Attack Stage 2 deals damage.

skills.name: 战术性调整
skills.desc:
共鸣技能·来发大的！
处于【猎手】模式时，短按共鸣技能，可接近敌人然后使用【猎手】快速扫射，同时切换模式为【铁胆】，并使用【铁胆】轰击目标，造成导电伤害。

共鸣技能·有本事来抓我！
处于【铁胆】模式时，短按共鸣技能，用【铁胆】快速扫击敌人，然后对地射击利用后坐力接近敌人，同时切换模式为【猎手】，并使用【猎手】快速扫射，造成导电伤害。
施放该技能后，若处于低空，一定时间内短按或长按普攻可施放空中突袭！·猎手。

{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} or hold Normal Attack when close to the ground shortly after casting this skill to follow up with Comin' in Hot! - Huntress.

skills.name: 狂欢时间！
skills.desc:
切换为【31型重机枪】模式，生成停滞领域，9.5秒内：
丽贝卡使用【31型重机枪】自动射击，造成导电伤害，此次伤害为普攻伤害，并持续获得【过载】。射击期间，每隔一定时间后短按或长按普攻、短按共鸣解放，可提升【31型重机枪】威力，并更快的获得【过载】，至多可触发2次。
·机枪会自动锁定屏幕中央瞄准框内距离准星最近的敌人，不会攻击瞄准框外的敌人。
·丽贝卡使用【31型重机枪】期间无法移动，但受到的伤害降低50%且免疫打断。

【过载】获取规则
【过载】上限为90点。
【31型重机枪】未提升威力时：命中获得2点。
【31型重机枪】威力提升1次后：命中获得4点。
【31型重机枪】威力提升2次后：命中获得6点。

大烟花！
【31型重机枪】模式持续时间结束时或【过载】达到上限时，自动施放大烟花！，造成导电伤害。施放大烟花！时，会退出【31型重机枪】模式。
·【31型重机枪】模式下长按共鸣解放，可提前施放大烟花！。
·退出【31型重机枪】模式时，会清除所有【过载】。
skills.descEn:
Switching to Mk. 31 HMG mode generates a field of Stagnation for 9.5s, in which:
Rebecca fires the Mk. 31 HMG automatically, dealing Electro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG, while accumulating Overload. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} or hold Normal Attack or {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Liberation at intervals after Rebecca starts firing to enhance her Mk. 31 HMG's firepower and accumulate Overload faster. This effect can be triggered up to 2 times.
- The machine gun will only auto-lock onto the enemy closest to the crosshair in the aim down sight.
- Rebecca is immobile when firing the Mk. 31 HMG and gains 50% DMG Reduction and Immunity to Interrruption.

Overload
Rebecca can hold up to 90 points of Overload.
Hitting targets with the standard firepower Mk. 31 HMG grants 2 points.
Hitting targets with the enhanced firepower Mk. 31 HMG grants 4 points.
Hitting targets with the twice-enhanced firepower Mk. 31 HMG grants 6 points.

BOOM! Fireworks!
After Mk. 31 HMG mode ends or when Overload is maxed, BOOM! Fireworks! is automatically cast, dealing Electro DMG. Casting BOOM! Fireworks! ends  Mk. 31 HMG.
- Hold Resonance Liberation while in Mk. 31 HMG mode to immediatly cast BOOM! Fireworks!.
- Leaving the Mk. 31 HMG mode removes all Overload.

skills.name: 我要认真了！
skills.desc:
该用这个了！
丽贝卡施放共鸣技能或变奏技能可以在【猎手】、【铁胆】模式之间切换：
·处于【猎手】模式时，丽贝卡暴击伤害提升30%。
·处于【铁胆】模式时，丽贝卡造成伤害无视目标15%防御。
·丽贝卡初始处于【猎手】模式。

骇破·偏移
丽贝卡施放以下技能造成伤害时会对目标附加【骇破·偏移】，同一技能对同一目标3秒内只能触发1次。
变奏技能·呜呼，来发大的！、变奏技能·蠢货，有本事来抓我！、重击·哒哒哒！·猎手、重击·砰砰砰！·铁胆、共鸣解放·大烟花！。

骇破响应·熔触
丽贝卡对范围内处于【骇破·干涉】状态的目标造成导电伤害，此次伤害为骇破伤害。

重击·哒哒哒！·猎手
【狂热】达到120点时，重击·猎手替换为重击·哒哒哒！·猎手。长按普攻施放重击·哒哒哒！·猎手，消耗所有的【狂热】，牵引周围的目标，造成导电伤害，此次伤害为普攻伤害。
在施放重击·猎手期间，若【狂热】达到120点，且此时不处于施放战术闪避·猎手期间，可以通过松开普攻施放重击·哒哒哒！·猎手。

重击·砰砰砰！·铁胆
【狂热】达到120点时，重击·铁胆替换为重击·砰砰砰！·铁胆。长按普攻施放重击·砰砰砰！·铁胆，消耗所有的【狂热】，牵引周围的目标，造成导电伤害，此次伤害为普攻伤害。

【狂热】获取规则
【狂热】上限120点。
常态攻击造成伤害时，回复【狂热】。
共鸣技能造成伤害时，回复【狂热】。
施放变奏技能·呜呼，来发大的！、变奏技能·蠢货，有本事来抓我！并获得小孩子才做选择！时，回复50点。

【手感火热】获取规则
【手感火热】上限120点。
随时间持续获得，每秒获得10点。
施放重击·哒哒哒！·猎手或重击·砰砰砰！·铁胆时回复40点。

小孩子才做选择！
【手感火热】达到120点时，施放变奏技能·呜呼，来发大的！、变奏技能·蠢货，有本事来抓我！、共鸣技能·来发大的！或共鸣技能·有本事来抓我！时，获得额外效果，12秒内：
无论处于哪种模式，丽贝卡同时获得【猎手】和【铁胆】模式的属性加成效果。
此期间无法回复【手感火热】，并且每秒消耗10点【手感火热】。
skills.descEn:
Switch Gears!
Upon casting Resonance Skill or Intro Skill, Rebecca can freely switch between the Huntress and Guts modes.
- The Huntress mode increases Rebecca's Crit. DMG by 30%.
- The Guts mode allows Rebecca to ignore 15% of the target's DEF.
By default, Rebecca starts in the Huntress mode.

Hack - Shifting
Rebecca inflicts Hack - Shifting upon dealing damage to the targets through the following skills. The same skill can trigger this effect once every 3s:
Intro Skill - Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time!, Intro Skill - Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me!, Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress, Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts, and Resonance Liberation - BOOM! Fireworks!.

Hack Response - Meltdown
Deal Electro DMG to all targets affected by Hack - Interfered within the range, considered Hack DMG.

Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress
At 120 points of Fervor, Heavy Attack - Huntress is replaced with Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress. Hold Normal Attack to cast Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress, which consumes all Fervor to pull in nearby targets and deal Electro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.
During Heavy Attack - Huntress, if Fervor is at 120 points and Rebecca is not in the action of Tactical Dodge - Huntress, release Normal Attack to cast Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress.

Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts
At 120 points of Fervor, Heavy Attack - Guts is replaced with Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts. Hold Normal Attack  to cast Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts, which consumes all Fervor to pull in nearby targets and deal Electro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.

Fervor
Rebecca can hold up to 120 points of Fervor.
Normal Attacks restore Fervor upon damaging the target.
Resonance Skill restores Fervor upon damaging the target.
When A Girl Gets What She Wants! is gained by casting Intro Skill - Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time! or Intro Skill - Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me!, Rebecca restores 50 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=7} of Fervor.

Hot Hand
Rebecca can hold up to 120 points of Hot Hand.
Regenerates over time at a rate of 10 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=9} per second.
Casting Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress or Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts restores 40 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=A}.

A Girl Gets What She Wants!
At 120 points of Hot Hand, casting Intro Skill - Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time!, Intro Skill - Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me!, Resonance Skill -  It's Big Boomin' Time!, or Resonance Skill - Come 'n' Get Me! grants the following effects for 12s:
Rebecca simultaneously gains the Stat Bonuses of both the Huntress and Guts modes, regardless of which mode she's currently in.
Hot Hand cannot be restored during this period and is consumed by 10 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=B} per second.

skills.name: 好搭档
skills.desc:
召唤机枪塔持续攻击敌人，持续14秒，每次攻击造成2.5%的导电伤害。
下一位登场角色获得浪客羁绊，全伤害加深15%，持续14秒。持有浪客羁绊的角色每0.2秒会获得1层超限，造成重击伤害加深0.5%（若是露西持有浪客羁绊，则直接获得满层），上限为35%。若切换至其他角色则提前结束浪客羁绊和超限。
机枪塔可被露西强化，伤害倍率提升250%，但持续时间变为4秒。
skills.descEn:
Summon a turret that continuously attacks enemies for 14s, dealing 2.5% Electro DMG each hit.
The incoming Resonator gains Edgerunner Bonds, granting 15% All DMG Amplification for 14s. Resonators with Edgerunner Bonds gain 1 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=3} of Overlimit every 0.2s, each stack granting 0.5% Heavy Attack DMG Amplification, up to 35% (Lucy automatically receives max stacks when her Edgerunner Bonds is active). Switching to another Resonator ends Edgerunner Bonds and Overlimit early.
Lucy can enhance the turret, increasing its DMG Multiplier by 250%, but its on-field duration will be lowered to 4s.

skills.name: 骇破·熔触
skills.desc:
目标【偏谐值】满时，丽贝卡可对其施放【谐度破坏】。

丽贝卡拥有为目标附加【骇破·偏移】以及响应【骇破·干涉】的能力。
响应【骇破·干涉】：队伍中的角色对目标造成【谐度破坏】伤害并使其进入【骇破·干涉】状态时，丽贝卡将触发骇破响应·熔触效果，同一目标每8秒仅可受到1次该伤害。
skills.descEn:
When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, Rebecca can cast Tune Break on the target.

Rebecca can inflict Hack - Shifting and respond to Hack - Interfered on targets.
Responding to Hack - Interfered:  When any Resonator in the team deals Tune Break DMG and inflicts the Hack - Interfered, Rebecca triggers Hack - Meltdown on the target.  Each target can be damaged by this skill up to once every 8s.

inherents.name: 该你了！
inherents.desc:
每次获得小孩子才做选择！效果或者施放重击·哒哒哒！·猎手和重击·砰砰砰！·铁胆时，攻击提升10%，持续12秒，可叠加2层。
队伍中的角色附加【骇破·偏移】时，谐度破坏增幅提升30点，持续30秒。

inherents.name: 有破绽！
inherents.desc:
重击·哒哒哒！·猎手和重击·砰砰砰！·铁胆抗打断能力提升。
丽贝卡施放共鸣解放·狂欢时间！时，附近队伍中所有角色攻击提升20%，持续30秒。

chains.name: 请多指教咯~
chains.nameEn: Try Not to Get in the Way!
chains.desc:
丽贝卡以下技能伤害倍率提升50%：
·普攻·猎手、重击·猎手、战术闪避·猎手、闪避反击·猎手。
·普攻·铁胆、战术闪避·铁胆、闪避反击·铁胆。
丽贝卡获得小孩子才做选择！效果时，额外获得3层街头直觉，持续12秒。施放战术闪避·猎手、战术闪避·铁胆时，若拥有街头直觉则消耗1层街头直觉，回复20点耐力。
共鸣解放大烟花！免疫打断。
chains.descEn:
The DMG Multipliers of the following skills are increased by 50%: 
- Basic Attack - Huntress, Heavy Attack - Huntress, Tactical Dodge - Huntress, and Dodge Counter - Huntress
- Basic Attack - Guts, Tactical Dodge - Guts, Dodge Counter - Guts.
When A Girl Gets What She Wants! is triggered, Rebecca gains 3 additional {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=1} of Street Smarts for 12s. Upon performing Tactical Dodge - Huntress or Tactical Dodge - Guts, if Rebecca has sufficient Street Smarts stacks, 1 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=3} will be consumed to restore 20 STA.
Resonance Liberation BOOM! Fireworks! is immune to interruption.

chains.name: 哦，原来是你啊！
chains.desc:
施放变奏技能呜呼，来发大的！、变奏技能蠢货，有本事来抓我！或共鸣解放狂欢时间！时，队伍中的角色全属性伤害加成提升20%，持续30秒。
队伍中的角色附加【骇破·偏移】时，全伤害加深15%，持续30秒。
处于非战斗状态时，【手感火热】回复速度翻倍。
chains.descEn:
Casting Intro Skill - Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time!, Intro Skill - Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me!, or Resonance Liberation - Party 'til Dawn! grants 20% All-Attribute DMG Bonus for all Resonators in the team for 30s.
When Resonators in the team inflict Hack - Shifting, they gain 15% All DMG Amplification for 30s.
Hot Hand regenerates twice as fast when Rebecca is out of combat.

chains.name: 背后就交给我吧！
chains.desc:
丽贝卡共鸣解放狂欢时间！、共鸣解放大烟花！伤害倍率提升60%。
丽贝卡共鸣解放狂欢时间！爆炸范围增加30%。
施放变奏技能呜呼，来发大的！、变奏技能蠢货，有本事来抓我！时，获得120点【手感火热】。
chains.descEn:
Rebecca's Resonance Liberation - Party 'til Dawn!, and Resonance Liberation - BOOM! Fireworks! gain 60% DMG Multiplier increase.
Rebecca's Resonance Liberation - Party 'til Dawn! gains 30% more explosion range.
Casting Intro Skill - Yo, It's Big Boomin' Time! or Intro Skill - Hey, Leadhead, Come 'n' Get Me! grants 120 points of Hot Hand.

chains.name: 我会保护你的！
chains.desc: 丽贝卡小孩子才做选择！属性加成效果额外提升60%。
chains.descEn: Rebecca gains an additional 60% Stat Bonus increase from the A Girl Gets What She Wants! effect.

chains.name: 边缘幻梦
chains.desc: 丽贝卡附加【骇破·偏移】时，自身普攻伤害加成提升20%，持续8秒。
chains.descEn: Rebecca gains 20% Basic Attack DMG Bonus for 8s when she inflicts Hack - Shifting.

chains.name: 也许……
chains.desc:
丽贝卡从所有来源中获得的普攻伤害加成数值提升40%。
丽贝卡施放重击·哒哒哒！·猎手、重击·砰砰砰！·铁胆期间，额外造成一次900%的导电伤害，此次伤害为普攻伤害。
丽贝卡施放重击·哒哒哒！·猎手、重击·砰砰砰！·铁胆时，额外回复20点【手感火热】。
受到致死伤害时，此次伤害不会使丽贝卡倒下，并且立即回复5次2077点固定生命值，该效果每10分钟可触发1次。
处于非战斗状态大于4秒时，丽贝卡回复120点【狂热】，每4秒只生效1次。
chains.descEn:
Rebecca's Basic Attack DMG Bonus from every source is increased by 40%.
During Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress or Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts, Rebecca deals an additional instance of Electro DMG equal to 900% of her ATK, considered Basic Attack DMG.
Rebecca recovers an additional 20 points of Hot Hand when she is casting Heavy Attack - Rat-tat-tat!: Huntress or Heavy Attack - Bang-bang-bang!: Guts.
When Rebecca takes a fatal blow, she does not fall to the damage and instead restores fixed 2077 HP for 5 times immediately. This effect is triggered once every 10 min.
When Rebecca stays out of combat for more than 4s, she restores 120 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=7} of Fervor. This effect is triggered once every 4s.

skills.name: 止戈
skills.desc:
普攻
进行最多4段的连续攻击，造成导电伤害。

格挡架势
长按普攻，消耗耐力进入格挡架势。
格挡架势下免疫打断，受到的伤害降低60%，持续消耗耐力；松开普攻键时，结束格挡架势，并施放普攻·逆转一击，造成导电伤害。
若施放普攻·逆转一击的一定时间内受到敌方目标攻击,免疫此次伤害并短暂停滞目标,随后会施放普攻·逆转一击·崩解，造成导电伤害。
施放普攻·逆转一击后一定时间内短按普攻，将会施放普攻第2段。
施放普攻·逆转一击·崩解后一定时间内短按普攻，将会施放空中攻击·湮灭。
格挡架势下可消耗耐力向对应方向进行闪避·瞬身，施放该技能一定时间内可以触发成功闪避。

空中攻击
消耗耐力进行空中下落攻击，造成导电伤害。

空中攻击·湮灭
进行最多3段的连续攻击，造成湮灭伤害，施放该技能第3段后，在一定时间内短按普攻，将会施放普攻·克敌。

闪避反击
成功闪避后一定时间内短按普攻，将会攻击目标，造成导电伤害。
施放该技能后在一段时间内短按普攻，将会施放普攻第3段。

空中闪避反击
空中成功闪避后一定时间内短按普攻，消耗耐力进行空中下落攻击，造成导电伤害。
skills.descEn:
Basic Attack
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Electro DMG.

Parry Stance
Hold Normal Attack to enter Parry Stance at the cost of STA. 
While active, Rover is immune to interruptions, takes 60% less DMG, and continuously consumes STA. Release Normal Attack to exit Parry Stance and perform Basic Attack - Riposte Strike, dealing Electro DMG.
If an attack hits Rover during a certain period of Basic Attack - Riposte Strike, neutralize this attack and temporarily Stagnate the target before performing Basic Attack - Riposte Strike: Crumble, dealing Electro DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting Basic Attack - Riposte Strike to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting Basic Attack - Riposte Strike: Crumble to cast Mid-air Attack - Havoc
In Parry Stance, use Dodge to consume STA to perform Dodge: Flicker, which can trigger successful Dodges during the action of this skill shortly after it's cast.

Mid-air Attack
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack from mid-air, dealing Electro DMG.

Mid-air Attack - Havoc
Perform up to 3 consecutive strikes, dealing Havoc DMG. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting Stage 3 of this skill to perform Basic Attack - Repel.

Dodge Counter
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after to perform Basic Attack Stage 3.

Mid-air Dodge Counter
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge in mid-air to perform Plunging Attack at the cost of STA, dealing Electro DMG.

skills.desc: 长按施放共鸣技能超负荷后，自身共鸣技能伤害加成提升20%，持续20秒，若切换至其他角色则该效果提前结束。

skills.desc: 攻击目标，造成导电伤害。
skills.descEn: Attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.

skills.name: 天机万象
skills.desc:
超负荷
【电涌】达到上限时，共鸣技能替换为共鸣技能超负荷。
施放该技能后一定时间内短按普攻，将会施放普攻第4段。
可在空中施放。
短按施放共鸣技能超负荷，造成导电伤害，随后清空【电涌】并使队伍中的角色获得10%攻击加成，持续20秒。
长按施放共鸣技能超负荷，消耗60点协奏能量，造成导电伤害，随后清空【电涌】并进入临界共鸣状态。

临界共鸣
临界共鸣状态下，解锁共鸣技能千声翻涌，处于战斗状态时每秒消耗10%上限的【霆怒】：
地面短按共鸣技能进行至多7段的连续攻击，前3段为千声翻涌·衍射，造成衍射伤害；后3段为千声翻涌·湮灭，造成湮灭伤害，最后1段为千声翻涌·剑止万律，造成气动伤害；
地面长按共鸣技能施放千声翻涌·气动，造成气动伤害并升空；
空中短按共鸣技能进行至多6段的空中攻击，前3段为千声翻涌·湮灭空中攻击，造成湮灭伤害，后2段为千声翻涌·气动空中攻击，造成气动伤害并回复附近队伍中所有角色的生命值，最后1段为千声翻涌·气动下落攻击，造成气动伤害，落地后一定时间内短按共鸣技能可以施放千声翻涌·剑止万律；
空中长按共鸣技能也可以施放千声翻涌·气动下落攻击。
千声翻涌命中时可以触发雷陨，对范围内的目标造成导电伤害，此次伤害为共鸣技能伤害。
临界共鸣状态下，施放普攻后一定时间内短按共鸣技能，将会依据普攻段数施放不同形态的千声翻涌。 

【电涌】获取规则
【电涌】上限120点
变奏技能·不啻惊雷、常态攻击·止戈、共鸣技能·雷引、普攻·克敌造成伤害时，回复【电涌】。 

【霆怒】获取规则
【霆怒】上限100点。
进入临界共鸣状态时，获得【霆怒】至上限，千声翻涌造成伤害时，回复【霆怒】。
skills.descEn:
Overshock
At max Electric Surge, Resonance Skill is replaced with Resonance Skill Overshock, dealing Electro DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to perform Normal Attack Stage 4.
This skill can be cast in mid-air.
If Resonance Skill Overshock is cast by {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tapping PC=pressing Gamepad=pressing} the button, clear all Electric Surge to grant Resonators in the team 10% ATK Bonus for 20s.
If Resonance Skill Overshock is cast by holding down the button, consume 60 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=3} of Concerto Energy to deal damage, then clear all Electric Surge to enter Apex Resonance.

Apex Resonance
While in Apex Resonance, Resonance Skill Thrum of All Sounds is unlocked, which consumes 10% Thunder Rage per second:
While on the ground, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Skill to launch up to 7 consecutive attacks:
- The first 3 {Cus:Sap,S=stage P=stages SapTag=5}: Thrum of All Sounds: Spectro, dealing Spectro DMG.
- The next 3 {Cus:Sap,S=stage P=stages SapTag=6}: Thrum of All Sounds: Havoc, dealing Havoc DMG.
- The last 1 {Cus:Sap,S=stage P=stages SapTag=7}: Thrum of All Sounds: Silencing Blade, dealing Aero DMG.
While on the ground, hold Resonance Skill to cast Thrum of All Sounds: Aero, dealing Aero DMG and leaping into the air.
While airborne, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Skill to perform up to 6 stages of Mid-air Attacks:
- The first 3 {Cus:Sap,S=stage P=stages SapTag=9}: Thrum of All Sounds: Havoc Mid-air Attack, dealing Havoc DMG.
- The next 2 {Cus:Sap,S=stage P=stages SapTag=A}: Thrum of All Sounds: Aero Mid-air Attack, dealing Aero DMG and healing all nearby Resonators in the team.
- The last 1 {Cus:Sap,S=stage P=stages SapTag=B}: Thrum of All Sounds: Aero Plunging Attack, dealing Aero DMG. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Resonance Skill shortly after landing to cast Thrum of All Sounds: Silencing Blade.
Hold Resonance Skill in mid-air to cast Thrum of All Sounds: Aero Plunging Attack.
Each time Thrum of All Sounds hits the target, Thunder Bane is triggered, dealing Electro DMG to the target within range, considered Resonance Skill DMG.
While in Apex Resonance, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Skill shortly after casting a Basic Attack to chain into a specific Thrum of All Sounds skill based on the different Basic Attack Stages.

Electric Surge
Rover can hold up to 120 points of Electric Surge.
Electric Surge is restored when Intro Skill - Thunderous Fury, Normal Attack - Deterrence, Resonance Skill - Thunderclap, or Basic Attack - Repel deals damage.

Thunder Rage
Rover can hold up to 100 points of Thunder Rage.
Entering Apex Resonance restores Thunder Rage to the max limit.
Thunder Rage is restored when Thrum of All Sounds deals damage.

skills.name: 止戈
skills.desc:
普攻
进行最多4段的连续攻击，造成导电伤害。

格挡架势
长按普攻，消耗耐力进入格挡架势。
格挡架势下免疫打断，受到的伤害降低60%，持续消耗耐力；松开普攻键时，结束格挡架势，并施放普攻·逆转一击，造成导电伤害。
若施放普攻·逆转一击的一定时间内受到敌方目标攻击,免疫此次伤害并短暂停滞目标,随后会施放普攻·逆转一击·崩解，造成导电伤害。
施放普攻·逆转一击后一定时间内短按普攻，将会施放普攻第2段。
施放普攻·逆转一击·崩解后一定时间内短按普攻，将会施放空中攻击·湮灭。
格挡架势下可消耗耐力向对应方向进行闪避·瞬身，施放该技能一定时间内可以触发成功闪避。

空中攻击
消耗耐力进行空中下落攻击，造成导电伤害。

空中攻击·湮灭
进行最多3段的连续攻击，造成湮灭伤害，施放该技能第3段后，在一定时间内短按普攻，将会施放普攻·克敌。

闪避反击
成功闪避后一定时间内短按普攻，将会攻击目标，造成导电伤害。
施放该技能后在一段时间内短按普攻，将会施放普攻第3段。

空中闪避反击
空中成功闪避后一定时间内短按普攻，消耗耐力进行空中下落攻击，造成导电伤害。
skills.descEn:
Basic Attack
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Electro DMG.

Parry Stance
Hold Normal Attack to enter Parry Stance at the cost of STA. 
While active, Rover is immune to interruptions, takes 60% less DMG, and continuously consumes STA. Release Normal Attack to exit Parry Stance and perform Basic Attack - Riposte Strike, dealing Electro DMG.
If an attack hits Rover during a certain period of Basic Attack - Riposte Strike, neutralize this attack and temporarily Stagnate the target before performing Basic Attack - Riposte Strike: Crumble, dealing Electro DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting Basic Attack - Riposte Strike to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting Basic Attack - Riposte Strike: Crumble to cast Mid-air Attack - Havoc
In Parry Stance, use Dodge to consume STA to perform Dodge: Flicker, which can trigger successful Dodges during the action of this skill shortly after it's cast.

Mid-air Attack
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack from mid-air, dealing Electro DMG.

Mid-air Attack - Havoc
Perform up to 3 consecutive strikes, dealing Havoc DMG. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting Stage 3 of this skill to perform Basic Attack - Repel.

Dodge Counter
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Electro DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after to perform Basic Attack Stage 3.

Mid-air Dodge Counter
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge in mid-air to perform Plunging Attack at the cost of STA, dealing Electro DMG.

skills.name: 天机万象
skills.desc:
超负荷
【电涌】达到上限时，共鸣技能替换为共鸣技能超负荷。
施放该技能后一定时间内短按普攻，将会施放普攻第4段。
可在空中施放。
短按施放共鸣技能超负荷，造成导电伤害，随后清空【电涌】并使队伍中的角色获得10%攻击加成，持续20秒。
长按施放共鸣技能超负荷，消耗60点协奏能量，造成导电伤害，随后清空【电涌】并进入临界共鸣状态。

临界共鸣
临界共鸣状态下，解锁共鸣技能千声翻涌，处于战斗状态时每秒消耗10%上限的【霆怒】：
地面短按共鸣技能进行至多7段的连续攻击，前3段为千声翻涌·衍射，造成衍射伤害；后3段为千声翻涌·湮灭，造成湮灭伤害，最后1段为千声翻涌·剑止万律，造成气动伤害；
地面长按共鸣技能施放千声翻涌·气动，造成气动伤害并升空；
空中短按共鸣技能进行至多6段的空中攻击，前3段为千声翻涌·湮灭空中攻击，造成湮灭伤害，后2段为千声翻涌·气动空中攻击，造成气动伤害并回复附近队伍中所有角色的生命值，最后1段为千声翻涌·气动下落攻击，造成气动伤害，落地后一定时间内短按共鸣技能可以施放千声翻涌·剑止万律；
空中长按共鸣技能也可以施放千声翻涌·气动下落攻击。
千声翻涌命中时可以触发雷陨，对范围内的目标造成导电伤害，此次伤害为共鸣技能伤害。
临界共鸣状态下，施放普攻后一定时间内短按共鸣技能，将会依据普攻段数施放不同形态的千声翻涌。 

【电涌】获取规则
【电涌】上限120点
变奏技能·不啻惊雷、常态攻击·止戈、共鸣技能·雷引、普攻·克敌造成伤害时，回复【电涌】。 

【霆怒】获取规则
【霆怒】上限100点。
进入临界共鸣状态时，获得【霆怒】至上限，千声翻涌造成伤害时，回复【霆怒】。
skills.descEn:
Overshock
At max Electric Surge, Resonance Skill is replaced with Resonance Skill Overshock, dealing Electro DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to perform Normal Attack Stage 4.
This skill can be cast in mid-air.
If Resonance Skill Overshock is cast by {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tapping PC=pressing Gamepad=pressing} the button, clear all Electric Surge to grant Resonators in the team 10% ATK Bonus for 20s.
If Resonance Skill Overshock is cast by holding down the button, consume 60 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=3} of Concerto Energy to deal damage, then clear all Electric Surge to enter Apex Resonance.

Apex Resonance
While in Apex Resonance, Resonance Skill Thrum of All Sounds is unlocked, which consumes 10% Thunder Rage per second:
While on the ground, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Skill to launch up to 7 consecutive attacks:
- The first 3 {Cus:Sap,S=stage P=stages SapTag=5}: Thrum of All Sounds: Spectro, dealing Spectro DMG.
- The next 3 {Cus:Sap,S=stage P=stages SapTag=6}: Thrum of All Sounds: Havoc, dealing Havoc DMG.
- The last 1 {Cus:Sap,S=stage P=stages SapTag=7}: Thrum of All Sounds: Silencing Blade, dealing Aero DMG.
While on the ground, hold Resonance Skill to cast Thrum of All Sounds: Aero, dealing Aero DMG and leaping into the air.
While airborne, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Skill to perform up to 6 stages of Mid-air Attacks:
- The first 3 {Cus:Sap,S=stage P=stages SapTag=9}: Thrum of All Sounds: Havoc Mid-air Attack, dealing Havoc DMG.
- The next 2 {Cus:Sap,S=stage P=stages SapTag=A}: Thrum of All Sounds: Aero Mid-air Attack, dealing Aero DMG and healing all nearby Resonators in the team.
- The last 1 {Cus:Sap,S=stage P=stages SapTag=B}: Thrum of All Sounds: Aero Plunging Attack, dealing Aero DMG. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Resonance Skill shortly after landing to cast Thrum of All Sounds: Silencing Blade.
Hold Resonance Skill in mid-air to cast Thrum of All Sounds: Aero Plunging Attack.
Each time Thrum of All Sounds hits the target, Thunder Bane is triggered, dealing Electro DMG to the target within range, considered Resonance Skill DMG.
While in Apex Resonance, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Skill shortly after casting a Basic Attack to chain into a specific Thrum of All Sounds skill based on the different Basic Attack Stages.

Electric Surge
Rover can hold up to 120 points of Electric Surge.
Electric Surge is restored when Intro Skill - Thunderous Fury, Normal Attack - Deterrence, Resonance Skill - Thunderclap, or Basic Attack - Repel deals damage.

Thunder Rage
Rover can hold up to 100 points of Thunder Rage.
Entering Apex Resonance restores Thunder Rage to the max limit.
Thunder Rage is restored when Thrum of All Sounds deals damage.

skills.desc: 当前角色烹饪时有概率产出特色料理
skills.descEn: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.

skills.name: 殷殷其雷
skills.desc:
下一位登场角色获得电髓，持续20秒，切换至其他角色时，移除电髓；持有电髓的角色附加异常效应后，消耗电髓并获得全伤害加深25%，持续14秒，切换至其他角色时，该效果提前结束。
施放延奏技能时，退出临界共鸣状态，清除全部【霆怒】。
skills.descEn:
The incoming Resonator gains Electro Core for 20s or until the Resonator is switched out. After Resonators with Electro Core inflict Negative Statuses, their Electro Core is consumed, and they gain 25% All DMG Amplification for 14s. Switching to another Resonator ends the effect.
Casting Outro Skill ends the Apex Resonance state and clears all Thunder Rage.

skills.name: 谐度破坏·迅刀
skills.desc: 目标偏谐值满时，可对其施放【谐度破坏】。
skills.descEn: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.

inherents.name: 解明
inherents.desc: 共鸣技能超负荷对目标造成伤害后附加10层【电磁效应】。

inherents.name: 归枢

chains.name: 鬼工玲珑
