chains.name: 一切需求按时完成
chains.desc: 共鸣解放重燃倍率提升120%。
chains.descEn: The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation Rekindle is increased by 120%.

chains.name: 当务之急？下班！
chains.desc:
重斩·破晓、重斩·将明、重斩·终夜、重斩·闪裂倍率提升40%。重斩·终夜命中时消耗的每点【焰光】额外增加倍率提升40%。
处于灼焰形态时获得以下效果：
·【焰光】低于70点时立即回复70点，灼焰形态期间可触发1次。
·进入灼焰形态 后8秒内受到致死伤害时不会倒下，最少保留1点生命值。
chains.descEn:
The DMG Multipliers of Heavy Slash - Daybreak, Heavy Slash- Dawning, Heavy Slash - Nightfall, and Heavy Slash - Lightsmash are increased by 40%. Every Blaze consumed increases the DMG Multiplier of Heavy Slash - Nightfall by 40% on hit.
Gain following effects when in Inferno Mode: 
- When Blaze is lower than 70, restore 70 Blazes immediately. This effect is triggered once in Inferno Mode.
- Within 8s after entering Inferno Mode, Zani will remain standing with at least 1 HP if hit by a fatal blow.

skills.name: 俱寂
skills.desc:
普攻
进行最多2段的连续攻击，造成湮灭伤害。
施放普攻第2段后在一定时间内短按普攻，将会施放纷裂贯穿。

纷裂贯穿
造成湮灭伤害。
在地面施放该技能后一定时间内短按普攻，将会施放断命之铗。
在空中施放该技能后一定时间内按下普攻，将会施放垂落终焉。

断命之铗
张开剪刀，造成湮灭伤害，一段时间后剪出，造成湮灭伤害，回复附近队伍中所有角色的生命值。
施放该技能期间按下普攻，可额外造成湮灭伤害，再次按下普攻，将直接剪出。
该技能伤害为共鸣解放伤害。
断命之铗剪出后一定时间内短按普攻，将会施放撤弦。

撤弦
造成湮灭伤害。
施放该技能一定时间内，可以触发成功闪避效果。

重击
跃至空中，消耗耐力攻击目标，造成湮灭伤害。
处于电锯模式时无法施放该技能。
施放该技能后进行下述操作，将会施放垂落终焉：
·一定时间内短按普攻。
·一定时间后施放命弦·掠行，在落地前下一次短按普攻。
施放重击至落地期间，下一次长按普攻，将会施放重击·碎响切面。

空中攻击
消耗耐力进行空中下落攻击，造成湮灭伤害。
不处于电锯模式时，施放该技能后一定时间内短按普攻，将会施放普攻第2段。

重击·碎响切面
造成湮灭伤害。
施放重击·碎响切面后一定时间内按下普攻，将会施放垂落终焉。
施放重击·碎响切面期间，若被打断，则在落地前，下一次长按普攻，可再次施放重击·碎响切面，落地前无法重复触发该效果。

垂落终焉
消耗耐力进行空中下落攻击，造成湮灭伤害。
在地面施放该技能后一定时间内短按普攻，将会施放断命之铗。

闪避反击
成功闪避后一定时间内短按普攻，将会攻击目标，造成湮灭伤害。
施放该技能后一定时间内短按普攻，将会施放纷裂贯穿。

闪避反击·解弦之眼·收弦
在地面时，成功闪避后保持按住闪避，将会施放闪避反击·解弦之眼·收弦攻击目标，停滞目标，造成湮灭伤害。
·不处于电锯模式时，施放该技能后，下次在地面短按普攻或在空中按下普攻，将会施放纷裂贯穿，进入电锯模式时，移除该效果。
·处于电锯模式时，施放该技能后一定时间内短按普攻，将会施放锯环·疾攻第3段。
skills.descEn:
Basic Attack
Perform up to 2 consecutive attacks, dealing Havoc DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting Basic Attack Stage 2 to cast Rending Lunge. 

Rending Lunge
Deal Havoc DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill on the ground to cast Death Snip.
Use Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill in mid-air to cast Hanging Finality.

Death Snip
Open the scissors, dealing Havoc DMG. After a while, the scissors snip, dealing Havoc DMG and restoring HP for all nearby Resonators in the team.
Use Normal Attack during this skill to deal additional Havoc DMG. Use Normal Attack again to immediately snip the target.
The skill DMG is considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting Death Snip to cast Thread Withdrawn.

Thread Withdrawn
Deal Havoc DMG. 
Can trigger successful Dodges within a certain time after being cast.

Heavy Attack
Leap into the air and consume STA to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG.
This skill cannot be cast while in Chainsaw Mode.
Perform the following actions within a certain time after casting this skill to cast Hanging Finality:
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack;
- Cast Lifethread - Glide and {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack before landing.
Hold Normal Attack before landing after casting Heavy Attack to cast Heavy Attack - Severed Facet.

Mid-air Attack
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing Havoc DMG. 
While not in Chainsaw Mode, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack within a certain time after casting Mid-air Attack to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.

Heavy Attack - Severed Facet
Deal Havoc DMG. 
Use Normal Attack within a certain time after casting Heavy Attack - Severed Facet to cast Hanging Finality.
If interrupted, Heavy Attack - Severed Facet can be cast again by holding Normal Attack before landing. This effect can be triggered once only before landing.

Hanging Finality
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing Havoc DMG. 
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill on the ground to cast Death Snip.

Dodge Counter
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Rending Lunge.

Dodge Counter - Eye of Unraveling: Retraction
Hold Dodge after a successful Dodge on the ground to cast Dodge Counter - Eye of Unraveling: Retraction to attack and Stagnate the target, dealing Havoc DMG.
- While not in Chainsaw Mode, after casting this skill, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack on the ground or use Normal Attack in mid-air to cast Rending Lunge. This effect is removed when Chisa enters Chainsaw Mode.
- While in Chainsaw Mode, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Sawring - Blitz Stage 3.

skills.name: 碎面构图
skills.desc:
解弦之眼
停滞目标，造成湮灭伤害。
·不处于电锯模式时，施放该技能后，下次在地面短按普攻或在空中按下普攻，将会施放纷裂贯穿，进入电锯模式时，移除该效果。
·在地面且处于电锯模式时，施放该技能后一定时间内短按普攻，将会施放锯环·疾攻第2段。
可在空中施放。

齿轨轮回
在地面且【锯环残响】充满时，共鸣技能替换为齿轨轮回。
停滞目标，造成湮灭伤害，牵引附近的目标。
施放该技能后，进入电锯模式，共鸣技能替换为解弦之眼。
施放该技能后一定时间内按下普攻，将会施放锯环·疾攻第2段。
施放该技能期间，按住共鸣技能，可持续攻击目标，并持续牵引附近的目标。期间松开共鸣技能或一段时间后，施放锯环·疾攻第1段。
skills.descEn:
Eye of Unraveling
Stagnate and deal Havoc DMG.
- While not in Chainsaw Mode, after casting this skill, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack on the ground or use Normal Attack in mid-air to cast Rending Lunge. This effect is removed when Chisa enters Chainsaw Mode.
- While in Chainsaw Mode and on the ground, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Sawring - Blitz Stage 2.
Can be cast in mid-air.

Serrated Loop
While on the ground and Ring of Chainsaw is full, Resonance Skill is replaced with Serrated Loop.
Stagnate targets, and deal Havoc DMG and pull in nearby targets.
Casting this skill sends Chisa into Chainsaw Mode and replaces Resonance Skill with Eye of Unraveling.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Sawring - Blitz Stage 2.
Hold Resonance Skill while casting this skill to continuously attack and pull in nearby targets. Release the Resonance Skill button in the duration or keep holding it for a certain period of time to cast Sawring - Blitz Stage 1.

skills.name: 即刻·归无
skills.desc:
造成湮灭伤害，并回复附近队伍中所有角色的生命值。
施放时进入万缕·汇终，持续15秒。
不处于电锯模式时，施放该技能后一定时间内短按普攻，将会施放普攻第2段。
该技能可在低空中施放。

万缕·汇终
锯环·疾攻、电锯模式·闪避反击、锯环·终结伤害倍率提升120%。
锯环·疾攻、电锯模式·闪避反击消耗【锯环残响】提供的锯环·终结倍率增加效果提升120%。
施放锯环·终结后提前结束万缕·汇终。
skills.descEn:
Deal Havoc DMG and recover HP for all nearby Resonators in the team. 
Casting this skill sends Chisa into Woven Myriad - Convergence for 15s.
While not in Chainsaw Mode, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

Woven Myriad - Convergence
The DMG Multipliers of Sawring - Blitz, Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter, and Sawring - Eradication are increased by 120%.
The bonus DMG Multiplier for Sawring - Eradication granted by Sawring- Blitz and Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter when Ring of Chainsaw is consumed additionally increases by 120%.
Casting Sawring - Eradication ends Woven Myriad - Convergence.

skills.name: 无解的命途
skills.desc: 队伍中的角色击败拥有虚无绞痕的目标时，重置千咲的共鸣技能解弦之眼冷却时间，该效果每3秒最多触发1次。
skills.descEn: When a Resonator in the team defeats a target marked by Unseen Snare, the Cooldown of Chisa's Resonance Skill Eye of Unraveling is reset, triggered up to once every 3s.

skills.name: 终点在此处
skills.desc:
施放变奏技能鸣响·再临或共鸣解放即刻·归无时，湮灭伤害加成提升20%，治疗加成提升20%，持续12秒。
队伍中拥有虚湮之线的角色击败拥有虚无绞痕的目标时，千咲获得解弦视界，持续3秒。
处于解弦视界下，队伍中拥有虚湮之线的角色造成伤害时，千咲对目标附加虚无绞痕，持续30秒。
skills.descEn:
Casting Intro Skill Reverberance - Return or Resonance Liberation Moment of Nihility grants 20% Havoc DMG Bonus and 20% Healing Bonus for 12s.
When Resonators in the team with Thread of Bane defeat a target marked by Unseen Snare, Chisa gains Sight of Unraveling, lasting 3s.
While in Sight of Unraveling, Chisa inflicts Unseen Snare that lasts for 30s on the targets damaged by Resonators in the team with Thread of Bane.

skills.name: 鸣响·再临
skills.desc:
攻击目标，造成湮灭伤害。
不处于电锯模式时，施放该技能后一定时间内短按普攻，将会施放普攻第2段。
处于电锯模式时，施放该技能后一定时间内按下普攻，将会施放锯环·疾攻第2段。
skills.descEn:
Attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG.
While not in Chainsaw Mode, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.
While in Chainsaw Mode, use Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Sawring - Blitz Stage 2.

skills.name: 解弦视界·万理归尘
skills.desc:
虚无绞痕
进行下述4种操作时，可为目标附加虚无绞痕，持续30秒。
·共鸣技能命中目标。
·施放齿轨轮回一定时间内，命中目标。
·闪避反击·解弦之眼·收弦命中目标。
·锁定目标。
拥有虚无绞痕的目标受到角色直接造成的伤害时，千咲为目标附加1层虚湮效应，该效果每2秒最多触发1次。

虚湮之线
对拥有虚无绞痕的目标造成伤害时，可无视其18%防御。

电锯模式
千咲处于电锯模式时，解锁锯环·疾攻、锯环·终结、电锯模式·闪避反击。
锯环·疾攻、电锯模式·闪避反击命中目标时消耗【锯环残响】。

锯环·疾攻
锯环·疾攻进行最多3段的连续攻击，造成湮灭伤害。
短按普攻将从锯环·疾攻第1段开始施放，长按普攻将从锯环·疾攻第2段开始施放。
施放锯环·疾攻第2段时，按住普攻，可持续攻击目标，锯环·疾攻第2段结束后，将会自动施放锯环·疾攻第3段。
施放锯环·疾攻第2段时，松开普攻或向后闪避，将自动施放锯环·疾攻第2段·折鸣，造成湮灭伤害，施放锯环·疾攻第2段·折鸣一定时间内，可以触发成功闪避效果。
施放锯环·疾攻第2段·折鸣一定时间内按下普攻，将会施放锯环·疾攻第3段。
施放锯环·疾攻第3段时，按住普攻，可持续攻击目标，锯环·疾攻第3段结束后，将会自动施放锯环·终结。
施放锯环·疾攻第3段时，松开普攻，将自动施放锯环·疾攻第3段·坠响，造成湮灭伤害。
锯环·疾攻伤害为共鸣解放伤害。

电锯模式·闪避反击
处于电锯模式时，成功闪避后一定时间内短按普攻，将会施放电锯模式·闪避反击，造成湮灭伤害。
施放电锯模式·闪避反击后一定时间内按下普攻，将会施放锯环·疾攻第3段。
施放电锯模式·闪避反击时，按住普攻，可持续攻击目标，电锯模式·闪避反击结束后，将会自动施放锯环·疾攻第3段。
施放电锯模式·闪避反击时，松开普攻或向后闪避，将自动施放锯环·疾攻第2段·折鸣。
电锯模式·闪避反击伤害为共鸣解放伤害。

锯环·终结
处于电锯模式时，进行下述2种操作时，施放锯环·终结。
·施放锯环·疾攻第3段·坠响后，下一次按下普攻。
·施放锯环·疾攻或电锯模式·闪避反击将【锯环残响】消耗至0后，下一次按下普攻。
锯环·终结攻击目标，造成湮灭伤害，附近队伍中所有角色获得护盾，持续30秒。
该技能伤害为共鸣解放伤害。
施放锯环·疾攻、电锯模式·闪避反击每消耗1点【锯环残响】，可增加下一次锯环·终结伤害倍率，最多计入100点。
施放该技能时，退出电锯模式并清空【锯环残响】。

【电锯热力】
处于电锯模式时，【命弦·本流】条替换为【电锯热力】条。
【电锯热力】初始为100%，
千咲在一定时间内没有造成伤害，【电锯热力】将快速衰减，衰减至0时，进入熄火状态，退出电锯模式。
处于电锯模式时，千咲造成伤害或施放共鸣解放即刻·归无、变奏技能鸣响·再临、锯环·疾攻第3段·坠响时，可重置【电锯热力】。
处于熄火状态时，【锯环残响】将快速衰减，衰减至0时，退出熄火状态。
处于熄火状态时，千咲造成伤害或施放共鸣解放即刻·归无、变奏技能鸣响·再临时，退出熄火状态。

命弦·掠行
不处于电锯模式且【命弦·本流】大于10时，进行下述5种操作时，可施放命弦·掠行，施放后消耗50点【命弦·本流】。
·施放重击跃起至落地期间，在空中短按闪避。
·处于空中时，施放共鸣技能解弦之眼或纷裂贯穿至落地期间，在空中短按闪避。
·施放撤弦后一定时间内向前闪避。
·被击飞至落地期间，短按闪避。
·施放命弦·掠行至落地期间，在空中短按闪避。
施放该技能时，可以牵引附近拥有虚无绞痕的敌人。
施放该技能期间，保持长按闪避可乘着武器滑翔一段距离。
施放该技能一定时间内，可以触发成功闪避效果。

【锯环残响】获取规则
【锯环残响】上限100点。
常态攻击、共鸣技能解弦之眼命中目标时，获得【锯环残响】。
施放共鸣解放即刻·归无时，获得40点【锯环残响】。
施放变奏技能鸣响·再临时，获得20点【锯环残响】。

【命弦·本流】获取规则
【命弦·本流】上限100点。
随时间持续获得【命弦·本流】。
千咲自身击败目标获得100点【命弦·本流】。
退出电锯模式时，重置【命弦·本流】至上限。
施放命弦·掠行一定时间内无法随时间持续获得【命弦·本流】。
skills.descEn:
Unseen Snare
Chisa inflicts Unseen Snare on the target for 30s in the following 4 ways:
- Hitting a target with Resonance Skill.
- Hitting a target within a certain period of time after casting Serrated Loop.
- Hitting a target with Dodge Counter - Eye of Unraveling: Retraction.
- Locking on to a target.
When targets marked by Unseen Snare take direct damage from Resonators, Chisa inflicts 1 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=1} of Havoc Bane on them. This effect can be triggered up to once every 2s.

Thread of Bane
When dealing damage to targets affected by Unseen Snare, ignore 18% of their DEF.

Chainsaw Mode
While in Chainsaw Mode, Chisa unlocks Sawring - Blitz, Sawring - Eradication, Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter.
Sawring - Blitz and Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter consume Ring of Chainsaw on hit.

Sawring - Blitz
Sawring - Blitz chains up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Havoc DMG.  
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack to start the combo from Sawring - Blitz Stage 1. Hold Normal Attack to start from Sawring - Blitz Stage 2.
Hold Normal Attack while casting Sawring - Blitz Stage 2 to continuously attack the target. Sawring - Blitz Stage 2 is automatically followed by Sawring - Blitz Stage 3.
While casting Sawring - Blitz Stage 2, release the Normal Attack button or Dodge without directional input to automatically cast Sawring - Blitz Stage 2: Discordance, dealing Havoc DMG. Shortly after casting Sawring - Blitz Stage 2: Discordance, successful Dodges can be triggered.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting Sawring - Blitz Stage 2: Discordance to cast Sawring - Blitz Stage 3.
While casting Sawring - Blitz Stage 3, hold Normal Attack to continuously attack the target. Sawring - Blitz Stage 3 is automatically followed by Sawring - Eradication.
Release Normal Attack during Sawring - Blitz Stage 3 to automatically cast Sawring - Blitz Stage 3: Falltone, dealing Havoc DMG.
Sawring - Blitz DMG is considered Resonance Liberation DMG.

Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter
While in Chainsaw Mode, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack following a successful Dodge to cast Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter, dealing Havoc DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack following Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter to cast Sawring - Blitz Stage 3.
Hold Normal Attack while casting Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter to sustain the attack. When Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter ends, cast Sawring - Blitz Stage 3 automatically.
Release the Normal Attack button or Dodge without directional input while casting Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter to cast Sawring - Blitz Stage 2: Discordance automatically.
Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter deals Resonance Liberation DMG.

Sawring - Eradication
While in Chainsaw Mode, Chisa casts Sawring - Eradication in the following 2 ways:
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack after casting Sawring - Blitz Stage 3: Falltone.
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack after consuming all Ring of Chainsaw with Sawring - Blitz or Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter.
Attacking targets with Sawring - Eradication deals Havoc DMG and grants Shields to all nearby Resonators in the team for 30s.
The skill DMG is considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
Every 1 point of Ring of Chainsaw consumed by Sawring - Blitz and Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter increases the DMG Multiplier of the next Sawring - Eradication. Up to 100 points will be counted toward this effect.
Casting this skill consumes all Ring of Chainsaw and ends Chainsaw Mode.

Chainsaw Fever
While in Chainsaw Mode, Lifethread - Jetstream is replaced with Chainsaw Fever.
Chainsaw Fever is at 100% by default.
When Chisa goes on for a period without dealing any damage, Chainsaw Fever will rapidly deplete. Once it reaches 0, Chisa enters the Burnout State and exits Chainsaw Mode.
While in Chainsaw Mode, Chisa resets Chainsaw Fever when dealing damage or when casting Resonance Liberation Moment of Nihility, Intro Skill Reverberance - Return and Sawring - Blitz Stage 3: Falltone.
While in the Burnout State, Ring of Chainsaw will rapidly deplete. Once it reaches 0, Chisa exits the Burnout State.
When in Burnout State, Chisa exits the state upon dealing damage, or casting Resonance Liberation Moment of Nihility and Intro Skill Reverberance - Return.

Lifethread - Glide
When Chisa is not in Chainsaw Mode and has more than 10 points of Lifethread - Jetstream, she can consume 50 points of Lifethread - Jetstream to cast Lifethread - Glide in the following 5 ways:
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Dodge in mid-air before landing after casting Heavy Attack.
- While in mid-air, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Dodge before landing after casting Resonance Skill Eye of Unraveling or Rending Lunge.
- Dodge forward shortly after casting Thread Withdrawn.
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Dodge before landing when launched into mid-air.
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Dodge before landing after casting Lifethread - Glide.
Casting this skill can pull in nearby enemies marked by Unseen Snare.
During the skill, hold Dodge to glide a short distance on the weapon.
Can trigger successful Dodges within a certain time after casting this skill.

Ring of Chainsaw
Chisa can hold up to 100 points of Ring of Chainsaw.
Hitting a target with Normal Attack  and Resonance Skill Eye of Unraveling grants Ring of Chainsaw.
Casting Resonance Liberation Moment of Nihility grants 40 points of Ring of Chainsaw.
Casting Intro Skill Reverberance - Return grants 20 points of Ring of Chainsaw.

Lifethread - Jetstream
Chisa can hold up to 100 points of Lifethread - Jetstream. 
Chisa continuously obtains Lifethread - Jetstream over time.
Chisa obtains 100 points of Lifethread - Jetstream upon defeating a target. 
Exiting Chainsaw Mode resets Lifethread - Jetstream to the max limit.
Chisa cannot obtain Lifethread - Jetstream passively for a short period of time after casting  Lifethread - Glide.

skills.descEn: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.

skills.name: 解弦式第零定律
skills.desc:
附近队伍中所有角色获得拖曳终焉之弦，持续20秒。
拖曳终焉之弦状态下：
·攻击命中后，使目标【异常效应】、【电磁爆发】层数上限增加3层，持续15秒。该效果无法叠加。
·附加【异常效应】或造成异常效应伤害后，获得虚湮之线，持续15秒。
skills.descEn:
Grant Resonant Thread of Closure to all nearby Resonators in the team for 20s.
While in Resonant Thread of Closure:
- When an attack hits, increase the max stacks of Negative Status and Electro Rage the target can receive by 3 for 15s. Unstackable.
- Inflicting Negative Status or dealing Negative Status DMG grants Thread of Bane for 15s.

skills.name: 谐度破坏·长刃
skills.desc: 目标【偏谐值】满时，可对其施放【谐度破坏】。
skills.descEn: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.

inherents.name: 无解的命途
inherents.desc: 队伍中的角色击败拥有虚无绞痕的目标时，重置千咲的共鸣技能解弦之眼冷却时间，该效果每3秒最多触发1次。

inherents.name: 终点在此处
inherents.desc:
施放变奏技能鸣响·再临或共鸣解放即刻·归无时，湮灭伤害加成提升20%，治疗加成提升20%，持续12秒。
队伍中拥有虚湮之线的角色击败拥有虚无绞痕的目标时，千咲获得解弦视界，持续3秒。
处于解弦视界下，队伍中拥有虚湮之线的角色造成伤害时，千咲对目标附加虚无绞痕，持续30秒。

chains.name: 穿行于荒芜长廊
chains.desc:
千咲施放锯环·疾攻、锯环·终结、电锯模式·闪避反击期间，免疫打断。

千咲附加虚无绞痕时，触发下述效果：
·自身攻击提升30%，持续15秒。
·对目标造成61803点固定湮灭伤害，最多可将目标生命扣除至61.80%，同一目标最多可受到1次该伤害。此次伤害为普攻伤害，不受伤害加成影响。
chains.descEn:
Chisa is immune to interruption during Sawring - Blitz,  Sawring - Eradication, and Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter

Inflicting Unseen Snare grants the following additional effects:
- Chisa's ATK is increased by 30% for 15s.
- Deal fixed 61803 points of Havoc DMG. The target's HP can be reduced to 61.80% at most and each target can take this damage only once. This instance of damage is considered Basic Attack DMG that does not bear any effect from damage bonuses.

chains.name: 织作牵绊的弦网
chains.nameEn: Into the Web of Endless Bonds
chains.desc:
造成伤害无视目标10%湮灭伤害抗性。
附近队伍中的角色处于虚湮之线状态时，全属性伤害加成提升50%。
chains.descEn:
Ignore 10% of the target's Havoc RES when dealing damage.
Nearby Resonators in the team with Thread of Bane gain 50% All-Attribute DMG Bonus.

chains.name: 踱过长夜的迷惘
chains.nameEn: Across the Confusion of the Long Night
chains.desc:
锯环·疾攻、电锯模式·闪避反击、锯环·终结的伤害倍率提升120%，该倍率提升效果与万缕·汇终的倍率提升效果相互叠加。
锯环·疾攻、电锯模式·闪避反击消耗【锯环残响】提供的锯环·终结倍率增加效果提升120%，该倍率提升效果与万缕·汇终的倍率提升效果相互叠加。
锯环·疾攻、电锯模式·闪避反击、锯环·终结破共振度能力提升50%。
chains.descEn:
The DMG Multipliers of Sawring - Blitz, Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter and Sawring - Eradication are increased by 120%. This effect is mutually stackable with that of Woven Myriad - Convergence.
The bonus DMG Multiplier for Sawring - Eradication granted by Sawring- Blitz and Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter when Ring of Chainsaw is consumed is increased by 120%. This effect is mutually stackable with that of Woven Myriad - Convergence.
The Vibration Strength Reduction Rate of Sawring - Blitz, Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter and Sawring - Eradication is increased by 50%.

chains.name: 斩断循环的劫章
chains.nameEn: Severing the Endless Cycle of Tragic Fate
chains.desc:
虚无绞痕效果替换为：
拥有虚无绞痕的目标受到角色直接造成的伤害时，千咲为目标附加1层【虚湮效应】，该效果每1秒最多触发1次。
chains.descEn:
The effect of Unseen Snare becomes:
When targets marked by Unseen Snare take direct damage from Resonators, Chisa inflicts 1 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=0} of Havoc Bane on them. This effect is triggered up to once every 1s.

chains.name: 万盏灯火将照亮归途所向
chains.nameEn: Thousands of Lights to Guide the Way Home
chains.desc:
共鸣解放即刻·归无的伤害加成提升100%。
命弦·掠行消耗的【命弦·本流】降低50%。
chains.descEn:
Resonance Liberation Moment of Nihility gains 100% DMG Bonus.
Lifethread - Glide costs 50% less Lifethread - Jetstream.

chains.name: 由此重铸希望，与天光
chains.nameEn: Thus, Hope is Rekindled with the Rising Dawn
chains.desc:
千咲施放锯环·疾攻、锯环·终结、电锯模式·闪避反击期间，受到致死伤害时不会倒下，最少保留1点生命。

虚无绞痕强化为虚无绞痕·终焉，获得下述效果：
·虚无绞痕·终焉拥有虚无绞痕的所有效果。
·拥有虚无绞痕·终焉的目标受到异常效应伤害加深30%。
·拥有虚无绞痕·终焉的目标受到千咲伤害提升40%。

skills.name: 泛彩流光
skills.desc:
普攻
短按或长按施放普攻，进行最多3段的连续攻击，造成衍射伤害。

空中攻击
消耗耐力进行空中下落攻击，造成衍射伤害。

闪避反击
成功闪避后一定时间内短按普攻，将会攻击目标，造成衍射伤害。

普攻·灵感碰撞
处于「光学取样」阶段时，如果【溢彩】已满，按住普攻进入蓄力状态。
蓄力期间，每0.2秒将15点【溢彩】转换为12.5%的【流光】，蓄力期间免疫打断且受到伤害降低50%。
松开普攻或【流光】满时，琳奈将根据当前转换的【流光】百分比造成衍射伤害：
普攻·灵感碰撞·1级：当前【流光】<50%
普攻·灵感碰撞·2级：50% ≤当前【流光】<100%
普攻·灵感碰撞·3级：当前【流光】=100%

绮彩巡游·普攻
绮彩巡游状态期间，普攻替换为绮彩巡游·普攻。
进行最多5段的连续攻击，造成衍射伤害。
【流光】达到120点时，绮彩巡游·普攻第1段和绮彩巡游·普攻第4段的追击能力提升。

绮彩巡游·地面重击
绮彩巡游状态期间，且处于地面时，按住普攻持续施放。琳奈持续消耗耐力攻击目标，造成衍射伤害，此次伤害为普攻伤害；松开普攻时，琳奈施放绮彩巡游·跃动集束，造成衍射伤害，此次伤害为普攻伤害。

绮彩巡游·空中重击
绮彩巡游状态期间，且处于空中时，长按普攻施放。消耗耐力攻击目标，造成衍射伤害，此次伤害为普攻伤害。
处于空中时无法刷新该技能释放次数，琳奈为登场角色且处于地面时刷新可释放次数。

绮彩巡游·空中攻击
绮彩巡游状态期间，空中攻击替换为绮彩巡游·空中攻击。
消耗耐力进行空中下落攻击，造成衍射伤害。

绮彩巡游·闪避反击
绮彩巡游状态期间，闪避反击替换为绮彩巡游·闪避反击。
成功闪避后一定时间内短按普攻，将会攻击目标，造成衍射伤害。
施放该技能后，若琳奈处于绮彩巡游，一定时间内短按普攻将会施放绮彩巡游·普攻第2段。
skills.descEn:
Basic Attack
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} or hold Normal Attack to perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Spectro DMG.

Mid-air Attack
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing Spectro DMG.

Dodge Counter
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG.

Basic Attack - Spark Collision
With full Overflow in the Optical Sampling Stage, hold Normal Attack to enter a charging state.
During this state, 15 points of Overflow will be converted to 12.5% of Lumiflow every 0.2s. Lynae is immune to interruption and takes 50% less DMG.
Upon releasing Normal Attack or when Lumiflow is full, Lynae casts Spark Collision of varying strengths based on the ratio of Lumiflow, dealing Spectro DMG:
- Spark Collision Lv. 1: Lumiflow <50%
- Spark Collision Lv. 2: 50% ≤ Lumiflow < 100%
- Spark Collision Lv. 3: Lumiflow=100%

Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack
While in Kaleidoscopic Parade, Basic Attack is replaced with Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack.
Perform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing Spectro DMG.
With 120 points of Lumiflow, Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 1 & 4 track enemies in a greater distance.

Kaleidoscopic Parade - Ground Heavy Attack
While in Kaleidoscopic Parade, hold Normal Attack on the ground to cast this skill. Consume STA to continuously attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG. Release to cast Kaleidoscopic Parade - Graffiti Blast, dealing Spectro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.

Kaleidoscopic Parade - Mid-air Heavy Attack
While in Kaleidoscopic Parade, hold Normal Attack in mid-air to cast this skill. Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.
Cannot gain new charges while in the air. The available charges reset when Lynae is the active Resonator and is on the ground.

Kaleidoscopic Parade - Mid-air Attack
While in Kaleidoscopic Parade, Mid-air Attack is replaced with Kaleidoscopic Parade - Mid-air Attack.
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing Spectro DMG.

Kaleidoscopic Parade - Dodge Counter
While in Kaleidoscopic Parade, Dodge Counter is replaced with Kaleidoscopic Parade - Dodge Counter.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG.
While in Kaleidoscopic Parade, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 2.

skills.desc:
施放普攻·视觉冲击后，琳奈会在地面留下颜料。处于颜料内的目标会被持续附加光致变染，每2秒触发一次，持续5秒。颜料存在时，切换共鸣模态不会影响该光致变染的附加效果。

琳奈处于队伍中时，科考摩托的动能储备上限提升600点。驾驶科考摩托时，自动进入绮彩巡游状态，且每秒回复20%的【流光】。
skills.descEn:
After casting Basic Attack - Visual Impact, Lynae leaves Spray Paint on the ground and continuously inflicts Photochromic Flux on targets within the Spray Paint for 5s, triggered once every 2s. When Spray Paint is on the ground, switching to another Resonance Mode doesn't affect the Photochromic Flux effects inflicted by the Spray Paint.

With Lynae in the team, the expedition motorbike's Energy Tank expands by 600 points. Lynae enters Kaleidoscopic Parade automatically while on the expedition motorbike and restores 20% of Lumiflow per second.

skills.name: 《自适应光学在生活中的实际应用》
skills.desc:
施放变奏技能·来点儿颜色瞧瞧时，9秒内自身的衍射伤害加成提升25%。

绮彩巡游状态期间，若琳奈不处于战斗状态，施放地面后闪时会为自身附加光学迷彩，持续15秒，施放非闪避技能或切换至其他角色时移除。若进行场景、玩法、功能交互、或进入战斗时，将强制移除光学迷彩。拥有光学迷彩时，琳奈进入目标的警戒范围将不会进入战斗状态。
skills.descEn:
Casting Intro Skill - Time to Show Some Colors! increases Lynae's Spectro DMG Bonus by 25% for 9s. 

During Kaleidoscopic Parade, if Lynae isn't in combat, dodging without directional input grants her Optic Camo for 15s, which will be removed when Lynae casts any skill other than dodging or is switched off the field. Performing environmental, gameplay or functional interactions, or entering combat, removes the Optic Camo. With Optic Camo, Lynae may enter the enemy's aggro range without triggering combat.

施放时，如果处于「光学取样」阶段，回复100点【溢彩】。
skills.descEn:

skills.name: 色光混合律
skills.desc:
「光学取样」阶段
琳奈初始处于「光学取样」阶段。「光学取样」阶段下，施放特定技能期间回复【溢彩】。

绮彩巡游
琳奈施放普攻·灵感碰撞时，进入绮彩巡游状态。绮彩巡游状态下，若琳奈处于地面移动状态或施放特定技能的一定时间内，会持续回复【流光】。绮彩巡游状态期间，琳奈无法进入行走状态，且跑步状态和冲刺状态替换为移速更快的自由轮滑和速度轮滑。

普攻·幻光折跃
绮彩巡游状态期间，至少拥有1/3【流光】上限时，跳跃替换为普攻·幻光折跃。
消耗1/3最大【流光】，造成衍射伤害，命中时为目标附加光致变染，施放一定时间内可以触发成功闪避效果。处于空中时可衔接下一段普攻·幻光折跃，最多连续施放3段，若切换至其他角色则会重置连段。
战斗状态期间，每次施放时获得1点【本色】。
施放普攻·幻光折跃·第1段一定时间内，若处于地面，短按普攻将会施放【绮彩巡游·普攻第2段】。
施放普攻·幻光折跃·第2段时，牵引周围目标。

普攻·虹彩飞溅
绮彩巡游状态期间，拥有3点【本色】且处于空中时，若普攻·视觉冲击处于冷却，短按普攻或共鸣技能，造成衍射伤害，并为命中的目标附加光致变染。
施放时消耗3点【本色】。
施放该技能期间，一定时间内短按普攻将会施放绮彩巡游·普攻第2段。

普攻·视觉冲击
绮彩巡游状态期间，拥有3点【本色】且处于空中时，若该技能不处于冷却，短按普攻或共鸣技能，造成衍射伤害，并为命中的目标附加光致变染。
施放时消耗3点【本色】，并使附近队伍中所有角色的谐度破坏增幅提升40点，持续30秒。
施放该技能期间，一定时间内短按普攻将会施放绮彩巡游·普攻第2段。

共鸣模态
普攻·幻光折跃、普攻·虹彩飞溅、普攻·视觉冲击和变奏技能·来点儿颜色瞧瞧命中目标时，为目标附加光致变染。
琳奈可以在共鸣模态·震谐状态和共鸣模态·集谐状态间切换：
·处于共鸣模态·震谐时，光致变染为目标附加【震谐·偏移】，持续25秒。
·处于共鸣模态·集谐时，光致变染为目标附加【集谐·偏移】，持续25秒。

震谐响应·光谱解析
琳奈对范围内处于【震谐·干涉】状态的目标造成衍射伤害，此次伤害为震谐伤害。

【溢彩】
上限120点。
琳奈处于「光学取样」阶段时，施放普攻、琳奈式创想、空中攻击、闪避反击期间回复【溢彩】，施放变奏技能时回复【溢彩】。
【溢彩】满时，可施放普攻·灵感碰撞。
施放普攻·灵感碰撞后清除所有【溢彩】。

【流光】
上限120点。
绮彩巡游状态下：
·处于地面/攀爬移动状态，或地面成功闪避，或施放绮彩巡游·普攻、绮彩巡游·地面重击、绮彩巡游·空中重击、绮彩巡游·闪避反击、加色混合、地面闪避技能、变奏技能、普攻·向着多彩的明天！的一定时间内，每秒回复20%的【流光】。
·处于地面/攀爬/游泳待机状态、不在场时、或施放上述技能的一定时间后，每秒失去20%的【流光】。
·不处于上述状态时，【流光】不会持续回复或失去。
退出绮彩巡游时清除所有【流光】。
【流光】达到120时，轮滑速度进一步提升，速度轮滑期间会持续消耗体力。

【本色】
上限3点。
处于战斗状态时，每次施放普攻·幻光折跃时，获得1点【本色】。拥有3点【本色】时，可施放普攻·虹彩飞溅和普攻·视觉冲击。
退出绮彩巡游状态时清除所有【本色】。
skills.descEn:
Optical Sampling Stage
Lynae is in Optical Sampling Stage by default. While in this state, Overflow recovers during certain skills.

Kaleidoscopic Parade
Casting Basic Attack - Spark Collision sends Lynae into Kaleidoscopic Parade. In this state, Lynae continuously recovers Lumiflow while moving on the ground or during certain periods of certain skills. Lynae will not Walk during this state, and her Running and Sprinting will be replaced by the faster Free Skating and Speed Skating.

Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap
While in Kaleidoscopic Parade, with at least 1/3 of the max Lumiflow, Jump is replaced by Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap.
Consume 1/3 of the max Lumiflow to deal Spectro DMG. Inflict Photochromic Flux on targets hit. Successful Dodges can be triggered within a certain time during this skill. While airborne, Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap chains up to 3 stages. Switching to another Resonator resets the combo.
While in combat, each stage of Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap cast recovers 1 point of True Color.
Within a certain time after Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap Stage 1 {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack on the ground to cast Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 2.
Casting Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap Stage 2 also pulls in nearby targets.

Basic Attack - Iridescent Splash
During Kaleidoscopic Parade, when Lynae is in mid-air with 3 points of True Color, and Basic Attack - Visual Impact is on cooldown, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack or Resonance Skill to deal Spectro DMG and inflict Photochromic Flux on targets hit.
This skill consumes 3 points of True Color.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack within a certain time during this skill to cast Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 2.

Basic Attack - Visual Impact
During Kaleidoscopic Parade, when Lynae is in mid-air with 3 points of True Color, and this skill is not on cooldown, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack or Resonance Skill to deal Spectro DMG and inflict Photochromic Flux on targets hit.
This skill consumes 3 points of True Color and grants all nearby Resonators in the team 40 points of Tune Break Boost for 30s.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack within a certain time during this skill to cast Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 2. 

Resonance Mode
Inflict Photochromic Flux when hitting a target with Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap, Basic Attack - Iridescent Splash, Basic Attack - Visual Impact and Intro Skill - Time to Show Some Colors!.
Lynae can switch between Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture and Resonance Mode - Tune Strain:
- When in Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture, Photochromic Flux inflicts Tune Rupture - Shifting on targets for 25s.
- When in Resonance Mode - Tune Strain, Photochromic Flux inflicts Tune Strain - Shifting on targets for 25s.

Tune Rupture Response - Spectral Analysis
Deal an instance of Spectro DMG, considered Tune Rupture DMG, to targets within range affected by Tune Rupture - Interfered.

Overflow
Lynae can hold up to 120 points of Overflow.
While in Optical Sampling Stage, Overflow recovers during Basic Attack, Lynae-Style Palettes, Mid-air Attack, and Dodge Counter, or when Intro Skill is cast.
When Overflow is full, Basic Attack - Spark Collision becomes available.
Casting Basic Attack - Spark Collision removes all Overflow.

Lumiflow
Lynae can hold up to 120 points of Lumiflow.
During Kaleidoscopic Parade:
- Restore 20% of Lumiflow per second when Lynae is moving on the ground/climbing, or performs a successful Dodge on the ground, or within a certain time during Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack, Kaleidoscopic Parade - Ground Heavy Attack, Kaleidoscopic Parade - Mid-air Heavy Attack, Kaleidoscopic Parade - Dodge Counter, Additive Color, ground Dodge, Intro Skill, or Basic Attack - To a Vivid Tomorrow!.
- Lumiflow starts to deplete by 20% per second while Lynae is staying still on the ground/climbing/swimming or off the field, or after a certain time following the use of the skills listed above.
- Lumiflow does not change while Lynae is not in any of the states described above.
Exiting Kaleidoscopic Parade removes all Lumiflow.
With 120 points of Lumiflow, Lynae's roller skating speed further increases. Speed Skating consumes STA over time.

True Color
Lynae can hold up to 3 points of True Color.
During combat, each time Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap is cast, gain 1 point of True Color. With 3 points of True Color, Basic Attack - Iridescent Splash and Basic Attack - Visual Impact become available.
Exiting Kaleidoscopic Parade removes all True Color.

skills.name: 巧手烹调
skills.desc: 当前角色烹饪时有概率产出特色料理
skills.descEn: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.

skills.name: 有空一起兜风！
skills.desc:
造成100%的衍射伤害。下一个登场的角色全伤害加深15%，共鸣解放伤害加深25%，持续14秒，若切换至其他角色则该效果提前结束。 
施放延奏技能时，退出绮彩巡游状态。
skills.descEn:
Attack the target and deal 100% Spectro DMG. The next incoming Resonator gain 15% All DMG Amplification and 25% Resonance Liberation DMG Amplification for 14s or until they are switched out.
Lynae leaves the Kaleidoscopic Parade state upon casting Outro Skill.

skills.name: 光谱解析
skills.desc:
琳奈拥有为目标附加【震谐·偏移】或【集谐·偏移】的能力。
琳奈拥有响应【震谐·干涉】和【集谐·干涉】的能力。
响应【震谐·干涉】：队伍中的角色对目标造成【谐度破坏】伤害并使其进入【震谐·干涉】状态时，琳奈将施放震谐响应·光谱解析，同一目标每8秒仅可受到1次该伤害。
响应【集谐·干涉】：目标每有一层【集谐·干涉】效果，琳奈自身的每点谐度破坏增幅会使自身对该目标造成的最终伤害提升0.12%。琳奈在编队中时，目标的【集谐·干涉】效果的层数上限增加1层。
此外，目标【偏谐值】满时，琳奈可对其施放【谐度破坏】。
skills.descEn:
Lynae can inflict Tune Rupture - Shifting or Tune Strain - Shifting on targets.
Lynae can respond to Tune Rupture - Interfered and Tune Strain - Interfered.
- Responding to Tune Rupture - Interfered: When any Resonator in the team deals Tune Break DMG and inflicts the Tune Rupture - Interfered state, Lynae casts Tune Rupture Response - Spectral Analysis. Each target can be damaged by this skill up to once every 8s.
- Responding to Tune Strain - Interfered: For each stack of Tune Strain - Interfered on the target, each point of Lynae's Tune Break Boost increases her total DMG against that target by 0.12%. When Lynae is in the team, the target's max stack limit of Tune Strain - Interfered is increased by 1.
When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, Lynae can cast Tune Break on the target.

inherents.name: 永不褪色！
inherents.desc:
施放普攻·视觉冲击后，琳奈会在地面留下颜料。处于颜料内的目标会被持续附加光致变染，每2秒触发一次，持续5秒。颜料存在时，切换共鸣模态不会影响该光致变染的附加效果。

琳奈处于队伍中时，科考摩托的动能储备上限提升600点。驾驶科考摩托时，自动进入绮彩巡游状态，且每秒回复20%的【流光】。

inherents.name: 《自适应光学在生活中的实际应用》
inherents.desc:
施放变奏技能·来点儿颜色瞧瞧时，9秒内自身的衍射伤害加成提升25%。

绮彩巡游状态期间，若琳奈不处于战斗状态，施放地面后闪时会为自身附加光学迷彩，持续15秒，施放非闪避技能或切换至其他角色时移除。若进行场景、玩法、功能交互、或进入战斗时，将强制移除光学迷彩。拥有光学迷彩时，琳奈进入目标的警戒范围将不会进入战斗状态。

chains.name: 应是肆意挥洒的年华
chains.nameEn: Days to be Painted Like a Canvas
chains.desc:
普攻·幻光折跃的伤害倍率提升120%。
颜料的持续时间提升100%，每6秒将处于颜料范围内的敌人向颜料中心进行一次牵引。
施放普攻·幻光折跃和普攻·视觉冲击期间免疫打断。
「光学取样」阶段期间，处于非战斗状态大于2秒时，回复120点【溢彩】，每2秒触发一次。
chains.descEn:
The DMG Multiplier of Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap is increased by 120%.
The duration of Spray Paint is increased by 100%. Targets within the range of Spray Paint are pulled in towards the center every 6s.
Lynae is now immune to interruptions during Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap and Basic Attack - Visual Impact.
During Optical Sampling Stage, after staying in a non-combat state for 2s, restore 120 points of Overflow every 2s.

chains.name: 驶向光彩交绘的彼方
chains.desc:
全伤害加深25%。
延奏技能额外获得以下效果：
施放延奏技能时，使下一个登场的角色全伤害加深25%，持续14秒，若切换至其他角色则该效果提前结束。
chains.descEn:
Gain 25% All DMG Amplification.
Outro Skill gains the following effect:
Casting Outro Skill now additionally grants the incoming Resonator 25% All DMG Amplification for 14s or until the Resonator is switched out.

chains.name: 为一瞬的绚烂
chains.desc:
普攻·视觉冲击和普攻·虹彩飞溅的伤害倍率提升90%。
战斗状态期间，【流光】大于等于120点时，每1秒获得一层预调色，上限25层。每层预调色使加色混合的衍射伤害加成提升55%。施放加色混合期间不会获得预调色，加色混合结束时，移除所有预调色。【流光】小于120点时，每0.5秒失去一层预调色。
非战斗状态期间，【流光】大于等于120点时，每0.5秒获取一层预调色，【流光】小于120点时，每1秒失去一层预调色。
chains.descEn:
The DMG Multiplier of Basic Attack - Visual Impact and Basic Attack - Iridescent Splash is increased by 90%.
While Lynae is in combat, when Lumiflow is at least 120 points, gain 1 stack of Premixed Hue every 1s, up to 25 stacks. Each stack of Premixed Hue increases the Spectro DMG Bonus of Additive Color by 55%. No Premixed Hue is gained while casting Additive Color. When Additive Color ends, remove all stacks of Premixed Hue. Lynae loses a stack of Premixed Hue every 0.5s when Lumiflow is below 120 points.
While Lynae is out of combat, with at least 120 points of Lumiflow, gain 1 stack of Premixed Hue every 0.5s; when Lumiflow is below 120 points, lose 1 stack of Premixed Hue every 1s.

chains.name: 灰影随风呼啸而去
chains.desc: 攻击提升20%。
chains.descEn: ATK is increased by 20%.

chains.name: 不羁未来的映想
chains.desc: 共鸣解放·爆炸喷涂的伤害倍率提升70%。
chains.descEn: The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation - Prismatic Overblast is increased by 70%.

chains.name: 以「我」为名的真彩
chains.desc:
每次施放绮彩巡游·跃动集束或绮彩巡游·空中重击时，为自身叠加1层心之彩，最多叠加3层，每层心之彩使目标受到普攻·虹彩飞溅和普攻·视觉冲击的伤害提升30%。施放普攻·虹彩飞溅或普攻·视觉冲击后，移除所有心之彩。
施放普攻·幻光折跃时，刷新绮彩巡游·空中重击的可施放次数。
施放绮彩巡游·空中重击期间免疫打断且受到伤害降低30%。
施放延奏技能·有空一起兜风！时，琳奈不会退出绮彩巡游状态。
【流光】上限由120提升至360。且【流光】达到上限时，轮滑速度进一步提升。
施放变奏技能时，若处于绮彩巡游状态，回复120点【流光】。
chains.descEn:
Each time Kaleidoscopic Parade - Graffiti Blast or Kaleidoscopic Parade - Mid-air Heavy Attack is cast, Lynae gains 1 stack of Color of Soul, up to 3 stacks. Each stack of Color of Soul increases the DMG the target takes from Basic Attack - Iridescent Splash and Basic Attack - Visual Impact by 30%. After casting Basic Attack - Iridescent Splash or Basic Attack - Visual Impact, all stacks of Color of Soul are removed.
Casting Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap resets the charges of Kaleidoscopic Parade - Mid-air Heavy Attack.
Lynae is immune to interruptions, and DMG taken is reduced by 30% during Kaleidoscopic Parade - Mid-air Heavy Attack.
Lynae now stays in Kaleidoscopic Parade after casting Outro Skill - Let's Hit the Road!.
The Lumiflow upper limit is increased from 120 to 360. At the max limit, Lynae's roller skating speed further increases.
If Intro Skill is cast during Kaleidoscopic Parade, restore 120 points of Lumiflow.

skills.name: 光犹如此
skills.desc:
普攻
进行最多4段的连续攻击，造成衍射伤害。
第3段攻击会发出飞刃，施放其他可造成伤害的技能或陆·赫斯处于后台时，飞刃会消失。

重击
消耗耐力跳至空中，造成衍射伤害。

空中攻击
在空中进行最多4段的连续攻击，造成衍射伤害，第4段为消耗耐力进行空中下落攻击。
空中的第2、3段普攻，可以通过短按普攻或短按跳跃施放。
通过短按普攻施放时，使用镰刀·剖解进行攻击。
通过短按跳跃施放时，使用镰刀·裁断进行攻击，对命中目标附加【集谐·偏移】，持续25秒，并使自己在1秒内受到的伤害降低15%。
作为登场角色在空中时，该技能连击段数不会被重置。
在空中时，长按普攻，消耗耐力进行空中下落攻击。

闪避反击
在地面成功闪避后一定时间内短按普攻，将造成衍射伤害。施放该技能后一定时间内短按普攻，将施放普攻第3段。
在空中成功闪避后一定时间内短按普攻，将会高速位移至目标位置，造成衍射伤害。
skills.descEn:
Basic Attack
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Spectro DMG.
Hurl out a whirling blade on Stage 3, which disappears when Luuk Herssen casts other skills that can deal damage or leaves the field.

Heavy Attack
Consume STA to jump into the air, dealing Spectro DMG.

Mid-air Attack
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks in mid-air, dealing Spectro DMG. Stage 4 is a Plunging Attack at the cost of STA.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack or Jump to perform Basic Attack Stage 2 and 3 in mid-air.
Luuk Herssen attacks with Scythe: Dissection when the input is Normal Attack.
Luuk Herssen attacks with Scythe: Resection when the input is Jump. He also inflicts Tune Strain - Shifting on the target hit for 25s and reduces DMG taken by 15% for 1s.
As the active Resonator, while in mid-air, this skill's cycle will not be reset.
While in mid-air, hold Normal Attack to perform a Plunging Attack at the cost of STA.

Dodge Counter
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge on the ground to deal Spectro DMG. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack right after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 3.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge in mid-air to flash toward the target, dealing Spectro DMG.

skills.name: 所有陨落在此重逢
skills.desc:
流金回潮
高速位移至目标位置，造成衍射伤害，并为命中目标附加【集谐·偏移】，持续25秒。
流金回潮拥有2次可施放次数。
可在空中施放。

斩杀日冕
每次施放普攻第4段或空中攻击第3段时，共鸣技能替换为斩杀日冕，斩杀日冕造成的伤害为普攻伤害，并为命中目标附加【集谐·偏移】，持续25秒。
斩杀日冕共有3个形态，依次为：斩杀日冕·环、斩杀日冕·破、斩杀日冕·曜。
施放任意形态斩杀日冕时，获得1层【终局之释义】，且下次施放的斩杀日冕会变为下个形态。
若切换至其他角色，则斩杀日冕的形态顺序会重置，且共鸣技能会替换回流金回潮。
可在空中施放。

斩杀日冕·环
造成衍射伤害，并使空中攻击重置为第1段。
下次按下普攻，可以施放普攻·流金贯行。
期间如果切换至其他角色或在空中施放闪避反击，则无法再施放普攻·流金贯行。

斩杀日冕·破
旋转冲锋，对沿途敌人造成衍射伤害，使空中攻击重置为第1段，并发出日髓碎刃。
下次按下普攻，可以施放普攻·流金贯行。
期间如果切换至其他角色或在空中施放闪避反击，则无法再施放普攻·流金贯行。

斩杀日冕·曜
投掷固相日髓，造成衍射伤害，并在地上形成日髓阵列。

普攻·流金贯行
高速位移至目标位置，造成衍射伤害，此伤害为普攻伤害。

日髓阵列
日髓阵列在5秒后会自动爆炸，造成衍射伤害，此伤害为普攻伤害。

终局之释义
使共鸣解放于永冻中释义伤害倍率提升25%，可叠加3层，施放共鸣解放于永冻中释义或切换至下个角色后移除。
skills.descEn:
Golden Reflux
Flash toward the target and deal Spectro DMG. Inflict Tune Strain - Shifting on the target hit for 25s.
Golden Reflux has 2 charges.
Can be cast in mid-air.

Aureole of Execution
Casting Basic Attack Stage 4 or Mid-air Attack Stage 3 replaces Resonance Skill with Aureole of Execution, which deals Basic Attack DMG and inflicts Tune Strain - Shifting on the target hit for 25s.
Aureole of Execution has 3 forms, including Aureole of Execution: Ring, Aureole of Execution: Breach, and Aureole of Execution: Glare.
Casting any form of Aureole of Execution grants 1 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=1} of Endnotes on the Endgame and switches Aureole of Execution to the next form in sequence.
Switching to another Resonator resets the cycle of Aureole of Execution and Resonance Skill is reset to Golden Reflux.
Can be cast in mid-air.

Aureole of Execution: Ring
Deal Spectro DMG, and reset the Mid-air Attack cycle to Stage 1.
The next Normal Attack triggers Basic Attack - Golden Impale.
Basic Attack - Golden Impale is no longer available if Dodge Counter is cast in mid-air or Luuk Herssen is switched out in the duration.

Aureole of Execution: Breach
Spin and dash forward, dealing Spectro DMG to enemies along the path and resetting the Mid-air Attack cycle to Stage 1. Then, hurl out an Ichor Blade.
The next Normal Attack triggers Basic Attack - Golden Impale.
Basic Attack - Golden Impale is no longer available if Dodge Counter is cast in air or Luuk Herssen is switched out in the duration.

Aureole of Execution: Glare
Hurl out Solid-State Ichor, dealing Spectro DMG and forming an Ichor Deposit on the ground.

Basic Attack - Golden Impale
Flash toward the target and deal Spectro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.

Ichor Deposit
Ichor Deposit detonates automatically after 5s, dealing Spectro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.

Endnotes on the Endgame
Increase the DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation Rewritten in Winter's Margins by 25%, stacking up to 3 times. Casting Rewritten in Winter's Margins or switching to another Resonator removes all stacks.

skills.desc:
造成衍射伤害，此伤害为普攻伤害。
可在空中施放。
skills.descEn:

skills.name: 雪下的脉搏
skills.desc:
队伍中的角色直接造成的伤害击败带有【集谐·干涉】效果的目标时：
如果陆·赫斯没有【续写白昼】效果，则获得【续写白昼】效果，且层数与目标的【集谐·干涉】层数相同。
如果陆·赫斯已有【续写白昼】效果，且目标的【集谐·干涉】层数大于陆·赫斯的【续写白昼】层数，则使陆·赫斯的【续写白昼】层数变为与目标的【集谐·干涉】层数相同。

【续写白昼】
队伍中的角色施放【谐度破坏】时，如果目标有【集谐·偏移】效果，则陆·赫斯失去所有【续写白昼】层数，使目标额外获得相同层数的【集谐·干涉】，最高可叠加至当前目标的【集谐·干涉】层数上限，该效果冷却时间为1秒。
陆赫斯失去意识时，不会继续获得【续写白昼】效果，同时已有的【续写白昼】效果失效。
【续写白昼】效果最多可叠加2层。
skills.descEn:
When Resonators in the team directly damage and defeat targets, if the targets are affected by Tune Strain - Interfered:
- If Luuk Herssen has no Perpetuating Daytime, gain stacks of Perpetuating Daytime equal to the stacks of Tune Strain - Interfered.
- If Luuk Herssen already has Perpetuating Daytime, and the target's stacks of Tune Strain - Interfered exceed the current stacks of Perpetuating Daytime, increase Perpetuating Daytime's stacks to match the target's Tune Strain - Interfered stacks.

Perpetuating Daytime
- When Resonators in the team casts Tune Break, if the target is affected by Tune Strain - Shifting,  Luuk Herssen loses all stacks of Perpetuating Daytime, then apply equal stacks of Tune Strain - Interfered on the target, up to the target's current Tune Strain - Interfered stack cap. Cooldown: 1s.
Luuk Herssen loses all stacks of Perpetuating Daytime and will not be able to obtain any new stacks when knocked out.
- Perpetuating Daytime stacks up to 2 times.

skills.name: 无因的医谕
skills.desc:
自身施放的技能对有【集谐·干涉】的目标直接造成伤害时，陆·赫斯每拥有10点谐度破坏增幅，本次伤害加深5%，最高加深30%。
附近队伍中所有角色为敌方怪物附加【集谐·偏移】或造成【谐度破坏】伤害后，陆·赫斯攻击提升25%，持续20秒。
skills.descEn:
When Luuk Herssen's skills directly damage targets affected by Tune Strain - Interfered, every 10 points of Tune Break Boost he has Amplifies this instance of damage by 5%, up to 30%.
After any nearby Resonator in the team inflicts Tune Strain - Shifting on the enemies or deals Tune Break DMG, Luuk Herssen's ATK increases by 25% for 20s.

skills.name: 注入黎明以前
skills.desc:
造成衍射伤害，为命中目标附加【集谐·偏移】，并发出日髓碎刃。
施放该技能后在空中可短按普攻施放空中攻击第二段·镰刀·剖解，或短按跳跃施放空中攻击第二段·镰刀·裁断。
skills.descEn:
Deal Spectro DMG. Hurl out an Ichor Blade and inflict Tune Strain - Shifting on the target.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack after this skill to cast Mid-air Attack Stage 2 - Scythe: Dissection or Jump to cast Mid-air Attack Stage 2 - Scythe: Resection.

skills.name: 自霜中诞生的火光
skills.desc:
空中攻击·判决大地裂响
共鸣技能斩杀日冕·曜投掷固相日髓后，一定时间内在空中按下普攻，可以施放空中攻击·判决大地裂响。
一跃而下，造成衍射伤害，此伤害为普攻伤害，落地时立即引爆日髓阵列，并回复全部耐力。
如果在该时间内施放共鸣解放于永冻中释义或切换至其他角色，则无法再施放空中攻击·判决大地裂响。

黄金的裁量
【日髓能流】满时，进入黄金的裁量状态，获得以下效果：
无法回复【日髓能流】，所有形态的共鸣技能斩杀日冕伤害倍率提升110%。
施放共鸣技能斩杀日冕·曜后，使接下来的空中攻击·判决大地裂响和日髓阵列伤害倍率提升110%。
每次施放共鸣技能斩杀日冕，消耗100点【日髓能流】。
当【日髓能流】清空时，退出黄金的裁量状态。

黄金诊律
陆·赫斯处于编队中时，使队伍其他角色获得【黄金诊律】，拥有【黄金诊律】的角色施放延奏技能时，如果下一个登场的角色是陆·赫斯，则移除队伍中所有角色的【黄金诊律】，使陆·赫斯获得200点【日髓能流】和12点协奏能量，24秒后使队伍中其他角色再次获得【黄金诊律】。该效果联机状态下不会生效。

日辉庇覆
处于非战斗状态大于4秒或施放变奏技能注入黎明以前时，获得1层【日辉庇覆】。
【日辉庇覆】上限为1层，受到敌方怪物攻击造成的伤害时，可消耗1层【日辉庇覆】，使自身免疫打断且受到伤害降低60%，持续1秒。该效果每秒可触发1次。

光雨裁下
在空中施放闪避时，陆·赫斯会短暂悬于空中，并发出日髓碎刃。
陆·赫斯悬于空中期间，持续消耗耐力。
陆·赫斯被击飞至落地期间，短按闪避，也可以触发该效果，但最多只能触发3次。处于地面状态或切换至其他角色3秒后，刷新该次数。

日髓碎刃
造成固定衍射伤害，此伤害为普攻伤害，不受伤害加成影响。
日髓碎刃同时只能存在一个，且无法触发逆势回击。
当附近没有可攻击的目标时，日髓碎刃无法发出。
施放其他可造成伤害的技能或陆·赫斯处于后台时，日髓碎刃会消失。

【日髓能流】获取规则
【日髓能流】上限为300点。
常态攻击、共鸣技能流金回潮、共鸣技能斩杀日冕、普攻·流金贯行、空中攻击·判决大地裂响命中时，能回复【日髓能流】。
施放变奏技能注入黎明以前时，回复100点【日髓能流】。
skills.descEn:
Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker
When the Solid-State Ichor of Resonance Skill Aureole of Execution: Glare is hurled out, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack in mid-air to cast Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker.
Slam down from the air to detonate the Ichor Deposit, dealing Spectro DMG (considered Basic Attack DMG) and recovering all STA.
Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker is no longer available when Resonance Liberation Rewritten in Winter's Margins is cast or Luuk Herssen is switched off the field.

Aureate Judge
With full Ichor Flow, enter the Aureate Judge state. In this state, Luuk Herssen gains the following effects:
- Ichor Flow does not restore. The DMG Multipliers of all forms of Resonance Skill Aureole of Execution increase by 110%.
- Casting Aureole of Execution: Glare increases the DMG Multiplier of the next Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker and Ichor Deposit DMG by 110%.
- 100 points of Ichor Flow is consumed each time Resonance Skill Aureole of Execution is cast.
- Aureate Judge ends when Ichor Flow depletes.

Golden Rule
When Luuk Herssen is in the team, all other Resonators in the team gain Golden Rule. When Resonators with Golden Rule cast Outro Skill and the incoming Resonator is Luuk Herssen, remove all Golden Rules on Resonators in the team and grant Luuk Herssen 200 points of Ichor Flow and 12 points of Concerto Energy. Resonators in the team gain Golden Rule again after 24s. This effect does not apply in Co-op Mode.

Dawnlit Keep
Luuk Herssen gains 1 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=6} of Dawnlit Keep when he stays out of combat for over 4s or casts Intro Skill Before Injection of Dawn.
Dawnlit Keep is capped at 1 stack. When taking damage from enemies, consume 1 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=9} of Dawnlit Keep to reduce the DMG taken by 60% and gain immunity to interruptions for 1s. This effect can be triggered once per second.

Radiant Reave
When Luuk Herssen performs Dodge in mid-air, he briefly stays airborne and hurls out an Ichor Blade.
Luuk Herssen consumes STA continuously while airborne.
If Luuk Herssen is launched into mid-air, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Dodge before landing to trigger this effect, up to 3 times. When he is on the ground or switched out for more than 3s, the trigger count is reset.

Ichor Blade
Deal fixed Spectro DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG that is not affected by any DMG Bonus.
Only one Ichor Blade can exist at a time. It cannot trigger Counterattack.
Ichor Blade cannot be launched without a nearby target.
Ichor Blade disappears when Luuk Herssen casts other skills that deal damage or leaves the field.

Ichor Flow
Luuk Herssen holds up to 300 points of Ichor Flow.
Normal Attacks, Resonance Skill Golden Reflux, Resonance Skill Aureole of Execution, Basic Attack - Golden Impale, and Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker restore Ichor Flow on hit.
Casting Intro Skill Before Injection of Dawn restores 100 points of Ichor Flow.

skills.name: 一场关于光的默辩
skills.desc:
陆·赫斯拥有为目标附加【集谐·偏移】的能力。
陆·赫斯拥有响应【集谐·干涉】的能力。

Luuk Herssen can respond to Tune Strain - Interfered.
When responding to Tune Strain - Interfered: For each stack of Tune Strain - Interfered on the target, each point of Luuk Herssen's Tune Break Boost increases his total DMG against the target by 0.12%. While Luuk Herssen is in the team, the max stack limit of Tune Strain - Interfered on a target is increased by 1.
When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, Luuk Herssen can cast Tune Break on the target.

inherents.name: 无因的医谕
inherents.desc:
自身施放的技能对有【集谐·干涉】的目标直接造成伤害时，陆·赫斯每拥有10点谐度破坏增幅，本次伤害加深5%，最高加深30%。

chains.name: 流金于灰白中灼烧
chains.desc:
空中攻击伤害加成提升150%。
【日辉庇覆】层数上限提升1层。
处于黄金的裁量状态时，施放共鸣技能斩杀日冕可获得1层【日辉庇覆】。
chains.descEn:
Luuk Herssen gains 150% Mid-air Attack DMG Bonus.
The max stack limit of Dawnlit Keep is increased by 1.
When in the Aureate Judge state, casting Resonance Skill Aureole of Execution grants 1 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=2} of Dawnlit Keep.

chains.name: 眼底尚有雪崩未止
chains.desc:
共鸣解放于永冻中释义伤害倍率提升60%，该倍率提升效果与【终局之释义】的倍率提升效果相互叠加。
固有技能无因的医谕效果中：对有【集谐·干涉】的目标造成伤害时，陆·赫斯每拥有10点谐度破坏增幅，伤害加深效果提升至10%，此效果最高加深由30%提升至60%
chains.descEn:
The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation Rewritten in Winter's Margins is increased by 60%. This DMG Multiplier increase effect is stackable with that of Endnotes on the Endgame.
Inherent Skill Uncaused Diagnosis is enhanced:
When Luuk Herssen deals damage to targets inflicted with Tune Strain - Interfered, every 10 points of Tune Break Boost he has now Amplify this instance of damage by 10%. This effect now increases the DMG Amplification up to 60% instead of 30%.

chains.name: 金雨浇筑你的脊骨
chains.desc:
黄金的裁量状态下所有形态的共鸣技能斩杀日冕伤害倍率提升136%，施放斩杀日冕·曜后，使接下来的空中攻击·判决大地裂响和日髓阵列伤害倍率提升136%。该倍率提升效果与共鸣回路黄金的裁量的倍率提升效果相互叠加。
固有技能雪下的脉搏获得强化：【续写白昼】效果可叠加上限提升至4层。
chains.descEn:
The DMG Multipliers of all forms of Resonance Skill Aureole of Execution are increased by 136% in the Aureate Judge state. Casting Aureole of Execution: Glare increases the DMG Multipliers of the next Mid-Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker and Ichor Deposit by 136%.
Inherent Skill Pulses Under the Snow is enhanced:
Perpetuating Daytime now stacks up to 4 times.

chains.name: 冻土之下，亦有新生
chains.desc: 队伍中的角色造成【谐度破坏】伤害后，使队伍中所有角色造成的伤害提升20%，持续20秒，无法叠加。
chains.descEn: After a Resonator in the team deals Tune Break DMG, all Resonators in the team deal 20% more DMG for 20s. This effect is unstackable.

chains.name: 穿过风雪构筑的静场
chains.desc:
变奏技能注入黎明以前和延奏技能致濒死以答伤害加成提升80%。
共鸣技能流金回潮伤害倍率提升50%，冷却时间降低2秒，可施放次数增加1次。
chains.descEn:
Intro Skill Before Injection of Dawn and Outro Skill Bow to the Last Light gain 80% DMG Bonus.
Resonance Skill Golden Reflux has its DMG Multiplier increased by 50% and Cooldown reduced by 2s, and gains 1 more charge.

chains.name: 冰原之上，铺开无垠曦光
chains.desc:
附近队伍中所有角色造成【谐度破坏】伤害时，使目标受到陆·赫斯所有形态的共鸣技能斩杀日冕、日髓阵列和空中攻击·判决大地裂响的伤害提升30%，持续25秒。
陆·赫斯每层【终局之释义】额外使共鸣解放于永冻中释义伤害加成提升40%，最高120%。
陆·赫斯对有【集谐·干涉】的目标造成伤害时，视为将目标当前的【集谐·干涉】提升2层，且此效果无视层数上限。
chains.descEn:
When nearby Resonators in the team deal Tune Break DMG, all forms of Resonance Skill Aureole of Execution, Ichor Deposit, and Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker deal 30% more DMG to the target for 25s.
Each stack of Endnotes on the Endgame additionally grants Resonance Liberation Rewritten in Winter's Margins 40% DMG Bonus, up to 120%.
When Luuk Herssen deals damage to targets inflicted with Tune Strain - Interfered, the stack count of Tune Strain - Interfered on the target is increased by 2. This effect ignores the max stack limit.

skills.name: 靶定线程
skills.desc:
普攻
进行最多4段的连续攻击，造成衍射伤害。
施放普攻第1段后，长按普攻，将会持续攻击目标，造成衍射伤害。持续长按一定时间后将会施放重击第1段。
普攻第3段命中目标且在施放后一定时间内长按普攻将会施放重击第2段。

重击
消耗耐力，甩出分子线造成衍射伤害。
重击第1段命中目标且持续长按普攻，将会施放重击第2段，造成衍射伤害。
重击第1段施放后一定时间内短按普攻将会施放普攻第3段。

空中攻击
消耗耐力进行空中下落攻击，造成衍射伤害。
施放该技能后一定时间内短按普攻将会施放普攻第2段。

闪避反击
成功闪避后一定时间内短按普攻，将会攻击目标，造成衍射伤害。
施放该技能后一定时间内短按普攻将会施放普攻第4段。
该技能命中目标后一定时间内长按普攻将会施放重击第2段。

普攻·线程撕裂
处于算法压缩状态时，普攻替换为普攻·线程撕裂。
进行最多4段的连续攻击，造成衍射伤害，本次伤害为重击伤害。

重击·单线程
处于算法压缩状态时，重击替换为重击·单线程。
消耗耐力攻击目标，造成衍射伤害。
施放该技能后一定时间内短按普攻且自身处于空中时，将会施放空中攻击·算法压缩。
施放该技能后一定时间内短按普攻且自身处于地面时，将会施放普攻·线程撕裂第2段。

重击·双线程
处于算法压缩状态时且【根权限】达到100点时重击·单线程替换为重击·双线程。
消耗耐力和所有【根权限】攻击目标，造成衍射伤害。
施放该技能后一定时间内长按或短按普攻且自身处于空中时，将会施放重击·多线程。
施放该技能后一定时间内短按普攻且自身处于地面时，将会施放普攻·线程撕裂第2段。

重击·多线程
消耗耐力攻击目标，造成衍射伤害并附加【骇破·偏移】。施放时若自身持有SQL，则使本次伤害倍率提升270%并移除SQL。
施放该技能后一定时间内短按普攻将会施放普攻·线程撕裂第2段。

空中攻击·算法压缩
处于算法压缩状态时，空中攻击替换为空中攻击·算法压缩。
消耗耐力进行空中下落攻击，造成衍射伤害。
施放该技能后一定时间内短按普攻将会施放普攻·线程撕裂第2段。

闪避反击·算法压缩
处于算法压缩状态时，闪避反击替换为闪避反击·算法压缩。
成功闪避后一定时间内短按普攻，将会攻击目标，造成衍射伤害。
施放该技能后一定时间内短按普攻将会施放普攻·线程撕裂第3段。
skills.descEn:
Basic Attack
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Spectro DMG.
Hold Normal Attack right after Basic Attack Stage 1 to continuously attack the targets, dealing Spectro DMG. Hold this skill for a certain amount of time to cast Heavy Attack Stage 1.
Hold Normal Attack shortly after Basic Attack Stage 3 lands to cast Heavy Attack Stage 2.

Heavy Attack
Consume STA to lash out against the enemies with Monowire, dealing Spectro DMG.
Hold Normal Attack after Heavy Attack Stage 1 lands to cast Heavy Attack Stage 2, dealing Spectro DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting Heavy Attack Stage 1 to cast Basic Attack Stage 3.

Mid-air Attack
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing Spectro DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.

Dodge Counter
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 4.
Hold Normal Attack shortly after this skill lands to cast Heavy Attack Stage 2.

Basic Attack - Thread Shredding
When in Algorithm Compaction, Lucy's Basic Attack is replaced with Basic Attack - Thread Shredding.
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Spectro DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.

Heavy Attack - Single Threading

Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill while airborne to cast Mid-air Attack - Algorithm Compaction.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill while on the ground to cast Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 2.

Heavy Attack - Dual Threading
When in Algorithm Compaction and Root Access reaches 100 points, Heavy Attack - Single Threading is replaced with Heavy Attack - Dual Threading.
Consume STA and all Root Access to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill while airborne to cast Heavy Attack - Multi-threading.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill while on the ground to cast Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 2.

Heavy Attack - Multi-threading
Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG and inflicting Hack - Shifting on the target. SQL can be consumed for a 270% increase in this attack's DMG Multiplier.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 2.

Mid-air Attack - Algorithm Compaction
When in Algorithm Compaction, Mid-air Attack is replaced with Mid-air Attack - Algorithm Compaction.
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing Spectro DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 2.

Dodge Counter - Algorithm Compaction
When in Algorithm Compaction, Dodge Counter is replaced with Dodge Counter - Algorithm Compaction.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 3.

skills.name: 协议突破
skills.desc:
共鸣技能·有效载荷
施放共鸣技能·有效载荷向前方突进造成衍射伤害并附加【骇破·偏移】。命中目标时将自动施放追加攻击，造成衍射伤害，同时激活共鸣技能·脉冲干扰。若突进攻击没有命中目标，则减少70%的冷却时间。若突进攻击施放过程中被打断或未施放完成，则不会减少冷却时间。
施放追加攻击后一定时间内短按普攻将会施放普攻第2段。
追加攻击命中目标后一段时间内长按普攻将会施放重击第2段。

共鸣技能·脉冲干扰
施放共鸣技能·脉冲干扰穿越目标造成衍射伤害并短暂停滞敌方目标。施放该技能后为露西附加非正式握手。
非正式握手：露西未处于算法压缩状态且为队伍中登场角色时，每秒持续获得【传输协议】，当【传输协议】达到100点、施放共鸣解放·网络行者或共鸣解放·暗网深潜后移除该效果。
施放该技能后一定时间内短按普攻将会施放普攻第2段。

共鸣技能·死锁
当【传输协议】达到100点或露西处于算法压缩状态下时，共鸣技能·有效载荷和共鸣技能·脉冲干扰替换为共鸣技能·死锁。
施放共鸣技能·死锁对目标造成衍射伤害同时附加【骇破·偏移】，此次伤害为重击伤害。
施放该技能后一定时间内短按普攻将会施放普攻·线程撕裂第2段。
施放共鸣解放·网络行者或共鸣解放·暗网深潜后，将重置共鸣技能·死锁的冷却时间。
skills.descEn:
Resonance Skill - Payload
Cast Resonance Skill - Payload to charge forward, dealing Spectro DMG and inflicting Hack - Shifting. Upon hitting the target, a follow-up attack is automatically triggered, dealing Spectro DMG and activating Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference. If no target is hit during the charge, reduce the skill CD by 70%. If the charge is interrupted or not successfully cast, the skill CD is not reduced.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after the follow-up attack to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.
Hold Normal Attack shortly after follow-up attack lands to cast Heavy Attack Stage 2.

Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference
Cast Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference to cut through the target, dealing Spectro DMG and briefly Stagnating the target, before granting Digital Handshake. 
Digital Handshake: When Lucy is not in Algorithm Compaction and is the active Resonator in the team, she gains TCP every second. This effect is removed when TCP reaches 100 points or when Resonance Liberation - Netrunner or Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive is cast.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.

Resonance Skill - Deadlock
When TCP reaches 100 points or Lucy is in Algorithm Compaction, Resonance Skill - Payload and Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference are replaced with Resonance Skill - Deadlock.
Cast Resonance Skill - Deadlock to attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG and inflicting Hack - Shifting, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 2.
Reset the CD of Resonance Skill - Deadlock after casting Resonance Liberation - Netrunner or Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive.

skills.name: 网络行者
skills.desc:
共鸣解放·网络行者
露西深潜赛博空间并展开协议界面，持续10秒。协议界面开启期间可选择共计7种不同的欺骗程式，每种欺骗程式消耗的Ram点数不同，初始露西拥有24点Ram点数。
处于协议界面时，露西会依次标记视野中一定范围内的目标，被标记的目标将会受到后续所有欺骗程式的效果。可通过调整露西的视角来标记更多目标。当视野中一定范围内无目标时，将无法施放任何欺骗程式。
处于协议界面时，当协议界面的持续时间结束或长按普攻，将对所有标记目标发起覆写篡改，造成衍射伤害并退出协议界面，此次伤害为重击伤害。当所有Ram点数消耗完毕或剩余Ram点数无法再施放任何欺骗程式时，点按普攻将对所有标记目标发起覆写篡改。
该技能可在低空施放。

欺骗程式·集群入侵
消耗2点Ram。拓展标记视角，施放效果后无需调整视野，直接标记露西周围一定范围内的所有目标，同时对周围的标记目标造成衍射伤害，此次伤害为重击伤害。
欺骗程式·义体故障
消耗4点Ram。使所有标记目标受到伤害提升5%，持续30秒。
欺骗程式·突破协议
消耗4点Ram。使所有标记目标降低5%的防御，持续30秒。
欺骗程式·突触熔融
消耗5点Ram。对一定范围内的所有标记目标造成衍射伤害，此次伤害为重击伤害。
欺骗程式·运动失能
消耗6点Ram。对所有标记目标造成骇破伤害并降低5%的攻击，持续30秒。
欺骗程式·武装故障
消耗5点Ram。使所有标记目标造成伤害时攻击有一定概率降低100%，持续30秒。
欺骗程式·赛博精神病
消耗6点Ram。干扰所有标记目标使其变为中立阵营，并削减共振度。转变阵营的效果只对轻波级敌人生效。

共鸣解放·暗网深潜
露西处于算法压缩状态且施放重击·多线程后，共鸣解放·网络行者替换为共鸣解放·暗网深潜。拥有共鸣解放·网络行者的所有效果，并使覆写篡改伤害倍率大幅提升。
施放共鸣解放·暗网深潜后或露西退出算法压缩状态，共鸣解放·暗网深潜替换为共鸣解放·网络行者。
该技能可在低空施放。
skills.descEn:
Resonance Liberation - Netrunner
Lucy deep dives into cyberspace and pulls up the Protocol Interface for 10s. While the Protocol Interface is active, choose up to 7 different Spoofing Program effects, each requiring different RAM costs. Lucy starts with 24 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=2} of RAM.
While in the Protocol Interface, Lucy marks targets within a certain range in her view. Marked targets will be applied with all Spoofing Program effects selected afterwards. Adjust Lucy's view to mark more targets. When no target is in view, no Spoofing Program can be applied.
While in the Protocol Interface, when either the duration expires or when Normal Attack is held down, Override is triggered, which deals Spectro DMG to all marked targets before closing the Protocol Interface, considered Heavy Attack DMG. When RAM runs out or is insufficient to activate any Spoofing Programs, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack to trigger Override on all marked targets. 
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

Spoofing Program: Ping
Requires 2 RAM. Extends field of view. Lucy marks and deals Spectro DMG to all nearby targets within the effective range without having to adjust the view, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
Spoofing Program: Cyberware Malfunction
Requires 4 RAM. Marked targets take 5% more DMG for 30s.
Spoofing Program: Breach Protocol
Requires 4 RAM. Marked targets' DEF is reduced by 5% for 30s.
Spoofing Program: Synapse Burnout
Requires 5 RAM. Deals Spectro DMG to all marked targets within a certain range, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
Spoofing Program: Cripple Movement
Requires 6 RAM. Deals Hack DMG to all marked targets and reduces their ATK by 5% for 30s.
Spoofing Program: Weapon Glitch
Requires 5 RAM. Causes all marked targets' attacks to have a chance to be reduced by 100% within 30s.
Spoofing Program: Cyberpsychosis
Requires 6 RAM. Convert all marked targets to neutral units and reduce their Vibration Strength. Only effective against Common Class enemies.

Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive
When in Algorithm Compaction, after Heavy Attack - Multi-threading is cast, Resonance Liberation - Netrunner is replaced with Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive. Lucy gains all effects of Resonance Liberation - Netrunner, and the DMG Multiplier of Override is greatly increased.
After casting Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive, or when Lucy exits the Algorithm Compaction state, Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive is replaced with Resonance Liberation - Netrunner.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

skills.desc:
露西为队伍中登场角色且8秒内不受到任何伤害时，为自身添加1层光学欺骗效果，该效果初始上限为1层。
光学欺骗：受到攻击时使该次伤害降低100%，若该次攻击使自身处于受击或被击飞状态，将会立即自动脱离受击状态或被击飞状态，若此时处于地面则触发成功闪避效果，效果触发后移除1层光学欺骗。该效果0.5秒内只能触发1次。

Optical Illusion: When attacked, reduce this instance of DMG by 100%. If Lucy is hit or launched from the attack, she immediately recovers and triggers a successful Dodge if she's on the ground. After this effect is triggered, remove 1 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=4} of Optical Illusion. This effect can be triggered up to 1 {Cus:Sap,S=time P=times SapTag=6} every 0.5s.

skills.name: 进程破解
skills.desc:
共鸣技能·有效载荷、共鸣技能·脉冲干扰或共鸣技能·死锁对怒涛级或海啸级敌人造成伤害时，露西为其附加傀儡标记，持续2分钟。傀儡标记持续时间内，队伍中的角色直接造成的伤害击败该目标时，露西获得【网络后门】效果，若丽贝卡在队伍中则也能获得同等效果。

【网络后门】
全伤害加深10%，骇破伤害倍率提升10%。效果持续2分钟，最多叠加2层。当叠加至2层时，额外获得全伤害加深5%，骇破伤害倍率提升5%。露西失去意识时，不会继续获得【网络后门】效果，同时已有的【网络后门】效果失效。
skills.descEn:
When Resonance Skill - Payload, Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference, or Resonance Skill - Deadlock damages an Overlord Class or Calamity Class enemy, Lucy applies Botnet Mark on them for 2 min. While Botnet Mark is active, when a Resonator in the team defeats that target with direct damage, Lucy gains the Network Backdoor effect. If Rebecca is in the team, she gains the same effect.

Network Backdoor
Grants 10% All DMG Amplification and 10% additional Hack DMG Multiplier. This effect lasts for 2 min and stacks up to 2 times. At 2 stacks, additionally increases All DMG Amplification by 5% and Hack DMG Multiplier by 5%. 施放该技能后，若露西未处于算法压缩状态，则一定时间内短按普攻将会施放普攻第2段。
施放该技能后，若露西处于算法压缩状态，则一定时间内短按普攻将会施放普攻·线程撕裂第2段。
施放该技能后，下一次施放共鸣技能·脉冲干扰时额外获得20点【传输协议】。
skills.descEn:
Attack the target, dealing Spectro DMG and granting Resonators in the team Involuntary Sharing, allowing them to see targets behind obstacles for 25s. Additionally, Involuntary Sharing is enhanced on Rebecca, allowing her to lock onto targets behind obstacles. If Rebecca's turret is on the field, its Overload effect is activated, increasing its DMG dealt for 4s.
If Lucy is not in Algorithm Compaction after casting this skill, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack within a certain time to cast Basic Attack Stage 2.
If Lucy is in Algorithm Compaction after casting this skill, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack within a certain time to cast Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage 2.
After casting this skill, the next Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference additionally grants 20 points of TCP.

skills.name: 黑墙深度
skills.desc:
云端接口
露西未处于算法压缩状态下时，攻击命中目标会获得【传输协议】。当【传输协议】达到100点时，共鸣技能·有效载荷和共鸣技能·脉冲干扰替换为共鸣技能·死锁。
施放共鸣解放·网络行者或共鸣解放·暗网深潜后会清空【传输协议】进度。

算法压缩
施放共鸣技能·死锁后露西进入算法压缩状态，并获得1层SQL。普攻替换为普攻·线程撕裂，重击替换为重击·单线程。自身衍射伤害加成提升65%，持续8秒。
算法压缩状态下，再次施放共鸣技能·死锁不会重复获得SQL和衍射伤害加成效果。
算法压缩状态下，普攻·线程撕裂、重击·单线程等攻击命中目标时可获得【根权限】。当【根权限】达到100点时，重击·单线程替换为重击·双线程。施放重击·双线程后短时间内点按普攻或长按普攻将会施放重击·多线程。
施放重击·多线程时若自身持有SQL，则使本次伤害倍率提升270%并移除SQL。
施放重击·多线程时若自身未持有SQL，则损失20%的当前生命值；当露西生命值低于1%时，不消耗生命值。
施放重击·多线程后共鸣解放·网络行者替换为共鸣解放·暗网深潜。
施放共鸣解放·网络行者、共鸣解放·暗网深潜后，或施放重击·多线程后8秒内不施放指定技能，将会退出算法压缩状态。指定技能包括：常态攻击·靶定线程、共鸣技能·协议突破、变奏技能·过时幻觉、谐度破坏·数据崩解。

骇破响应·数据崩解
露西对处于【骇破·干涉】状态的目标造成衍射伤害并附加数据崩解效果。此次伤害为骇破伤害。
数据崩解：当目标攻击造成伤害后触发，停滞目标0.5秒。效果触发后移除数据崩解。

【传输协议】获取规则
【传输协议】上限100点。
普攻、重击、空中攻击、闪避反击造成伤害时，获得【传输协议】。
共鸣技能·有效载荷、共鸣技能·脉冲干扰造成伤害时，获得【传输协议】。
施放变奏技能·过时幻觉后，下一次施放共鸣技能·脉冲干扰时额外获得20点【传输协议】。

【根权限】获取规则
【根权限】上限100点。
普攻·线程撕裂、重击·单线程、空中攻击·算法压缩、闪避反击·算法压缩造成伤害时，获得【根权限】。
skills.descEn:
Cloud Portal
When not in Algorithm Compaction, Lucy gains TCP upon hitting a target. At 100 points of TCP, Resonance Skill - Payload and Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference are replaced with Resonance Skill - Deadlock.
Casting Resonance Liberation - Netrunner or Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive clears all TCP.

Algorithm Compaction
After casting Resonance Skill - Deadlock, Lucy enters Algorithm Compaction and gains 1 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=1} of SQL. Her Basic Attack is replaced with Basic Attack - Thread Shredding, and Heavy Attack is replaced with Heavy Attack - Single Threading. Lucy's Spectro DMG Bonus is increased by 65% for 8s.
While in Algorithm Compaction, casting Resonance Skill - Deadlock again will not grant SQL and Spectro DMG Bonus repetitively.
When in Algorithm Compaction, Lucy gains Root Access upon hitting a target with attacks including Basic Attack - Thread Shredding and Heavy Attack - Single Threading. Reaching 100 points of Root Access replaces Heavy Attack - Single Threading with Heavy Attack - Dual Threading. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting Heavy Attack - Dual Threading to cast Heavy Attack - Multi-threading.
When casting Heavy Attack - Multi-threading, if Lucy has SQL, increase this attack's DMG Multiplier by 270% and remove SQL.
When casting Heavy Attack - Multi-threading, if Lucy does not have SQL, she loses 20% of current HP. If Lucy's HP is below 1%, no HP is consumed.
After casting Heavy Attack - Multi-threading, Resonance Liberation - Netrunner is replaced with Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive.
Lucy exits the the Algorithm Compaction state after casting Resonance Liberation - Netrunner or Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive, or Heavy Attack - Multi-threading is not followed up by one of these skills: Normal Attack - Locked Thread, Resonance Skill - Protocol Breach, Intro Skill - Outdated Hallucination, and Tune Break - Data Crash.

Hack Response - Data Crash
Lucy deals Spectro DMG to a target inflicted with Hack - Interfered and applies the same target with Data Crash, considered Hack DMG.
Data Crash: After the target deals damage, Stagnate the target for 0.5s. Data Crash is removed after this effect is triggered.

TCP
Lucy holds up to 100 points of TCP.
Lucy gains TCP when she deals damage through Basic Attack, Heavy Attack, Mid-air Attack, Dodge Counter.
Lucy gains TCP when she deals damage through Resonance Skill - Payload and Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference.
After casting Intro Skill - Outdated Hallucination, casting the next Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference additionally grants 20 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=A} of TCP.

Root Access
Lucy holds up to 100 points of Root Access.
Lucy gains Root Access when she deals damage through Basic Attack - Thread Shredding, Heavy Attack - Single Threading, Mid-air Attack - Algorithm Compaction, and Dodge Counter - Algorithm Compaction.

skills.desc:
下一名登场角色普攻伤害加深25%，持续14秒，若切换至其他角色则该效果提前结束。
队伍中的角色获得反制程序效果，持续25秒。

全伤害加深10%，骇破伤害倍率提升10%。效果持续2分钟，最多叠加2层。当叠加至2层时，额外获得全伤害加深5%，骇破伤害倍率提升5%。露西失去意识时，不会继续获得【网络后门】效果，同时已有的【网络后门】效果失效。

skills.name: 攻防转换
skills.desc:
御反之隙
拥有【刚柔化势】时，施放重击后发制人或变奏技能携攻守阵后一定时间内，短按普攻，可施放御反之隙。

御反之隙命中目标时消耗1点【刚柔化势】，同时获得护盾。
在施放变奏技能携攻守阵后使用普攻，可直接施放御反之隙。
 
刚柔化势获取规则
【刚柔化势】上限3点。
第4段普攻会消耗桃祈所有的【磐岩护壁】，并获得同等数量的【刚柔化势】。
磐岩护壁持续期间，队伍中登场角色受到攻击时，消耗1个【磐岩护壁】，回复【刚柔化势】。
磐岩护壁结束后，会消耗剩余的【磐岩护壁】，并获得等同数量的【刚柔化势】。
skills.descEn:
Timed Counters
When carrying "Resolving Caliber", use Basic Attack after Heavy Attack Strategic Parry or Intro Skill Defense Formation to cast Timed Counters, performing up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Havoc DMG, considered as Basic Attack DMG.
Timed Counters consume 1 "Resolving Caliber" upon hitting an enemy to grant a shield.
After casting the Intro Skill Defense Formation, use Basic Attack to directly cast Timed Counters.

Resolving Caliber
Taoqi can hold up to 3 Resolving Caliber.
Basic Attack 4 will consume all of Taoqi's "Rocksteady Shields" to grant that many "Resolving Caliber".
While Rocksteady Shield exists, when the active character is attacked, 1 "Rocksteady Shield" will be consumed to recover "Resolving Caliber".
After Rocksteady Shield ends, all remaining "Rocksteady Shield" will be consumed to grant that many "Resolving Caliber".

重击

空中攻击

闪避反击

skills.descEn:
Basic Attack
Danjin performs up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Havoc DMG.
 
Heavy Attack
Danjin consumes STA to launch consecutive attacks, dealing Havoc DMG.
 
Mid-air Attack
Consume STA to perform a Mid-air Plunging Attack, dealing Havoc DMG.
 
Dodge Counter
Use Basic Attack after a successful Dodge to launch an attack, dealing Havoc DMG.
 
Dodge Counter: Ruby Shades
After a successful Dodge Counter, Danjin can use Resonance Skill Crimson Fragment to perform Resonance Skill: Crimson Erosion.

skills.desc:
施放朱华残章时，每次攻击消耗丹瑾生命上限3%的生命值；当丹瑾生命低于1%时，不消耗生命值。
 
赤华
攻击目标，造成湮灭伤害。
 
朱蚀
在第2段普攻、闪避反击或变奏技能击雠施放后，短按共鸣技能，可进行最多2段的连续攻击，造成湮灭伤害。
第2段朱蚀命中时目标时，对目标附加朱蚀之刻。
 
朱蚀之刻
丹瑾攻击携带朱蚀之刻的目标时，造成的伤害提升20%。
 
烬灭
在第3段普攻后短按共鸣技能，可进行最多3段的连续攻击，造成湮灭伤害。
skills.descEn:
When casting Crimson Fragment, each attack consumes 3% of Danjin's max HP. When Danjin's HP is less than 1%, this no longer consumes HP.
 
Carmine Gleam
Danjin attacks the target, dealing Havoc DMG.
 
Crimson Erosion
After Basic Attack 2, Dodge Counter or Intro Skill Vindication, use Resonance Skill to perform up to 2 consecutive strikes, dealing Havoc DMG.
When Crimson Erosion 2 hits a target, apply Incinerating Will to it.
 
Incinerating Will
Danjin's damage dealt to targets marked with Incinerating Will is increased by 20%.
 
Sanguine Pulse
Use Resonance Skill after Basic Attack 3 to perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Havoc DMG.

skills.descEn: Damage of Resonance Skill Crimson Erosion triggered by Dodge Counter: Ruby Shades is increased by 20%. The HP cost and stacks of Ruby Blossom recovered are doubled.

skills.name: 击雠

skills.descEn: With unwavering determination, Danjin unleashes a strike, dealing Havoc DMG.

skills.desc:

若【彤华】积攒至120点时，则消耗120点【彤华】，此次缭乱和纷落的伤害倍率提升。
 
重击·纷落
重击缭乱后一定时间内短按普攻，将会施放纷落攻击目标，造成湮灭伤害，此次伤害为重击伤害。

施放共鸣技能朱华残章时，回复【彤华】。
skills.descEn:

skills.name: 盛放与凋零的轮舞
skills.desc:
红椿盛绽
攻击目标，造成湮灭伤害，并进入盛绽状态，此次伤害为普攻伤害。
可在空中施放。
 
盛绽状态
·椿缠绕藤蔓期间无法移动；
·普攻和重击修枝替换为普攻蔓舞，进行最多4段的连续攻击，造成湮灭伤害，此次伤害为普攻伤害;
·施放普攻第3段蔓舞时，长按普攻，将会施放普攻烬华蔓舞，造成湮灭伤害，并自动施放普攻第4段蔓舞;
·闪避反击替换为闪避反击偿赎，成功闪避后一定时间内短按普攻，将会攻击目标，造成湮灭伤害，此次伤害为普攻伤害；
·共鸣技能替换为共鸣技能黯蕊猎心，施放黯蕊猎心时，将会攻击目标，造成湮灭伤害，此次伤害为普攻伤害；
·可在空中施放共鸣技能黯蕊猎心；
·施放共鸣技能黯蕊猎心后，将会退出盛绽状态;
·施放控物时，将会退出盛绽状态；
·跳跃替换为普攻旋舞，短按跳跃，将会消耗耐力攻击目标，造成湮灭伤害，此次伤害为普攻伤害，并退出盛绽状态；
·在空中施放普攻蔓舞、普攻烬华蔓舞，将会消耗耐力；
·施放共鸣技能黯蕊猎心时，无法回复耐力；
·在空中缠绕藤蔓期间，持续消耗耐力。
skills.descEn:
Crimson Blossom
Attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG (considered Basic Attack DMG), then enter Blossom Mode.
This attack can be performed in mid-air.
 
Blossom Mode
- Unable to move while suspended on vines.
- Basic Attack and Heavy Attack Pruning are replaced by Basic Attack Vining Waltz: chain together 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Havoc DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.
- When performing Vining Waltz Stage 3, hold Normal Attack Button to cast Blazing Waltz that deals Havoc DMG before automatically performing Vining Waltz Stage 4.
- Dodge Counter is replaced by Dodge Counter Atonement. Tap Normal Attack Button right after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.
- Resonance Skill is replaced by Resonance Skill Floral Ravage. Casting Floral Ravage deals Havoc DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.
- Resonance Skill Floral Ravage can be cast in mid-air.
- Blossom Mode ends after casting Resonance Skill Floral Ravage.
- Blossom Mode ends after using the Levitator.
- Jump is replaced with Basic Attack Vining Ronde. Use Jump to attack the target at the cost of STA, dealing Havoc DMG (considered Basic Attack DMG). This ends the Blossom Mode.
- Using Basic Attack Vining Waltz and Basic Attack Blazing Waltz in mid-air consumes STA.
- Casting Resonance Skill Floral Ravage doesn't restore STA.
- Consume STA continuously to stay suspended on the vines.

skills.name: 植物性宇宙
skills.desc:
常态攻击、普攻蔓舞、普攻烬华蔓舞、普攻旋舞、闪避反击偿赎、共鸣技能红椿盛绽、共鸣技能黯蕊猎心命中目标时，消耗【红椿·蕊】，此次攻击的基础共鸣能量回复效率提升150%。
每消耗10点【红椿·蕊】，回复4点协奏能量，并获得1层红椿·蕾，持续15秒，可叠加10层。
 
共鸣回路·一日花
当协奏能量充满时，若一日花不处于冷却状态，共鸣技能替换为一日花。
施放一日花时，消耗70点协奏能量，并攻击目标，造成湮灭伤害，此次伤害为普攻伤害。
施放一日花时，进入含苞状态。
可在空中施放。
 
含苞状态
·酣梦：常态攻击、普攻蔓舞、普攻烬华蔓舞、普攻旋舞、闪避反击偿赎、共鸣技能红椿盛绽、共鸣技能黯蕊猎心的伤害倍率提升50%；
·施放一日花时，清除所有红椿·蕾，每层红椿·蕾使酣梦的伤害倍率提升效果额外提升5%，最多可额外提升50%； 
·含苞状态期间，无法获得红椿·蕾；
·含苞状态期间，常态攻击、普攻蔓舞、普攻烬华蔓舞、普攻旋舞、闪避反击偿赎、共鸣技能红椿盛绽、共鸣技能黯蕊猎心的基础共鸣能量回复效率降低至0%；
·切换至其他角色时，将提前结束含苞状态；
·消耗完【红椿·蕊】时，将提前结束含苞状态。
 
红椿·蕊获取规则
上限100点。
施放变奏技能八千春秋时，回复100点【红椿·蕊】。
施放共鸣回路一日花时，回复100点【红椿·蕊】。
skills.descEn:
Hitting a target with Normal Attack, Basic Attack Vining Waltz, Basic Attack Blazing Waltz, Basic Attack Vining Ronde, Dodge Counter Atonement , Resonance Skill Crimson Blossom, and Resonance Skill Floral Ravage consumes Crimson Pistils. The Energy Regen Multiplier of this attack is increased by 150%.
Consuming 10 Crimson Pistils recovers 4 Concerto Energy and obtains 1 Crimson Bud(s). Each bud lasts for 15s, stacking up to 10 times.
 
Forte Circuit: Ephemeral
When Concerto Energy is fully recovered, and Ephemeral is not on Cooldown, Resonance Skill is replaced with Ephemeral.
Casting Ephemeral consumes 70 Concerto Energy and deals Havoc DMG to the targets. This damage is considered Basic Attack DMG.
Camellya enters Budding Mode after casting Ephemeral.
This can be cast in mid-air.
 
Budding Mode
- Sweet Dream: Increase the DMG Multiplier of Normal Attack, Basic Attack Vining Waltz, Basic Attack Blazing Waltz, Basic Attack Vining Ronde, Dodge Counter Atonement, Resonance Skill Crimson Blossom, and Resonance Skill Floral Ravage by 50%.
- Casting Ephemeral consumes all Crimson Buds. Each Crimson Bud consumed additionally increases the DMG Multiplier of Sweet Dream by 5%, up to 50%. 
- When in Budding Mode, Camellya cannot gain Crimson Buds.
- When in Budding Mode, the Energy Regen Multiplier of Normal Attack, Basic Attack Vining Waltz, Basic Attack Blazing Waltz, Basic Attack Vining Ronde, Dodge Counter Atonement, Resonance Skill Crimson Blossom, and Resonance Skill Floral Ravage is reduced to 0%.
- Budding Mode ends when Camellya is switched off the field.
- Budding Mode ends when all Crimson Pistils are consumed.
 
Crimson Pistil
Camellya can hold up to 100 Crimson Pistils.
- Casting Intro Skill Everblooming recovers 100 Crimson Pistils.
- Activating Forte Circuit's Ephemeral recovers 100 Crimson Pistils.

共鸣回路永生花免疫打断。

闪避反击

skills.desc:
灭音
【暗流】充满时，长按普攻将会施放灭音攻击目标，造成湮灭伤害，此次伤害为重击伤害。
 
暗涌状态
施放灭音后，进入暗涌状态，在该状态下：
·普攻替换为强化普攻，可进行最多5段的连续攻击，造成湮灭伤害； 
·重击替换为强化重击；
·施放强化重击后短按普攻，将会施放重击鸣刃攻击目标，造成湮灭伤害，此次伤害为重击伤害；
·施放重击鸣刃后短按普攻，将会施放第3段强化普攻攻击目标，造成湮灭伤害；
·共鸣技能行刃替换为共鸣技能破命，化音为刃攻击目标，造成湮灭伤害。
 
暗流获取规则
【暗流】上限100点。
常态攻击裁羽弑音命中目标时，可积攒【暗流】。
施放共鸣技能行刃时，可积攒【暗流】。
施放共鸣技能破命时，可积攒【暗流】。
施放变奏技能化刹时，可积攒【暗流】。
skills.descEn:
Devastation
When "Umbra" is full, hold Basic Attack to cast Devastation to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.
 
Dark Surge
After casting Devastation, Rover enters the Dark Surge state. In this state:
-Basic Attack is replaced with Enhanced Basic Attack, which performs up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing Havoc DMG.
-Heavy Attack is replaced with Enhanced Heavy Attack;
-Use Basic Attack after casting Enhanced Heavy Attack to cast Heavy Attack Thwackblade to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.
-Use Basic Attack after casting Heavy Attack Thwackblade to cast Enhanced Basic Attack 3 to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG;
-Resonance Skill Wingblade is replaced with Resonance Skill Lifetaker, transforming sounds into blades to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG.
 
Umbra
Rover can hold up to 100 points of Umbra.
Normal Attack Tuneslayer recovers Umbra on hit.
Resonance Skill Wingblade recovers Umbra when cast.
Resonance Skill Lifetaker recovers Umbra when cast.
Intro Skill Instant of Annihilation recovers Umbra when cast.

Heavy Attack

The longer you hold the Basic Attack button, the more Imagination Roccia gains. In this state, Roccia can continue to charge the attack even when her STA depletes. Heavy Attack will be automatically cast when you release the Basic Attack button while charging or when Imagination reaches the max limit.
 
Mid-air Attack
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing Havoc DMG.
 
Dodge Counter
Use Basic Attack right after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG.

skills.name: 道具师的自我修养
skills.desc:
飞跃幻想
·洛可可处于飞跃幻想状态时，若至少拥有100点【想象力】，可短按普攻，消耗100点【想象力】施放普攻幻想照进现实。
·该状态会在洛可可不处于空中状态、或处于后台时解除。
 
普攻·幻想照进现实
·进行最多3段的连续攻击，造成湮灭伤害，此次伤害为重击伤害。第1段、第2段攻击落地后，若【想象力】大于100点，会将洛可可送上空中，进入飞跃幻想状态。

·【想象力】上限300点
·常态攻击造成伤害可回复【想象力】。
·持续按住普攻进行蓄力可获得【想象力】。
·施放共鸣技能高难度设计时，回复100点【想象力】
·施放变奏技能佩洛，来帮忙时，回复100点【想象力】。
skills.descEn:

- Roccia exits this state when she is not airborne or when switched off the field.

Imagination
Roccia can hold up to 300 Imagination.
- Dealing DMG with Normal Attacks restores Imagination.
- Hold Normal Attack to charge the next attack while restoring Imagination.
- Casting Resonance Skill Acrobatic Trick restores 100 Imagination.
- Casting Intro Skill Pero, Help restores 100 Imagination.

chains.name: 飞吧，乘着金色的翅膀
chains.desc:

·普攻幻想照进现实攻击目标时，无视对方60%的防御。
·普攻幻想照进现实第3段落地后，会将洛可可送上空中，进入飞跃幻想状态，此时短按普攻，将会施放普攻构筑现实，普攻构筑现实免疫打断，造成普攻幻想照进现实第3段100%的伤害，此次伤害为重击伤害。
·普攻构筑现实落地后，会将洛可可送上空中，进入飞跃幻想状态。普攻构筑现实需要在处于飞跃幻想状态时才可施放。
chains.descEn:
Casting Resonance Liberation Commedia Improvviso! grants the following effects for 12s:
- Basic Attack Real Fantasy ignores enemies' DEF by 60%.
- When Roccia lands after performing Basic Attack Real Fantasy Stage 3, she is launched into mid-air, activating Beyond Imagination. In this state, Basic Attack becomes Basic Attack Reality Recreation, dealing DMG equal to 100% of Basic Attack Real Fantasy Stage 3 DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG. Roccia is immune to interruptions while casting Basic Attack Reality Recreation.
- When Roccia lands after performing Basic Attack Reality Recreation, she is launched into mid-air, activating Beyond Imagination. Basic Attack Reality Recreation is only available in the Beyond Imagination state.

重击
消耗耐力攻击目标，造成湮灭伤害。

拥有【迷离】时，重击替换为浮潜幻海，造成湮灭伤害，并进入蜃境状态。若当前已处于蜃境状态，施放浮潜幻海不会重新进入蜃境状态。

闪避反击
成功闪避后一定时间内短按普攻，将会攻击目标，造成湮灭伤害。
skills.descEn:

skills.desc:
翩跹
攻击目标，造成湮灭伤害。
 
斑驳幻梦
处于蜃境状态时，共鸣技能替换为斑驳幻梦，施放此技能时，同时视为施放声骸技能。
攻击目标，造成湮灭伤害，使目标进入迷梦。
可在空中施放。
 
迷梦
降低目标的行动速度，持续6.5秒。目标受到伤害时，将触发一次惊醒，造成湮灭伤害，并清除迷梦，此次伤害为普攻伤害。
队伍中其他角色攻击处于迷梦的目标时，无法触发惊醒，并清除迷梦。
探索工具伤害和协同攻击不会触发惊醒。
skills.descEn:
Graceful Step
Attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG.
 
Flickering Reverie
When in Mirage, Resonance Skill becomes Flickering Reverie, which is considered an Echo Skill when being cast. Attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG, and send them into Hazy Dream.
Can be cast in mid-air.
 
Hazy Dream
Reduce the target's movement speed for 6.5s. When the target takes damage, Jolt is triggered once, removing Hazy Dream to deal Havoc DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG.
Attacks by other Resonators in the team will not Jolt a target influenced by Hazy Dream and will remove the Hazy Dream. 
Coordinated Attacks and damage from Utilities will not Jolt a target.

施放此技能时，同时视为施放声骸技能。
可在低空中施放。
 
弥漫
队伍中在场角色造成伤害时，会召唤织梦水母对目标进行协同攻击，造成湮灭伤害，此次伤害为普攻伤害。
