·织梦水母每秒最多召唤1只，共可召唤21只。
·效果持续30秒，或持续至织梦水母达到最大召唤数。
skills.descEn:
Flowing Suffocation
Attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG (considered Basic Attack DMG). Grant Diffusion to all Resonators in the team. Casting this skill is also considered as casting Echo Skill.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
 
Diffusion
When the Resonator on the field deals damage to a target, summon Dreamweavers to perform Coordinated Attack, dealing Havoc DMG (considered as Basic Attack DMG).
- Within 3s after the Resonator deals damage, summon 1 {Cus:Sap,S=Dreamweaver P=Dreamweavers SapTag=1} per second. This effect can be triggered once per second. Damage dealt by Dreamweavers cannot trigger this effect.
- Up to 1 {Cus:Sap,S=Dreamweaver P=Dreamweavers SapTag=2} can be summoned each second, max 21 Dreamweavers in total.
- This effect lasts for 30s or until reaching the maximum number of Dreamweavers.

点水
攻击目标，造成湮灭伤害。
施放该技能后在一定时间内短按普攻，将会施放普攻第3段。
 
逐浪
处于蜃境状态时，变奏技能替换为逐浪，逐浪攻击目标时会进行3次协同攻击，造成湮灭伤害。施放逐浪后重置普攻蛰幻连击段数。
skills.descEn:
Ripple

{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to start the Basic Attack combo from Basic Attack Stage 3.
 
Tidal Surge
When in Mirage, Intro Skill becomes Tidal Surge, which triggers 3 coordinated attacks on hit, dealing Havoc DMG. Casting Tidal Surge resets the combo of Basic Attack Phantom Sting.

skills.name: 虚实之间
skills.desc:
蜃境状态
·普攻替换为普攻蛰幻，进行最多3段连续攻击，造成湮灭伤害，可在空中施放，在空中施放普攻蛰幻，将会消耗耐力。此外，普攻蛰幻连击段数不会被重置。
·普攻蛰幻命中目标时，消耗1点【迷离】，获得1点【颤栗】，并为附近队伍中所有角色回复生命值。
·普攻第3段蛰幻攻击目标时会进行3次协同攻击，造成湮灭伤害。
·空中攻击替换为暗涌漩涡，短按跳跃，消耗耐力进行空中下落攻击，造成湮灭伤害。
·闪避反击替换为闪避反击掠影，攻击目标，造成湮灭伤害。施放该技能后短按普攻，将会施放普攻蛰幻第2段。
·空中攻击暗涌漩涡或闪避反击·掠影命中目标时，消耗1点【迷离】，获得1点【颤栗】，并为附近队伍中所有角色回复生命值。
·蜃境状态持续8秒；
·消耗完所有【迷离】时结束蜃境状态。
 
共鸣回路·感知汲取
处于蜃境状态时，若持有3点【颤栗】，共鸣技能替换为感知汲取。
施放感知汲取时，消耗所有【颤栗】，攻击目标，造成湮灭伤害，此次伤害为普攻伤害，使敌人进入迷梦，并为附近队伍中所有角色回复生命值。
施放此技能时，同时视为施放声骸技能。
可在空中施放。
 
溟海苏生
施放变奏技能后，队伍中的角色施放声骸技能时，坎特蕾拉回复6点协奏能量，同名声骸只可触发一次，最多可触发6次，持续25秒。该效果25秒内最多生效1次。
自身在水中时，游泳速度增加，耐力消耗降低。
 
迷离获取途径
上限5点。
施放变奏技能时，回复1点【迷离】。
普攻第三段命中目标时，回复1点【迷离】。
施放共鸣技能翩跹时，回复1点【迷离】。
施放共鸣解放陷溺时，回复3点【迷离】。
自身在水中时，每5秒回复1点【迷离】。
 
颤栗获取途径
上限3点。
普攻蛰幻命中时，回复1点【颤栗】。
空中攻击暗涌漩涡或闪避反击·掠影命中目标时，回复1点【颤栗】。
skills.descEn:
Mirage
- Basic Attack becomes Basic Attack Phantom Sting. Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Havoc DMG. Can be cast in mid-air. When cast mid-air, Basic Attack Phantom Sting consumes STA, and the combo does not reset when Cantarella is airborne.
- Hitting the target with Basic Attack Phantom Sting consumes 1 point of Trance to obtain 1 point of Shiver and heal all nearby Resonators in the team.
- The third stage of Basic Attack Phantom Sting triggers 3 Coordinated Attacks, dealing Havoc DMG.
- Mid-air Attack becomes Abysmal Vortex. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Jump to perform a Plunging Attack at the cost of STA, dealing Havoc DMG.
- Dodge Counter becomes Dodge Counter Shadowy Sweep. Attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack right after casting the skill to cast Basic Attack Phantom Sting Stage 2.
- When Mid-air Attack Abysmal Vortex or Dodge Counter Shadowy Sweep hits a target, consume 1 point of Trance to obtain 1 point of Shiver and heal all nearby Resonators in the team.
- Mirage lasts for 8s.
- Mirage ends when Trance is depleted.
 
Forte Circuit - Perception Drain
If Cantarella has 3 points of Shiver when in Mirage, Resonance Skill becomes Perception Drain.
Consume all Shiver to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG. Send the target into Hazy Dream and heal all Resonators in the team.
Casting this skill is also considered as casting Echo Skill.
Can be cast in mid-air.
 
Abyssal Rebirth
After casting Intro Skill, Cantarella enters Abyssal Rebirth, which lasts for 25s and can be activated once every 25s. In the duration, for up to 6 times, when Resonators in the team cast Echo Skill, Cantarella recovers 6 points of Concerto Energy. Echoes with the same name can only trigger this effect once.
When in water, Cantarella's swimming speed increases and STA cost decreases.
 
Trance
- Cantarella can hold up to 5 points of Trance.
- Casting Intro Skill recovers 1 point of Trance.
- Hitting a target with Basic Attack Stage 3 recovers 1 point of Trance.
- Casting Resonance Skill Graceful Step recovers 1 point of Trance.
- Casting Resonance Liberation Flowing Suffocation recovers 3 points of Trance.
- When in the water, recover 1 point of Trance every 5s.
 
Shiver
- Cantarella can hold up to 3 points of Shiver.
- Hitting the target with Basic Attack Phantom Sting recovers 1 point of Shiver.

skills.name: 生与死的乐章
skills.desc:
普攻
进行最多3段的连续攻击，造成湮灭伤害。
施放普攻第3段时进入重世状态。

重击
消耗耐力攻击目标，造成湮灭伤害。
施放该技能后在一定时间内短按普攻，将会施放普攻第2段。

谱曲终末
弗洛洛每25秒可激活谱曲。
同时满足下述3种条件时，重击替换为谱曲终末。
·拥有6枚【乐声】。
·谱曲处于激活状态。
·不处于【定音】状态。

施放谱曲终末，消耗耐力，停滞并牵引附近目标，造成湮灭伤害，本次伤害为共鸣技能伤害。
每层余响可使本次伤害倍率额外增加。
施放此技能时，同时视为施放声骸技能。
施放此技能时，谱曲进入冷却状态，随后获得【定音】状态。

空中攻击
消耗耐力进行空中下落攻击，造成湮灭伤害。

闪避反击
成功闪避后一定时间内短按普攻，将会攻击目标，造成湮灭伤害。
施放该技能后在一定时间内短按普攻，将会施放普攻第3段。

Scarlet Coda
Phrolova enters the Compose state every 25s.
When the following 3 conditions are met, Heavy Attack is replaced with Scarlet Coda.
- Has 6 Volatile Notes.
- In the Compose state.
- Not in the Resolving Chord state.

Scarlet Coda: Consume STA to deal Havoc DMG, Stagnating and pulling in nearby targets. This instance of damage is considered Resonance Skill DMG.
Each stack of Aftersound additionally increases the DMG Multiplier of this instance of damage.
Casting this skill is considered as casting Echo Skill.
Casting this skill sends Compose state into cooldown and activates the Resolving Chord state.

Mid-air Attack
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing Havoc DMG.

Dodge Counter
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack Stage 3.

skills.name: 往日深渊的圆舞曲
skills.desc:
往日深渊的圆舞曲
弗洛洛共鸣能量上限为0，往日深渊的圆舞曲不消耗共鸣能量。
处于【定音】状态时，解锁往日深渊的圆舞曲。
施放后退出【定音】状态，进入指挥状态，持续24秒。

指挥状态
攻击提升120%。
弗洛洛漂浮于空中，指挥赫卡忒进行战斗，赫卡忒将继承弗洛洛的属性。赫卡忒造成的伤害不会清除目标的迷梦状态。
期间按获取顺序演奏【乐声】，每枚【乐声】演奏4秒。
若弗洛洛为队伍中登场角色，可施放下列指令指挥赫卡忒发动攻击，此时赫卡忒受到攻击时弗洛洛会受到伤害。
·指令·普攻：点击普攻，指挥赫卡忒施放普攻·赫卡忒。弗洛洛为队伍中登场角色且赫卡忒累计施放2次普攻后，下次普攻·赫卡忒将替换为强化攻击·赫卡忒。
·指令·闪避：点击闪避，指挥赫卡忒闪避，成功闪避时将不受伤害。
·指令·复位：点击跳跃，重置赫卡忒位置。
·指令·谢幕：点击共鸣解放，结束指挥状态。
若弗洛洛不为队伍中登场角色，赫卡忒不会受到伤害。赫卡忒将自动施放普攻·赫卡忒攻击目标。队伍中角色施放声骸技能时，赫卡忒将施放强化攻击·赫卡忒攻击目标。指挥状态期间，最多可触发10次该效果，同名声骸仅可触发1次该效果。
若切换回弗洛洛，提前结束指挥状态。
结束指挥状态时，清除所有【乐声】。

普攻·赫卡忒
进行最多2段的连续攻击，造成湮灭伤害，本次伤害为声骸技能伤害。

强化攻击·弦乐·赫卡忒
弗洛洛演奏【乐声·弦乐】时，赫卡忒施放的强化攻击·赫卡忒为强化攻击·弦乐·赫卡忒，停滞目标，造成湮灭伤害，本次伤害为声骸技能伤害。

强化攻击·管乐·赫卡忒
弗洛洛演奏【乐声·管乐】时，赫卡忒施放的强化攻击·赫卡忒为强化攻击·管乐·赫卡忒，牵引附近目标，造成湮灭伤害，本次伤害为声骸技能伤害。

强化攻击·彩乐·赫卡忒
弗洛洛演奏【乐声·彩乐】时，赫卡忒施放的强化攻击·赫卡忒为强化攻击·彩乐·赫卡忒，停滞并牵引附近目标，造成湮灭伤害，本次伤害为声骸技能伤害。

谢幕
可通过下述5种操作，施放谢幕，停滞目标，造成湮灭伤害。
·弗洛洛为队伍中登场角色结束指挥状态。
·处于指挥状态时，弗洛洛非变奏技能登场。
·弗洛洛不为队伍中登场角色结束指挥状态后，弗洛洛下一次登场为非变奏技能登场。
·处于指挥状态时，点击共鸣解放。
·处于【定音】状态时，长按共鸣解放。
处于【定音】状态，施放谢幕时，清除所有【乐声】并退出【定音】状态。
skills.descEn:
Waltz of Forsaken Depths
Phrolova's max Resonance Energy is 0. Waltz of Forsaken Depths does not consume Resonance Energy.
When in the Resolving Chord state, Waltz of Forsaken Depths becomes available.
Casting this skill ends the Resolving Chord state, and Phrolova enters the Maestro state for 24s.

Maestro
Gain 120% ATK increase.
Phrolova floats in the air and commands Hecate to fight. Hecate will share Phrolova's stats and statuses, and damage dealt by Hecate will be considered coming from Phrolova. Hecate's attacks will not remove the target's Hazy Dream state.
During this period, Phrolova plays the Volatile Notes in turn. Each Volatile Note holds for 4s.
If Phrolova is the active Resonator on the field, she can give the following cues to Hecate. Any damage taken by Hecate in this state affects Phrolova as well.
- Cue - Basic Attack: {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack to command Hecate to cast Basic Attack - Hecate. When Phrolova is the active Resonator on the field, for every 2 times Hecate casts Basic Attack - Hecate, the next Basic Attack - Hecate is replaced with Enhanced Attack - Hecate.
- Cue - Dodge: {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Dodge to command Hecate to dodge an attack. Hecate takes no damage from a hit successfully Dodged.
- Cue - Reset: {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Jump to reset Hecate's position.
- Cue - Curtain Call: {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Resonance Liberation to command Hecate to cast Curtain Call and end the Maestro state.
When Phrolova is not the active Resonator, Hecate takes no damage and automatically casts Basic Attack - Hecate to attack the target. When Resonators in the team cast Echo Skill, Hecate casts Enhanced Attack - Hecate to attack the target. This effect can be triggered up to 10 times in total during Phrolova's Maestro state. Echoes of the same name can trigger this effect 1 {Cus:Sap,S=time P=times SapTag=3}.
Switching back to Phrolova ends Maestro state.
Ending Maestro state removes all Volatile Notes.

Basic Attack - Hecate
Perform up to 2 consecutive attacks, dealing Havoc DMG (considered Echo Skill DMG).

Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Strings
When Phrolova plays Volatile Note - Strings, Hecate casts Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Strings when casting Enhanced Attack - Hecate, dealing Havoc DMG and Stagnating the targets (considered Echo Skill DMG).

Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Winds
When Phrolova plays Volatile Note - Winds, Hecate casts Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Winds when casting Enhanced Attack - Hecate, dealing Havoc DMG, pulling the targets in (considered Echo Skill DMG).

Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Cadenza
When Phrolova plays Volatile Note - Cadenza, Hecate casts Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Cadenza when casting Enhanced Attack - Hecate, dealing Havoc DMG, Stagnating and pulling the targets in (considered Echo Skill DMG).

Curtain Call
Curtain Call can be cast via the following 5 ways, Stagnating the targets and dealing Havoc DMG.
- When Phrolova is the active Resonator on the field, end the Maestro state.
- When Phrolova is in the Maestro state, switch to Phrolova without casting Intro Skill.
- When Phrolova is not the active Resonator and the Maestro state ends, switch to Phrolova without casting Intro Skill.
- When Phrolova is in the Maestro state, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Liberation.
- When Phrolova is in the Resolving Chord state, hold Resonance Liberation.
When in Resolving Chord state, casting Curtain Call removes all Volatile Notes and ends the Resolving Chord state.

skills.name: 八重奏
skills.desc:
进入战斗状态获得10层余响，退出战斗状态4秒内无法触发该效果。
每拥有1层余响，暴击伤害提升2.5%。

skills.descEn:
Obtain 10 stacks of Aftersound upon entering battle. This effect cannot be triggered again within 4s after exiting the combat state. For every 1 stacks of Aftersound, Crit. DMG is increased by 2.5%.
When Aftersound reaches the max, each new stack of Aftersound increases Phrolova's Crit. DMG by 1%, up to 100%. The increased Crit. DMG is removed when Aftersound stacks are cleared.

致命组歌
攻击目标，造成湮灭伤害。
施放该技能后在一定时间内短按普攻，将会施放普攻第3段。

永生组歌
进入指挥状态后，下次致命组歌替换为永生组歌，期间施放谢幕将取消本次替换。
施放永生组歌，停滞目标，造成湮灭伤害，本次伤害为共鸣技能伤害。
施放该技能后在一定时间内短按普攻，将会施放普攻第3段。

When in the Maestro state, the next Suite of Quietus is replaced with Suite of Immortality. This replacement is cancelled if Curtain Call is cast while in this state. Suite of Immortality deals Havoc DMG (considered Resonance Skill DMG) and Stagnates the target.

skills.desc:
普攻·亡与死的乐章
处于重世状态时，地面短按普攻施放亡与死的乐章，使命中的目标停滞，随后对目标造成湮灭伤害，本次伤害为共鸣技能伤害。
施放时退出重世状态。

共鸣技能·永不消逝的梦呓
处于重世状态时，地面短按共鸣技能施放永不消逝的梦呓，造成湮灭伤害，本次伤害为共鸣技能伤害。
施放时退出重世状态。

余响获取规则
余响上限为24层。
弗洛洛不为队伍中登场角色，施放强化攻击·弦乐·赫卡忒、强化攻击·管乐·赫卡忒、强化攻击·彩乐·赫卡忒时，可获得1层余响。
弗洛洛处于非战斗状态时，每30秒会清除全部余响层数。

【乐声】获取规则
【乐声】上限6枚，达上限时，再次获取【乐声】，所有【乐声】将左移1格，最左侧【乐声·弦乐】、【乐声·管乐】将被移除。
普攻第3段、亡与死的乐章命中目标时，可获取1枚【乐声·弦乐】。
共鸣技能稍纵即逝的梦呓、共鸣技能永不消逝的梦呓命中目标时，可获取1枚【乐声·管乐】。
激活固有技能·变音符后，施放致命组歌、永生组歌、声骸技能时，下一枚获得的乐声会变为【乐声·彩乐】。
处于【定音】状态时，无法获取【乐声】。
skills.descEn:
Basic Attack - Movement of Fate and Finality
When in Reincarnate, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack on the ground to cast Movement of Fate and Finality, which Stagnates the target, dealing Havoc DMG (considered Resonance Skill DMG) and ending Reincarnate afterward.

Resonance Skill - Murmurs in a Haunting Dream
When in Reincarnate, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Skill on the ground to cast Murmurs in a Haunting Dream, dealing Havoc DMG (considered Resonance Skill DMG) and ending Reincarnate afterward.

Aftersound
Phrolova can hold up to 24 stacks of Aftersound.
When Phrolova is not the active Resonator, casting Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Strings, Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Winds, and Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Cadenza grants 1 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=1} of Aftersound.
When Phrolova is out of combat, all stacks of Aftersound are removed every 30s.

Volatile Note
Phrolova can hold up to 6 Volatile Notes. When Volatile Notes reach the max number, gaining new Volatile Notes moves all Volatile Notes one slot to the left, and the leftmost Volatile Note - Strings or Volatile Note - Winds will be removed.
Hitting a target with Basic Attack Stage 3 or Movement of Fate and Finality grants 1 Volatile Note - Strings.
Hitting a target with Resonance Skill Whispers in a Fleeting Dream or Resonance Skill Murmurs in a Haunting Dream grants 1 Volatile Note - Winds.
When Inherent Skill - Accidental is activated, casting Suite of Quietus, Suite of Immortality, or Echo Skill grants 1 Volatile Note - Cadenza.
Phrolova cannot obtain Volatile Notes during Resolving Chord.

skills.name: 未完成的曲目
skills.desc:
下一位登场角色湮灭伤害加深20%，重击伤害加深25%，效果持续14秒，若切换至其他角色则该效果提前结束。
弗洛洛处于指挥状态时施放此技能，此次指挥状态期间，弗洛洛切换至其他角色时，赫卡忒将额外施放2次强化攻击·赫卡忒。
skills.descEn:
The incoming Resonator gains 20% Havoc DMG Amplification and 25% Heavy Attack DMG Amplification for 14s or until they are switched out.
If Phrolova is in Maestro state when she casts this skill, Hecate additionally casts Enhanced Attack - Hecate 2 {Cus:Sap,S=time P=times SapTag=3} when Phrolova is switched off the field while in the same Maestro state duration.

skills.name: 谐度破坏·音感仪
skills.desc: 目标【偏谐值】满时，可对其施放【谐度破坏】。
skills.descEn: When the target's Off-Tune Level is full, the Resonator may cast Tune Break on the target.

inherents.name: 变音符
inherents.desc:
施放声骸技能时，抗打断能力提升，受到伤害降低30%，持续15秒。
施放致命组歌、永生组歌、声骸技能时，下一枚获得的【乐声】会变为【乐声·彩乐】。

inherents.name: 八重奏
inherents.desc:
进入战斗状态获得10层余响，退出战斗状态4秒内无法触发该效果。
每拥有1层余响，暴击伤害提升2.5%。
余响层数达上限时，再次获得余响，每溢出1层余响，弗洛洛暴击伤害提升1%，最多通过该方式提升100%，余响层数清除时，同时清除该方式提供的暴击伤害提升效果。

chains.name: 钥匙，通往冥界的奥秘
chains.desc:
亡与死的乐章伤害倍率提升80%。
永不消逝的梦呓伤害倍率提升80%。
弗洛洛不处于指挥状态且不处于战斗状态4秒后，若【乐声】少于2枚，获得【乐声·彩乐】，直至【乐声】不少于2枚。
chains.descEn:
The DMG Multiplier of Movement of Fate and Finality is increased by 80%.
The DMG Multiplier of Murmurs in a Haunting Dream is increased by 80%.
If Phrolova has less than 2 Volatile Notes when she is not in the Maestro state and stays out of combat for 4s, she gains Volatile Note - Cadenza until she has at least 2 Volatile Notes.

chains.name: 绳索，重生更新的纽带
chains.nameEn: A Rope Tied to a Life Beyond
chains.desc:
谱曲终末伤害倍率提升75%，余响对谱曲终末的倍率增加效果提升75%。
施放谱曲终末时可获得14层余响。
chains.descEn:
The DMG Multiplier of Scarlet Coda is increased by 75%. Aftersound now additionally increases the DMG Multiplier of Scarlet Coda by 75%.
Casting Scarlet Coda grants 14 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=2} of Aftersound.

chains.name: 匕首，消弭妄想的力量
chains.nameEn: A Dagger to Cut Clean Obsessions
chains.desc:
声骸技能伤害加深80%。
施放谱曲终末期间，所有【乐声】将依次转化为【乐声·彩乐】。
被强化攻击·彩乐·赫卡忒命中的目标，攻击降低20%，持续15秒。
chains.descEn:
Echo Skill DMG is Amplified by 80%.
Casting Scarlet Coda will convert all Volatile Notes to Volatile Notes - Cadenza in turn. Targets hit by Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Cadenza will have their ATK reduced by 20% for 15s.

chains.name: 火炬，新径启行的引导
chains.desc: 施放声骸技能时，队伍中的角色全属性伤害加成提升20%，持续30秒。
chains.descEn: Casting Echo Skill grants 20% Attribute DMG Bonus for all Resonators in the team for 30s.

chains.name: 岔路，穿越生命的要地
chains.nameEn: A Forked Road in Fate's Heartland
chains.desc:
进入指挥状态时，生成领域停滞周围的目标，领域持续4秒。结束指挥状态或切换至其他角色时，将提前清除停滞效果。
处于指挥状态时，受到伤害降低30%。
chains.descEn:
Upon entering the Maestro state, generate a field to Stagnate the nearby targets, which lasts for 4s. Leaving the Maestro state or switching to other Resonators removes the Stagnation effect early.
Damage taken during the Maestro state is reduced by 30%.

chains.name: 深夜，走出安息与终结
chains.nameEn: A Night to Depart From Eternal Rest
chains.desc:
强化攻击·赫卡忒伤害倍率提升24%。

施放亡与死的乐章、永不消逝的梦呓期间，将召唤赫卡忒施放1次重世幻象·赫卡忒，造成弗洛洛攻击216.42%的湮灭伤害，命中目标时获得8层余响。本次伤害为声骸技能伤害。

处于指挥状态时，若弗洛洛不为队伍中登场角色，目标受到赫卡忒和弗洛洛的伤害提升40%。
处于指挥状态时，若弗洛洛为队伍中登场角色，湮灭伤害加成提升60%。
chains.descEn:
The DMG Multiplier of Enhanced Attack - Hecate is increased by 24%. 

During Movement of Fate and Finality and Murmurs in a Haunting Dream, command Hecate to cast 1 Apparition of Beyond - Hecate, dealing Havoc DMG equal to 216.42% of Phrolova's ATK (considered Echo Skill DMG) and granting 8 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=4} of Aftersound on hit.

If Phrolova is not the active Resonator during the Maestro state, targets take 40% more DMG from Hecate and Phrolova. If Phrolova is the active Resonator during the Maestro state, gain 60% Havoc DMG Bonus.

skills.name: 济善伐恶
skills.desc:
普攻·苍剑式
连续短按或按住普攻，进行最多4段的连续攻击，造成湮灭伤害，并消耗【流响】。普攻·苍剑式造成伤害时，若【流响】未耗尽，共鸣效率提升20%。
普攻·苍剑式第4段造成伤害时，会为目标附加1层【虚湮效应】。

普攻·羽剑式
连续短按或按住普攻，进行最多4段的连续攻击，造成湮灭伤害，并消耗【流响】。普攻·羽剑式造成伤害时，若【流响】未耗尽，共鸣效率提升20%。
普攻·羽剑式第4段造成伤害时，会为目标附加1层【虚湮效应】。

空中攻击·苍剑式
消耗耐力进行空中下落攻击，造成湮灭伤害，并消耗【流响】。
施放该技能后在一定时间内短按普攻，将会施放普攻·苍剑式第2段。

空中攻击·羽剑式
消耗耐力进行空中下落攻击，造成湮灭伤害，并消耗【流响】。
施放该技能后在一定时间内短按普攻，将会施放普攻·羽剑式第2段。

闪避反击·苍剑式
成功闪避后一定时间内短按普攻，攻击目标造成湮灭伤害，并消耗【流响】。
施放该技能后在一定时间内短按普攻，将会施放普攻·苍剑式第3段。
施放闪避反击·苍剑式时，视为普攻·苍剑式第2段连段。

闪避反击·羽剑式
成功闪避后一定时间内短按普攻，攻击目标造成湮灭伤害，并消耗【流响】。
施放该技能后在一定时间内短按普攻，将会施放普攻·羽剑式第3段。
施放闪避反击·羽剑式时，视为普攻·羽剑式第2段连段。
skills.descEn:
Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack repeatedly or hold it down to consume Melody and perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Havoc DMG. While Melody is not depleted, the Energy Regen is increased by 20% when Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance deals damage.
Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Stage 4 applies 1 stack of Havoc Bane to the targets hit.

Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack repeatedly or hold it down to consume Melody and perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Havoc DMG. While Melody is not depleted, the Energy Regen is increased by 20% when Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance deals damage.
Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Stage 4 applies 1 stack of Havoc Bane to the targets hit.

Mid-air Attack - Azure Sword Stance
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, consuming Melody and dealing Havoc DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tapping PC=Pressing Gamepad=Pressing} Normal Attack within a short time after casting this skill triggers Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Stage 2.

Mid-air Attack - Feather Sword Stance
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, consuming Melody and dealing Havoc DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tapping PC=Pressing Gamepad=Pressing} Normal Attack within a short time after casting this skill triggers Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Stage 2.

Dodge Counter - Azure Sword Stance
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tapping PC=Pressing Gamepad=Pressing} Normal Attack within a short time after a successful Dodge consumes Melody to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tapping PC=Pressing Gamepad=Pressing} Normal Attack within a short time after casting this skill triggers Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Stage 3.
Casting Dodge Counter - Azure Sword Stance counts as casting Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Stage 2.

Dodge Counter - Feather Sword Stance
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tapping PC=Pressing Gamepad=Pressing} Normal Attack within a short time after a successful Dodge consumes Melody to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tapping PC=Pressing Gamepad=Pressing} Normal Attack within a short time after casting this skill triggers Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Stage 3.
Casting Dodge Counter - Feather Sword Stance counts as casting Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Stage 2.

skills.name: 羽拭苍锋
skills.desc:
剑式切换
处于苍剑式时，短按共鸣技能，会切换至羽剑式，并施放普攻·羽剑式第1段，造成湮灭伤害。

处于羽剑式时，短按共鸣技能，会切换至苍剑式，并施放普攻·苍剑式第1段，造成湮灭伤害。

剑式切换·苍
施放普攻·羽剑式后的一定时间内短按共鸣技能，会切换至苍剑式，并施放剑式切换·苍攻击目标，造成湮灭伤害，此次伤害为重击伤害。
施放该技能一定时间内可以触发成功闪避，触发成功闪避时消耗50点【流响】。
施放该技能后，一定时间内将不会重置普攻连段。

剑式切换·羽
施放普攻·苍剑式后的一定时间内短按共鸣技能，会切换至羽剑式，并施放剑式切换·羽攻击目标，造成湮灭伤害，此次伤害为重击伤害。
施放该技能一定时间内可以触发成功闪避，触发成功闪避时消耗50点【流响】。
施放该技能后，一定时间内将不会重置普攻连段。
skills.descEn:
Sword Stance Switch
While in Azure Sword Stance, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Skill to switch to Feather Sword Stance and perform Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Stage 1, dealing Havoc DMG.

While in Feather Sword Stance, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Skill to switch to Azure Sword Stance and perform Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Stage 1, dealing Havoc DMG.

Sword Stance Switch: Azure
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Resonance Skill within a short time after casting Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance to switch to Azure Sword Stance and cast Sword Stance Switch: Azure, dealing Havoc DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
A successful Dodge can be triggered within a short time into the action of this skill, which consumes 50 Melody.
After casting this skill, the Basic Attack cycle will not reset for a short time.

Sword Stance Switch: Feather
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Resonance Skill within a short time after casting Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance to switch to Feather Sword Stance and cast Sword Stance Switch: Feather, dealing Havoc DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
A successful Dodge can be triggered within a short time into the action of this skill, which consumes 50 Melody.
After casting this skill, the Basic Attack cycle will not reset for a short time.

skills.name: 裁羽寂万音
skills.desc:
裁羽寂万音
消耗所有【流响】，造成湮灭伤害，并回复1点【苍翎】，此次伤害为重击伤害。

施放该技能时，获得声声流转状态，施放共鸣技能·剑式流转·苍或共鸣技能·剑式流转·羽时，召唤玄翎之影攻击目标，造成湮灭伤害，此次伤害为重击伤害。
声声流转状态不可叠加，召唤玄翎之影后移除声声流转状态。
skills.descEn:
Hush of a Thousand Voices
Consume all Melody to deal Havoc DMG and restore 1 point of Azure Plume. This DMG is considered Heavy Attack DMG.

Upon casting this skill, obtain Voice upon Voice. When casting Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure or Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather, summon Shadow of Xuanling to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
Voice upon Voice cannot stack. Once Shadow of Xuanling is summoned, the Voice upon Voice state is removed.

skills.name: 恒守之誓
skills.desc:
当目标拥有1到3层【虚湮效应】后，每层【虚湮效应】使秧秧·玄翎对其造成的伤害加深10%，最多30%。

当目标拥有4到6层【虚湮效应】后，4到6层【虚湮效应】每层【虚湮效应】使秧秧·玄翎对其造成的伤害加深12%，最多36%。
skills.descEn:
When a target has 1 to 3 stacks of Havoc Bane, each stack of Havoc Bane Amplifies the DMG from Yangyang: Xuanling by 10%, up to 30%.

When a target has 4 to 6 stacks of Havoc Bane, each stack of Havoc Bane Amplifies the DMG from Yangyang: Xuanling by 12%, up to 36%.

skills.name: 一生一器
skills.desc:
秧秧·玄翎施放共鸣解放裁羽寂万音命中目标时，附加【虚湮效应】至目标可附加层数的上限。

附近队伍中的角色对目标附加【虚湮效应】时，秧秧·玄翎获得1层风息相依，风息相依获得间隔1秒，最多叠加6层。

风息相依叠加至6层时，秧秧·玄翎移除全部风息相依，并获得风我同频。
拥有风我同频时，秧秧·玄翎施放共鸣技能·剑式流转·苍或共鸣技能·剑式流转·羽时，召唤释羽·玄翎，为目标附加6层【虚湮效应】。
拥有风我同频时，无法获得风息相依。

召唤释羽·玄翎后，移除风我同频状态。
skills.descEn:
Resonance Liberation Hush of a Thousand Voices raises the Havoc Bane stacks on the targets to the maximum on hit.

When nearby Resonators in the team inflict Havoc Bane, Yangyang: Xuanling gains 1 stack of Windbound. Windbound can be gained once every 1s, stacking up to 6 times.

When Windbound reaches 6 stacks, Yangyang: Xuanling removes all Windbound and gains One with the Wind.
While One with the Wind lasts, when Yangyang: Xuanling casts Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure or Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather, she summons Feather Release: Xuanling to attack the target, applying 6 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=2} of Havoc Bane to the target. 
Windbound cannot be obtained while One with the Wind lasts.

Once Feather Release: Xuanling is summoned, the One with the Wind state is removed.

skills.desc:
共鸣技能·剑式流转·苍
秧秧·玄翎默认处于苍剑式，【流响】耗尽时，若处于羽剑式，共鸣技能·羽拭苍锋替换为共鸣技能·剑式流转·苍。
短按共鸣技能，会切换至苍剑式，并施放共鸣技能·剑式流转·苍，造成湮灭伤害，回复100点【流响】和1点【苍翎】，此次伤害为重击伤害。
共鸣技能·剑式流转·苍命中目标时，消耗目标1层【虚湮效应】。
施放共鸣技能·剑式流转·苍后，一定时间内将不会重置连段。若施放共鸣技能·剑式流转·苍打断普攻·羽剑式连段，则会召唤声之幻身完成当前攻击，造成固定湮灭伤害，此次伤害为普攻伤害，该次攻击造成的伤害不受伤害加成影响，且无法对目标附加【虚湮效应】。
施放该技能一定时间内可以触发成功闪避，触发成功闪避时消耗50点【流响】。

共鸣技能·剑式流转·羽
【流响】耗尽时，若处于苍剑式，共鸣技能·羽拭苍锋替换为共鸣技能·剑式流转·羽。
短按共鸣技能，会切换至羽剑式，并施放共鸣技能·剑式流转·羽，造成湮灭伤害，回复100点【流响】和1点【苍翎】，此次伤害为重击伤害。
共鸣技能·剑式流转·羽命中目标时，消耗目标1层【虚湮效应】。
施放共鸣技能·剑式流转·羽后，一定时间内将不会重置连段。若施放共鸣技能·剑式流转·羽打断普攻·苍剑式连段，则会召唤声之幻身完成当前攻击，造成固定湮灭伤害，此次伤害为普攻伤害，该次攻击造成的伤害不受伤害加成影响，且无法对目标附加【虚湮效应】。
施放该技能一定时间内可以触发成功闪避，触发成功闪避时消耗50点【流响】。

重击·苍剑式
【苍翎】回复至上限时，若处于苍剑式，长按普攻消耗所有【苍翎】，消耗耐力施放重击·苍剑式，生成巨大气旋攻击前方，造成湮灭伤害，此次伤害为重击伤害。
施放重击·苍剑式时，获得【绝息】，秧秧·玄翎为队伍中登场角色时，此次重击·苍剑式暴击伤害提升160%；重击·苍剑式结束时移除【绝息】，每25秒仅可获得1次【绝息】。
重击·苍剑式会为命中的目标附加2层【虚湮效应】。

重击·羽剑式
【苍翎】回复至上限时，若处于羽剑式且不处于普攻·湮象风华连段，并且处于地面时，长按普攻消耗耐力施放重击·羽剑式，造成湮灭伤害，命中目标后将自动施放空中攻击·释羽风落。
施放重击·羽剑式时，获得【流岚】，【流岚】持续15秒，秧秧·玄翎为队伍中登场角色时，此次重击·羽剑式、空中攻击·释羽风落、普攻·湮象风华、闪避反击·湮象风华暴击伤害提升160%；普攻·湮象风华第3段或闪避反击·湮象风华第3段结束时移除【流岚】，每25秒仅可获得1次【流岚】。
重击·羽剑式会为命中的目标附加2层【虚湮效应】。

空中攻击·释羽风落 
【苍翎】回复至上限时，若处于羽剑式并且处于空中时，空中攻击·羽剑式替换为空中攻击·释羽风落。
短按普攻或长按普攻消耗所有【苍翎】，消耗耐力并施放空中攻击·释羽风落，造成湮灭伤害，此次伤害为重击伤害。施放空中攻击·释羽风落时，进入聆风祀声，持续12秒。

聆风祀声
处于羽剑式时，普攻·羽剑式替换为普攻·湮象风华，进行最多3段的连续攻击，造成湮灭伤害，此次伤害为重击伤害。
普攻·湮象风华第2、3段可在低空施放，施放第3段后退出普攻·湮象风华，该连击段数不会被重置。
聆风祀声期间，施放闪避反击，视为施放普攻·湮象风华连段。

羽誓
附近队伍中的角色对目标附加【虚湮效应】时，秧秧·玄翎获得1层羽誓，持续4秒，羽誓获得间隔1秒，最多叠加6层，秧秧·玄翎为队伍中登场角色时，每层使重击·苍剑式、重击·羽剑式、空中攻击·释羽风落、普攻·湮象风华、闪避反击·湮象风华的暴击伤害提升25%，至多提升150%。

迭音
秧秧·玄翎的普攻·苍剑式第4段、普攻·羽剑式第4段、重击·苍剑式、重击·羽剑式命中目标前，记录一定范围内的目标被附加的【虚湮效应】最高层数，一定时间后复制到范围内的所有目标身上。

【流响】获取规则
【流响】上限100点。
施放共鸣技能·剑式流转·苍、共鸣技能·剑式流转·羽时回复100点【流响】。
施放共鸣解放裁羽寂万音消耗所有【流响】。
施放常态攻击造成伤害，并消耗【流响】。
施放共鸣技能·剑式切换·苍、共鸣技能·剑式切换·羽、共鸣技能·剑式流转·苍、共鸣技能·剑式流转·羽一定时间内可以触发成功闪避，触发成功闪避时消耗50点【流响】。

【苍翎】获取规则
【苍翎】上限2点。
施放共鸣技能·剑式流转·苍、共鸣技能·剑式流转·羽、变奏技能·羽挟苍空时回复1点【苍翎】。
施放共鸣解放·裁羽寂万音时回复1点【苍翎】。
施放重击·苍剑式、空中攻击·释羽风落消耗所有【苍翎】。
skills.descEn:
Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure
Yangyang: Xuanling is in Azure Sword Stance by default. When Melody is depleted while in Feather Sword Stance, Resonance Skill - Feather's Edge is replaced by Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Resonance Skill to switch to  Azure Sword Stance and cast Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure, dealing Havoc DMG and restoring 100 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=0} of Melody and 1 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=1} of Azure Plume. This instance of DMG is considered Heavy Attack DMG.
When Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure hits the target, consume 1 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=2} of Havoc Bane on the target.
The Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance cycle is not reset within a short time after casting Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure. If casting Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure resets the cycle, summon a Wraith of Sound to finish the current attack and deal a fixed instance of Havoc DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG, which is not affected by any DMG Bonus effects and does not inflict Havoc Bane.
Successful Dodge can be triggered within a short time into the action of this skill, which consumes 50 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=3} of Melody.

Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather
When Melody is depleted while in Azure Sword Stance, Resonance Skill - Feather's Edge is replaced by Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Resonance Skill to switch to Feather Sword Stance and cast Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather, dealing Havoc DMG and restoring 100 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=4} of Melody and 1 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=5} of Azure Plume. This instance of DMG is considered Heavy Attack DMG.
When Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather hits, consume 1 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=6} of Havoc Bane on the target.
The Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance cycle is not reset within a short time after casting Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather. If casting Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather resets the cycle, summon a Wraith of Sound to finish the current attack and deal a fixed instance of Havoc DMG, considered Basic Attack DMG, which is not affected by any DMG Bonus effects and does not inflict Havoc Bane.
Successful Dodge can be triggered within a short time into the action of this skill, which consumes 50 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=7} of Melody.

Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance
When Azure Plume is restored to its maximum while in Azure Sword Stance, hold Normal Attack to consume STA and all Azure Plume to cast Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance, generating a massive cyclone that strikes the area in front, dealing Havoc DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
When casting Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance, gain Bated Breath: If Yangyang: Xuanling is the active Resonator in the field, the Crit. DMG of this Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance increases by 160%. When Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance ends, Bated Breath is removed. Bated Breath can be gained up to once every 25s.
Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance applies 2 stacks of Havoc Bane to the targets hit.

Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance
When Azure Plume is restored to its maximum while in Feather Sword Stance, if Yangyang: Xuanling is on the ground and not in a Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom cycle, hold Normal Attack to consume STA and cast Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance, dealing Havoc DMG. After it hits a target, Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall is automatically cast.
When casting Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance, gain Streaming Storm, which lasts 15s. While Yangyang: Xuanling is the active Resonator in the team, the Crit. DMG of this Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance or the next Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall, Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom, or Dodge Counter - Havoc in Bloom is increased by 160%. Streaming Storm is removed when Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom Stage 3 or Dodge Counter - Havoc in Bloom Stage 3 ends. Streaming Storm can be gained up to once every 25s.
Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance applies 2 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=A} stacks of Havoc Bane to the targets hit.

Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall
When Azure Plume is restored to its maximum while in Feather Sword Stance and airborne,  Mid-air Attack - Feather Sword Stance is replaced by Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} or hold Normal Attack to consume STA and all Azure Plume to cast Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall, dealing Havoc DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG. Casting Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall enters Hark the Wind for 12s.

Hark the Wind
While in Feather Sword Stance, Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance is replaced by Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom, which performs up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Havoc DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom Stage 2 and Stage 3 can be cast in mid-air close to the ground. Casting Stage 3 ends Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom. This attack cycle cannot be reset.
During Hark the Wind, a Dodge Counter counts towards the Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom cycle.

Feathered Oath
When nearby Resonators in the team inflict Havoc Bane on a target, Yangyang: Xuanling gains 1 stack of Feathered Oath for 4s. Feathered Oath can be gained once every 1s, stacking up to 6 times. While Yangyang: Xuanling is the active Resonator in the team, each stack increases the Crit. DMG of Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance, Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance, Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall, Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom, and Dodge Counter - Havoc in Bloom by 25%, up to 150%.

Refrain
Before Yangyang: Xuanling's Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Stage 4, Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Stage 4, Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance, or Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance hits a target, record and propagate the highest stack count of Havoc Bane on targets within a certain range to all targets within range.

Melody
Melody has a maximum of 100 points.
Casting Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure or Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather restores 100 points of Melody.
Casting Resonance Liberation Hush of a Thousand Voices consumes all Melody.
Normal Attacks consumes Melody upon dealing damage.
Successful Dodge can be triggered during the action of Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Switch: Azure, Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Switch: Feather, Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure, or Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather within a certain time of casting these skills, which consumes 50 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=B} of Melody.

Azure Plume
Azure Plume has a maximum of 2 points.
Casting Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure,  Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather, or Intro Skill - Skybound Feather restores 1 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=C} of Azure Plume.
Casting Resonance Liberation - Hush of a Thousand Voices restores 1 {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=D} of Azure Plume.
Casting Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance or Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall consumes all Azure Plume.

inherents.desc:
秧秧·玄翎施放共鸣解放裁羽寂万音命中目标时，附加【虚湮效应】至目标可附加层数的上限。

附近队伍中的角色对目标附加【虚湮效应】时，秧秧·玄翎获得1层风息相依，风息相依获得间隔1秒，最多叠加6层。

风息相依叠加至6层时，秧秧·玄翎移除全部风息相依，并获得风我同频。
拥有风我同频时，秧秧·玄翎施放共鸣技能·剑式流转·苍或共鸣技能·剑式流转·羽时，召唤释羽·玄翎，为目标附加6层【虚湮效应】。
拥有风我同频时，无法获得风息相依。

召唤释羽·玄翎后，移除风我同频状态。

chains.name: 禾雀随风初绽
chains.nameEn: At the Wind's Breath, the Blossoms Wake
chains.desc:
施放共鸣技能·剑式流转·苍、共鸣技能·剑式流转·羽时，召唤玄翎之影·抗坠，造成秧秧·玄翎攻击337.98%的湮灭伤害，此次伤害为重击伤害。
施放共鸣技能·剑式流转·苍、共鸣技能·剑式流转·羽期间，停滞周围目标。

重击·苍剑式、普攻·湮象风华、闪避反击·湮象风华免疫打断。
chains.descEn:
Casting Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure or Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather summons a Shadow of Xuanling: Unfaltering to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG equal to 337.98% of Yangyang: Xuanling's ATK. This DMG is considered Heavy Attack DMG.
Casting Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure or Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather Stagnates nearby enemies.

Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance, Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom and Dodge Counter - Havoc in Bloom are immune to interruption.

chains.name: 戛剑棹歌而远
chains.desc:
重击·苍剑式、重击·羽剑式、空中攻击·释羽风落、普攻·湮象风华、闪避反击·湮象风华造成的伤害提升100%。

秧秧·玄翎每次脱离战斗状态或恢复意识后，处于非战斗状态达到4秒时，触发一次以下效果：
·获得贯珠，上限1层，施放普攻·苍剑式、普攻·羽剑式时，召唤玄翎之影·贯珠攻击目标，造成秧秧·玄翎攻击337.98%的湮灭伤害，此次伤害为重击伤害。召唤玄翎之影·贯珠后移除贯珠。
·回复2点【苍翎】。
·重置【绝息】、【流岚】的获取冷却时间。
chains.descEn:
The DMG dealt by Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance, Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance, Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall,  Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom, and Dodge Counter - Havoc in Bloom is increased by 100%.

Every time Yangyang: Xuanling remains out of combat for more than 4s after she leaves the combat state or revives, she gains the following effects once:
- Gain Strung Notes, up to 1 stack. Casting Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance or Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance summons Shadow of Xuanling: Strung Notes to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG equal to 337.98% of Yangyang: Xuanling's ATK, considered Heavy Attack DMG. Strung Notes is removed after Shadow of Xuanling: Strung Notes is summoned.
- Restore 2 points of Azure Plume.
- Reset the Cooldown of gaining Bated Breath and Streaming Storm.

chains.name: 追念暨云陵
chains.nameEn: My Grief Follows You into the Clouds
chains.desc:
共鸣解放裁羽寂万音造成的伤害加深175%。

施放变奏技能·羽挟苍空、共鸣技能·剑式流转·苍、共鸣技能·剑式流转·羽时，使自身一定范围内的目标【虚湮效应】层数上限增加3层，持续20秒，该效果无法叠加。

普攻·苍剑式第4段、普攻·羽剑式第4段、重击·苍剑式、重击·羽剑式额外为目标附加1层【虚湮效应】。
chains.descEn:
The DMG dealt via Resonance Liberation Hush of a Thousand Voices is Amplified by 175%.

After casting Intro Skill - Skybound Feather, Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure, or Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather, increase the maximum Havoc Bane stacks on targets within a certain range by 3, lasting 20s. This effect does not stack.

Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Stage 4, Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Stage 4, Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance, and Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance inflict 1 additional stack of Havoc Bane on the target.

chains.name: 一纸信笺遥眷
chains.nameEn: Across the Miles, a Letter and My Longing
chains.desc: 施放变奏技能·羽挟苍空、共鸣技能·剑式切换·苍、共鸣技能·剑式切换·羽、共鸣技能·剑式流转·苍、共鸣技能·剑式流转·羽时，队伍中的角色攻击提升20%，持续20秒。
chains.descEn: When casting Intro Skill - Skybound Feather, Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Switch: Azure, Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Switch: Feather, Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure, or Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather, the ATK of Resonators in the team is increased by 20% for 20s.

chains.name: 羽展。羽展
chains.desc: 秧秧·玄翎受到致命伤害时，此次伤害不会使秧秧·玄翎倒下，并回复秧秧·玄翎50%生命上限的生命值，同时免疫伤害和打断，持续3秒。该效果每10分钟可触发1次。
chains.descEn: When Yangyang: Xuanling takes a fatal blow, she will not be downed, but instead recover HP equal to 50% of her Max HP while becoming immune to DMG and interruption for 3s. This effect can be triggered once every 10 min.

chains.name: 所愿苍琅长睆
chains.nameEn: Let the Azure Keep Its Light
chains.desc:
秧秧·玄翎为目标附加【虚湮效应】后，获得万声皆流，持续30秒。万声皆流持续期间，目标受到秧秧·玄翎的重击伤害提升40%。

施放共鸣技能·剑式流转·苍、共鸣技能·剑式流转·羽时，获得止如槁木，持续30秒。止如槁木持续期间，若秧秧·玄翎为队伍中登场角色，则附近队伍中的角色为目标附加【霜渐效应】、【聚爆效应】、【电磁效应】、【风蚀效应】、【光噪效应】、【虚湮效应】后，秧秧·玄翎召唤玄翎之影·止如槁木攻击目标，造成秧秧·玄翎攻击337.98%的湮灭伤害。玄翎之影·止如槁木的伤害为重击伤害，且必定暴击。

玄翎之影·止如槁木召唤间隔1秒，召唤5次后移除止如槁木，止如槁木持续时间结束或被移除后，重置玄翎之影·止如槁木的召唤次数，止如槁木的获取冷却时间25秒。
chains.descEn:
After Yangyang: Xuanling inflicts Havoc Bane on a target, gain Voice Flux for 30s. While Voice Flux is active, targets take 40% more Heavy Attack DMG from Yangyang: Xuanling.

Casting Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure or Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather grants Still as Withered Wood for 30s. While Still as Withered Wood is active, if Yangyang: Xuanling is on the field, then after nearby Resonators in the team inflict Glacio Chafe, Fusion Burst, Electro Flare, Aero Erosion, Spectro Frazzle, or Havoc Bane, Yangyang: Xuanling summons Shadow of Xuanling: Still as Withered Wood to attack the target, dealing Havoc DMG equal to 337.98% of Yangyang: Xuanling's ATK. The DMG of Shadow of Xuanling: Still as Withered Wood is considered Heavy Attack DMG and is guaranteed to be a critical hit.

Shadow of Xuanling: Still as Withered Wood can be summoned once every 1s, and Still as Withered Wood expires after it is summoned 5 times. When Still as Withered Wood expires or is removed, reset the available summon charges of Shadow of Xuanling: Still as Withered Wood. Still as Withered Wood has a Cooldown of 25s.

Obtaining Fervor increases ATK by 40.00% and Movement Speed by 25.00%. Having more than 6 stacks of Fervor additionally increases ATK by 40.00%, Movement Speed by 25.00%, and DMG dealt to Immobilized targets by 100.00%.
CD: 35s

skill.descEnRank5:
Transform into Rocksteady Guardian and enter a Parry State. Upon being attacked, deal Spectro DMG equal to 8.29% of the Resonator's Max HP, and perform a follow-up attack that deals Spectro DMG equal to 8.29% of the Resonator's Max HP.
 
Use the Echo Skill again to exit the transformation.
 
If the attack received is a Special Skill attack, interrupt the enemy's Special Skill, gain a Shield equal to 30% Max HP, and perform a two-stage follow-up attack, each dealing Spectro DMG equal to 5.52% of the Resonator's Max HP. These follow-up attacks simultaneously launch three ground-breaking waves, each dealing Spectro DMG equal to 4.59% of the Resonator's Max HP.
 
CD: 15s
